> _Reasoning_
> Now Gantt (GNT-1..4, CPM-2) and PERT (PRT-1..3) components. These compute layout geometry in PHP from persisted engine output.
> 
> **Gantt\Index** design:
> - mount(project): load.
> - properties: zoom = 'day'|'week'|'month', memberFilter.
> - computed render data:
>   - $tasks rows (tree order with depth), filtered by member like tasks page (reuse simple filter).
>   - timeline: start = min(effective_start) minus 2 days; end = max(effective_end) plus 2 days.
>   - units: day zoom → each day from start..end; label day number + month; colW=26. week zoom → weeks; colW=64; month → months; colW=110.
>   - nonWorking(day): weekend or holiday → shading in day zoom; in week/month: unit is "nonworking" if ALL its days are non-working (rare) — instead shade lightly if contains holidays. I'll implement: for week/month, column bg normal; add small red dot if contains holiday. Keep simple: only day zoom shades (documented in DECISIONS already D-24-ish; I'll note).
>   - x(dayIndex) = dayIndex * dayW where dayW = colW/unitsDays? Simpler: compute everything in "day units" horizontally: dayW = zoom day ? 26 : zoom week ? 8 : 4? Then week column = 7*8=56, month = daysInMonth*4 (varying width). Labels positioned per column. This gives exact bar geometry: x = diffDays(start, date) * dayW; barWidth = (diffDays(start,end)+1) * dayW -2.
>   - day zoom dayW=26, week dayW=8 (56/wk), month dayW=4 (~120/mo).
> - rows: height 28. Left panel: name with indent (fixed 260px), right: SVG of width totalDays*dayW, height rows*28.
> - bars: rect x, y=row*28+6, h=16, rx=4. Parent: slate-700; critical: rose-500 fill + rose-700 stroke width 2 + ⚠ text at bar end? Accessibility: add "⚠" glyph inside critical bars + thicker stroke. Milestone: diamond polygon.
> - assignees: initials text after bar (or inside if wide enough): text x = bar end + 6.
> - leave/overlap warning: amber⚠ before initials (from same warnings logic — reuse simplified: leave overlap only).
> - dependency arrows: for each dependency where both tasks are rows visible: line from (predX2, predY) → elbow → (succX, succY) with marker-end arrow. Only draw between rows; use path: M x1 y1 H x1+8 V y2 H x2-6 with arrow marker.
> - today line: if today within range: vertical dashed rose line + label "Today".
> - header: months row + days/weeks row. To keep simple: single header row of units: day zoom shows day numbers (rotate?) — 26px wide fits "5"; show day-of-month; weekend shaded header too. week zoom shows "W?? (d MMM)"? Use label = start date of week "d MMM". month: "MMM YY".
> - holidays shading day zoom: rect full height light amber.
> - weekend shading: rect light slate.
> - zoom buttons + member filter select.
> - scroll container overflow-x auto.
> 
> Left panel rows must align with SVG rows (28px each) — render left list separately with same heights. Header height 32px; SVG includes header? Simpler: put header INSIDE the same SVG: headerY=0..32; bars start at 32. Left panel has a spacer header of 32px with the task column title. 
> 
> **Pert\Index**:
> - tasks = all tasks (incl parents? parents are derived nodes; include with distinct style) — include all for completeness; edges: dependencies + rollup edges (parent→child? no — keep dependency edges only; plus for readability include hierarchy edges as dashed). Simpler: dependency edges only; parents shown as separate nodes (their window derives from children).
> - layout: level via longest path from roots over dependency edges (ignore edges to parents? dependency edges may involve parents (treated at parent level)). level(t) = 0 if no incoming else max(level(pred))+1. Guard cycles (prevented already). Nodes positioned: x = level*220, y = index within level * 110 + 20.
> - node box 180x84: name (bold, truncate), dur, ES→EF, plus critical badge ⚠ + red border; on click (Alpine wire:click selectTask) detail panel below shows LS, LF, slack (PRT-2: ES/EF + optional LS/LF/slack — show in panel).
> - arrows between boxes with marker.
> - pan/zoom: buttons zoom in/out/reset scaling SVG via transform on <g> (Alpine state), container overflow-auto. Click node shows details panel (wire:model selectedTaskId).
> - SVG size: width = (maxLevel+1)*220+40, height = max(count per level)*110+40.

CPM-2: critical bars are highlighted (red + thicker\n * border + ⚠ marker — not colour alone, PRD §9 accessibility).\n *\n * Only layout geometry is computed here — every date comes from the persisted\n * engine output (build rule; D-24).\n */\n#[Layout('components.layouts.app')]\nclass Index extends Component\n{\n    public Project $project;\n\n    public string $zoom = 'day';\n\n    public ?int $memberFilter = null;\n\n    private const ROW_HEIGHT = 28;\n\n    private const HEADER_HEIGHT = 34;\n\n    public function mount(Project $project): void\n    {\n        $this->project = $project;\n    }\n\n    public function render()\n    {\n        $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();\n        $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');\n\n        $rows = [];\n        $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {\n            foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {\n                $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];\n                $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);\n            }\n        };\n        $walk(null, 0);\n\n        $assignments = Assignment::query()\n            ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)\n            ->with('resource:id,name')\n            ->get();\n\n        if ($this->memberFilter !== null) {\n            $rows = array_values(array_filter(\n                $rows,\n                static fn (array $row): bool => $assignments\n                    ->where('task_id', $row['task']->id)\n                    ->contains('resource_id', $this->memberFilter),\n            ));\n        }\n\n        $dated = $tasks->filter(static fn (Task $task): bool => $task->effective_start !== null && $task->effective_end !== null);\n\n        if ($dated->isEmpty()) {\n            return view('livewire.gantt.index', ['rows' => $rows, 'empty' => true, 'resources' => Resource::where('project_id', $this->project->id)->orderBy('name')->get()]);\n        }\n\n        $start = $dated->min('effective_start')->startOfDay()->subDays(2);\n        $end = $dated->max('effective_end')->startOfDay()->addDays(3);\n\n        $dayWidth = match ($this->zoom) {\n            'week' => 8,\n            'month' => 4,\n            default => 26,\n        };\n\n        $totalDays = $start->diffInDays($end) + 1;\n        $width = $totalDays * $dayWidth;\n\n        // Timeline units for the header (GNT-3 zoom).\n        $units = [];\n        if ($this->zoom === 'day') {\n            for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {\n                $units[] = [\n                    'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,\n                    'w' => $dayWidth,\n                    'label' => $date->format('j'),\n                    'bold' => $date->format('j') === '1',\n                    'nonworking' => ! $this->isWorking($date),\n                ];\n            }\n        } elseif ($this->zoom === 'week') {\n            for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addWeek()) {\n                $units[] = [\n                    'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,\n                    'w' => 7 * $dayWidth,\n                    'label' => $date->format('d M'),\n                    'bold' => false,\n                    'nonworking' => false,\n                ];\n            }\n        } else {\n            for ($date = $start->startOfMonth(); $date <= $end; $date = $date->addMonthNoOverflow()) {\n                $x = max(0, $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth);\n                $next = $date->addMonthNoOverflow();\n                $w = min($width - $x, $date->diffInDays($next) * $dayWidth);\n                $units[] = [\n                    'x' => $x,\n                    'w' => $w,\n                    'label' => $date->format('M Y'),\n                    'bold' => false,\n                    'nonworking' => false,\n                ];\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Non-working day columns (weekends + holidays) for shading (GNT-2).\n        $shaded = [];\n        if ($this->zoom === 'day') {\n            $holidays = Holiday::query()\n                ->where('calendar_id', $this->project->calendar_id)\n                ->get()\n                ->flatMap(static function (Holiday $holiday): array {\n                    $days = [];\n                    $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();\n                    $finish = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;\n\n                    for ($date = $start; $date <= $finish; $date = $date->addDay()) {\n                        $days[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');\n                    }\n\n                    return $days;\n                })\n                ->flip();\n\n            for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = > _Reasoning_
> Note: `! $barRows` when empty — barRows key exists only when not empty; view guarded by $empty || ! $barRows. When empty true, 'barRows' not passed → undefined variable in @if — `! $barRows` on undefined... In Blade compiled PHP, `$barRows` undefined → warning + null → `! null` = true → shows empty div. Undefined variable emits E_WARNING (in Laravel, converted to ErrorException in debug!). Risky. Fix: pass 'barRows' => [] in empty case. Let me patch the empty return in Gantt mount render: add 'barRows' => [], 'resources' already there.
> 
> Also careful in the view: `$todayX`, `$width` etc referenced only in else-branch. The @if uses $empty first so short-circuit prevents evaluating $barRows... no — `@if ($empty || ! $barRows)` still evaluates $barRows only if $empty false (PHP || short-circuits). If $empty true → OK. But inside else branch all vars passed. Good, but add barRows=[] anyway for safety.

{
  "path": "app/Livewire/Pert/Index.php",
  "instructions": "PERT/network diagram component with ES/EF/LS/LF/slack (PRT-1..3, CPM-2/3)",
  "content": "<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nnamespace App\\Livewire\\Pert;\n\nuse App\\Models\\Dependency;\nuse App\\Models\\Project;\nuse App\\Models\\Task;\nuse Livewire\\Attributes\\Layout;\nuse Livewire\\Component;\n\n/**\n * PRT-1..PRT-3: tasks as nodes connected by dependency arrows, laid out left\n * to right by dependency level; nodes show name, duration, ES/EF, and the\n * selected node's details show LS/LF and slack (PRT-2, CPM-3). Critical nodes\n * carry the ⚠ marker and a thicker border (CPM-2, PRD §9 accessibility).\n *\n * Only layout geometry is computed here; all dates/slack come from the\n * persisted engine output (D-24).\n */\n#[Layout('components.layouts.app')]\nclass Index extends Component\n{\n    public Project $project;\n\n    public ?int $selectedTaskId = null;\n\n    public float $zoomFactor = 1.0;\n\n    public function mount(Project $project): void\n    {\n        $this->project = $project;\n    }\n\n    public function select(int $taskId): void\n    {\n        $this->selectedTaskId = $this->selectedTaskId === $taskId ? null : $taskId;\n    }\n\n    public function zoomIn(): void\n    {\n        $this->zoomFactor = min(2.0, round($this->zoomFactor + 0.25, 2));\n    }\n\n    public function zoomOut(): void\n    {\n        $this->zoomFactor = max(0.5, round($this->zoomFactor - 0.25, 2));\n    }\n\n    public function zoomReset(): void\n    {\n        $this->zoomFactor = 1.0;\n    }\n\n    public function render()\n    {\n        $tasks = Task::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->orderBy('order')->get();\n\n        if ($tasks->isEmpty()) {\n            return view('livewire.pert.index', ['empty' => true]);\n        }\n\n        $dependencies = Dependency::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->get();\n\n        // Level = longest path from any root over dependency edges (PRT-1 layout).\n        $levelOf = [];\n        $byId = $tasks->keyBy('id');\n\n        $incoming = $dependencies->groupBy('successor_id');\n        $outgoing = $dependencies->groupBy('predecessor_id');\n\n        $resolveLevel = function (int $id) use (&$resolveLevel, &$levelOf, $incoming, $byId): int {\n            if (isset($levelOf[$id])) {\n                return $levelOf[$id];\n            }\n\n            $levelOf[$id] = 0; // guard against cycles (prevented at save time)\n\n            $predLevels = $incoming[$id]\n                ?->map(static fn ($dependency) => $resolveLevel((int) $dependency->predecessor_id) + 1)\n                ?? collect();\n\n            return $levelOf[$id] = $predLevels->max() ?? 0;\n        };\n\n        foreach ($tasks as $task) {\n            $resolveLevel($task->id);\n        }\n\n        $columns = [];\n        foreach ($tasks as $task) {\n            $columns[$levelOf[$task->id]][] = $task;\n        }\n        ksort($columns);\n\n        $nodeWidth = 190;\n        $nodeHeight = 84;\n        $gapX = 70;\n        $gapY = 26;\n\n        $positions = [];\n        foreach ($columns as $level => $nodes) {\n            foreach ($nodes as $index => $task) {\n                $positions[$task->id] = [\n                    'x' => 20 + $level * ($nodeWidth + $gapX),\n                    'y' => 20 + $index * ($nodeHeight + $gapY),\n                ];\n            }\n        }\n\n        $edges = [];\n        foreach ($dependencies as $dependency) {\n            if (! isset($positions[$dependency->predecessor_id], $positions[$dependency->successor_id])) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            $from = $positions[$dependency->predecessor_id];\n            $to = $positions[$dependency->successor_id];\n\n            $x1 = $from['x'] + $nodeWidth;\n            $y1 = $from['y'] + $nodeHeight / 2;\n            $x2 = $to['x'];\n            $y2 = $to['y'] + $nodeHeight / 2;\n\n            $edges[] = [\n                'd' => \"M {$x1} {$y1} C \".($x1 + 35).\" {$y1}, \".($x2 - 35).\" {$y2}, {$x2} {$y2}\",\n                'label' => $dependency->type.($dependency->lag !== 0 ? ' ('.$dependency->lag.')' : ''),\n                'labelX' => ($x1 + $x2) / 2,\n                'labelY' => ($y1 + $y2) / 2 - 5,\n            ];\n        }\n\n        $width = 20 + (max(array_keys($columns)) + 1) * ($nodeWidth + $gapX) + 20;\n        $height = 20 + max(array_map('count', $columns)) * ($nodeHeight + $gapY) + 20;\n\n        return view('livewire.pert.index', [\n            'nodes' => $tasks->map(static fn (Task $task): array => [\n                'task' => $task,\n                'x' => $positions[$task->id]['x'],\n                'y' => $positions[$task->id]['y'],\n            ])->values(),\n            'edges' => $edges,\n            'width' => $width,\n            'height' => $height,\n            'nodeWidth' => $nodeWidth,\n            'nodeHeight' => $nodeHeight,\n            'selected' => $this->selectedTaskId !== null ? $byId->get($this->selectedTaskId) : null,\n            'empty' => false,\n        ]);\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "path": "tests/Unit/Scheduling/WorkingCalendarTest.php",
  "instructions": "Unit tests for working-day arithmetic",
  "content": "<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nuse App\\Domain\\Scheduling\\SchedulingException;\nuse App\\Domain\\Scheduling\\WorkingCalendar;\n\n// PRD CAL-1/CAL-2/CAL-3 + §8.1 working-day rules.\n\nit('knows working days, weekends and holidays', function () {\n    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);\n\n    expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBeTrue()   // Monday\n        ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeFalse()  // Saturday\n        ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse()  // Sunday\n        ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-08')))->toBeFalse(); // Thursday holiday\n});\n\nit('supports six-day working weeks (any working-day set)', function () {\n    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);\n\n    expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeTrue()  // Saturday\n        ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse(); // Sunday\n});\n\nit('moves a non-working start date to the next working day (TSK-1 AC)', function () {\n    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);\n\n    expect($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12') // Sat → Mon\n        ->and($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12'); // Mon stays\n});\n\nit('shifts forwards and backwards by working days only', function () {\n    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);\n\n    expect($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-09'), 1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')  // Fri +1wd = Mon\n        ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), -1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09')\n        ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), 0)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');\n});\n\nit('counts working days between dates', function () {\n    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);\n\n    // Jan 5 (Mon) → Jan 12 (Mon): 6,7,9,10,12 = 5 working days (8 is a holiday)\n    expect($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12')))->toBe(5)\n        ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(0)\n        ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(-5);\n});\n\nit('rejects a calendar without working days', function () {\n    new WorkingCalendar([]);\n})->throws(SchedulingException::class);\n"

{
  "path": "tests/Unit/Scheduling/ScheduleEngineTest.php",
  "instructions": "Reference networks calculated by hand (CPM-1 AC)",
  "content": "<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nuse App\\Domain\\Scheduling\\CircularDependencyException;\nuse App\\Domain\\Scheduling\\DependencyLink;\nuse App\\Domain\\Scheduling\\DependencyType;\nuse App\\Domain\\Scheduling\\ProjectScheduleInput;\nuse App\\Domain\\Scheduling\\SchedulableTask;\nuse App\\Domain\\Scheduling\\ScheduleEngine;\nuse App\\Domain\\Scheduling\\WorkingCalendar;\n\n/**\n * Reference test cases for CPM-1: networks calculated BY HAND, including\n * SS, lag and holiday cases (PRD CPM-1 acceptance criteria).\n *\n * Baseline calendar for all cases: Mon–Fri, no holidays unless stated.\n */\n\nfunction engine(): ScheduleEngine\n{\n    return new ScheduleEngine;\n}\n\nfunction task(int $id, ?int $parent, ?string $start, int $duration): SchedulableTask\n{\n    return new SchedulableTask($id, $parent, $id, \"Task {$id}\", $start ? new DateTimeImmutable($start) : null, $duration);\n}\n\nfunction monFri(): WorkingCalendar\n{\n    return new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);\n}\n\nit('calculates an FS chain with holiday skipping and positive lag (reference case 1)', function () {\n    // Holiday: Thu 2026-01-08.\n    // A: 5wd from Mon Jan 5 → Jan 5,6,7,9,12 → finishes Mon Jan 12.\n    // B: FS lag 0 → Tue Jan 13, 3wd → finishes Thu Jan 15.\n    // C: FS lag 2 → 2wd after Jan 15 = Tue Jan 20, 2wd → finishes Wed Jan 21.\n    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);\n\n    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(\n        $calendar,\n        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 5), task(2, null, null, 3), task(3, null, null, 2)],\n        [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 2)],\n        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),\n    ));\n\n    expect($result->forTask(1)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')\n        ->and($result->forTask(1)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')\n        ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13')\n        ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-15')\n        ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-20')\n        ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')\n        ->and($result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')\n        ->and($result->totalDuration)->toBe(12)\n        ->and($result->forTask(1)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()\n        ->and($result->forTask(1)->slack)->toBe(0);\n});\n\nit('takes the latest constraint when a task has several predecessors (reference case 2, DEP-6)', function () {\n    // A: 2wd from Mon Jan 5 → finishes Tue Jan 6. B: 1wd from Fri Jan 2 → finishes Jan 2.\n    // C: FS from A → Jan 7; FS from B → Jan 5. Max wins: Jan 7. C: 2wd → finishes Jan 8.\n    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(\n        monFri(),\n        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 2), task(2, null, '2026-01-02', 1), task(3, null, null, 2)],\n        [new DependencyLink(1, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0)],\n        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-02'),\n    ));\n\n    expect($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')\n        ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08')\n        ->and($result->forTask(2)->slack)->toBeGreaterThan(0)\n        ->and($result->forTask(2)->isCritical)->toBeFalse();\n});\n\nit('handles start-to-start with negative lag (lead) (reference case 3, DEP-3/DEP-4)', function () {\n    // A: 3wd from Mon Jan 5 → Jan 5..7.\n    // B: SS lag −1 from A, no requested start → default start Jan 5 anchors first,\n    //    so B starts Jan 5 (max of default and shift(A.start, -1) = Jan 2). B: 2wd → Jan 5..6.\n    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(\n        monFri(),\n        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 3), task(2, null, null, 2)],\n        [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::SS, -1)],\n        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),\n    ));\n\n    expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')\n        ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06');\n\n    // Same network, but B requested to start Wed Jan 7: SS −1 only requires Jan 2,\n    // so the requested start wins.\n    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(\n        monFri(),\n        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 3), task(2, null, '2026-01-07', 2)],\n        [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::SS, -1)],\n        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),\n    ));\n\n    expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')\n        ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08');\n});\n\nit('computes slack and multiple critical paths (reference case 4, CPM-2/CPM-5)', function () {\n    // A(2wd) → B(3wd) → D(1wd);  A → C(1wd) → D.\n    // Longest path A→B→D = 6wd, so C has float.\n    // A: Jan 5-6, B: Jan 7-9, C: Jan 7, D: Jan 12. Project: Jan 5..12 (6wd).\n    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(\n        monFri(),\n        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 2), task(2, null, null, 3), task(3, null, null, 1), task(4, null, null, 1)],\n        [\n            new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0),\n            new DependencyLink(1, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0),\n            new DependencyLink(2, 4, DependencyType::FS, 0),\n            new DependencyLink(3, 4, DependencyType::FS, 0),\n        ],\n        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),\n    ));\n\n    expect($result->forTask(3)->slack)->toBe(3)\n        ->and($result->forTask(3)->isCritical)->toBeFalse()\n        ->and($result->forTask(1)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()\n        ->and($result->forTask(2)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()\n        ->and($result->forTask(4)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()\n        ->and($result->totalDuration)->toBe(6)\n        ->and($result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');\n});\n\nit('rolls parent tasks up from their children (reference case 5, TSK-4)', function () {\n    // Parent 10 with children: c1 (Jan 5, 2wd) and c2 (requested Jan 8, 3wd → Jan 8-12).\n    // Parent: Jan 5..Jan 12.           // CAL-2\n\n    Livewire::test(Index::class)->assertSee('Mobile App Launch');\n});\n\nit('edits a project (PRJ-2)', function () {\n    $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Old name']);\n\n    Livewire::test(Form::class, ['project' => $project])\n        ->set('name', 'New name')\n        ->call('save')\n        ->assertHasNoErrors()\n        ->assertRedirect(route('projects.show', $project));\n\n    expect($project->fresh()->name)->toBe('New name');\n});\n\nit('deletes a project only after confirmation (PRJ-2)', function () {\n    $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Doomed']);\n\n    Livewire::test(Index::class)\n        ->call('askDelete', $project->id)\n        ->assertSet('deleteId', $project->id)\n        ->call('delete');\n\n    expect(Project::withTrashed()->find($project->id)->trashed())->toBeTrue();\n});\n"

{
  "path": "tests/Feature/DependencyTest.php",
  "instructions": "Feature tests for dependency requirements (incl. cycle prevention)",
  "content": "<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nuse App\\Livewire\\Tasks\\Index as TasksIndex;\nuse App\\Models\\Dependency;\nuse App\\Models\\Project;\nuse App\\Models\\Task;\n\n// DEP-1..DEP-6 task dependency requirements.\n\nfunction twoTaskProject(): Project\n{\n    $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Deps project']);\n\n    Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Design', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 3, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);\n    Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Build', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 2]);\n\n    return $project->fresh();\n}\n\nfunction componentFor(Project $project, int $taskId): TasksIndex\n{\n    $component = Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project]);\n    $component->call('edit', $taskId);\n\n    return $component;\n}\n\nit('starts the successor 2 working days after the predecessor finishes with lag 2 (DEP-2/DEP-4 AC)', function () {\n    $project = twoTaskProject();\n    $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();\n    $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();\n\n    componentFor($project, $build->id)\n        ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 2])\n        ->call('addPredecessor')\n        ->assertHasNoErrors();\n\n    expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(1)\n        ->and(Dependency::first()->lag)->toBe(2);\n\n    // Design finishes Fri Jan 9; +2 working days → successor starts Wed Jan 14.\n    expect(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_start'))->toBe('2026-01-14')\n        ->and(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_end'))->toBe('2026-01-15');\n});\n\nit('supports start-to-start dependencies (DEP-3)', function () {\n    $project = twoTaskProject();\n    $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();\n    $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();\n\n    componentFor($project, $build->id)\n        ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'SS', 'lag' => 0])\n        ->call('addPredecessor');\n\n    // Build starts together with Design (Jan 5) and ends Jan 6.\n    expect(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_start'))->toBe('2026-01-05')\n        ->and(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_end'))->toBe('2026-01-06');\n});\n\nit('prevents circular dependencies and names the cycle (DEP-5)', function () {\n    $project = twoTaskProject();\n    $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();\n    $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();\n\n    // Design → Build (FS) is fine…\n    componentFor($project, $build->id)\n        ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])\n        ->call('addPredecessor')\n        ->assertHasNoErrors();\n\n    // …but Build → Design would close the loop and must be rejected with the cycle named.\n    $component = componentFor($project, $design->id)\n        ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $build->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])\n        ->call('addPredecessor');\n\n    expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(1)\n        ->and(implode(' ', $component->get('dependencyErrors')))\n        ->toContain('Circular dependency detected')\n        ->toContain('Design')\n        ->toContain('Build');\n});\n\nit('rejects a dependency on itself and on own sub-activities (DEP-5)', function () {\n    $project = twoTaskProject();\n    $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();\n    $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();\n\n    // Make Build a child of Design, then try Design → its own child.\n    $build->update(['parent_id' => $design->id]);\n\n    componentFor($project, $design->id)\n        ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $build->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])\n        ->call('addPredecessor');\n\n    // Self dependency\n    componentFor($project, $design->id)\n        ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])\n        ->call('addPredecessor');\n\n    expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(0);\n});\n\nit('uses the latest constraint for multiple predecessors (DEP-6)', function () {\n    $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Merge']);\n    Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'A', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 2, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);\n    Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'B', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);\n    Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'C', 'order' => 2, 'duration' => 2]);\n\n    $a = Task::where('name', 'A')->first();\n    $b = Task::where('name', 'B')->first();\n    $c = Task::where('name', 'C')->first();\n\n    componentFor($project, $c->id)\n        ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $a->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])\n        ->call('addPredecessor')\n        ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $b->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])\n        ->call('addPredecessor');\n\n    // A ends Jan 6 → C would start Jan 7; B ends Jan 5 → Jan 6. Latest wins: Jan 7.\n    expect(Task::where('name', 'C')->value('effective_start'))->toBe('2026-01-07');\n});\n\nit('removes predecessors (DEP-1)', function () {\n    $project = twoTaskProject();\n    $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();\n    $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();\n\n    $component = componentFor($project, $build->id)\n        ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])\n        ->call('addPredecessor');\n\n    $dependencyId = Dependency::first()->id;\n\n    $component->call('removePredecessor', $dependencyId);\n    expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(0);\n\n    // Build is now unconstrained and falls back to the earliest project start.\n    expect(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_start'))->toBe('2026-01-05');\n});\n"
}

<?php

namespace Livewire\Features\SupportValidation;

use Attribute;
use Livewire\Features\SupportAttributes\Attribute as LivewireAttribute;

use function Livewire\wrap;

#[Attribute(Attribute::IS_REPEATABLE | Attribute::TARGET_ALL)]
class BaseValidate extends LivewireAttribute
{
    function __construct(
        public $rule = null,
        protected $attribute = null,
        protected $as = null,
        protected $message = null,
        protected $onUpdate = true,
        protected bool $translate = true
    ) {}

    function boot()
    {
        // If this attribute is added to a "form object", we want to add the rules
        // to the actual form object, not the base component...
        $target = $this->subTarget ?: $this->component;
        $name = $this->subTarget ? $this->getSubName() : $this->getName();

        $rules = [];

        if (is_null($this->rule)) {
            // Allow "Rule" to be used without a given validation rule. It's purpose is to instead
            // trigger validation on property updates...
        } elseif (is_array($this->rule) && count($this->rule) > 0 && ! is_numeric(array_keys($this->rule)[0])) {
            // Support setting rules by key-value for this and other properties:
            // For example, #[Validate(['foo' => 'required', 'foo.*' => 'required'])]
            $rules = $this->rule;
        } else {
            $rules[$this->getSubName()] = $this->rule;
        }

        if ($this->attribute) {
            if (is_array($this->attribute)) {
                $target = $this->subTarget ?? $this->component;
                $target->addValidationAttributesFromOutside($this->attribute);
            } else {
                $target->addValidationAttributesFromOutside([$name => $this->attribute]);
            }
        }

        if ($this->as) {
            if (is_array($this->as)) {
                $as = $this->translate
                    ? array_map(fn ($i) => trans($i), $this->as)
                    : $this->as;

                $target->addValidationAttributesFromOutside($as);
            } else {
                $target->addValidationAttributesFromOutside([$name => $this->translate ? trans($this->as) : $this->as]);
            }

Positional second param is `$attribute` (validation attribute name), not extra rule. So `each` rule with constraints must be a single string: `#[Validate('each:in,1,2,3,4,5,6,7')]`? The 'each' rule doesn't take colon params like that... Laravel's `each` works with dot notation `workingDays.*` => 'in:...'. Simplest: replace the two attributes with one: `#[Validate('required|array|min:1')]` and add the per-item rule via `rules()` method override:

          $project = makeProject();

              ->set('name', '')
              ->set('duration', -1)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasErrors(['name' => 'required', 'duration']);
      });
      
      it('moves a non-working start to the next working day and calculates the end (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
          $project = makeProject();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Weekend start')
              ->set('startInput', '2026-01-10') // Saturday
              ->set('duration', 2)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $task = Task::first();
      
          // Start moves to Monday Jan 12; 2 working days end Tuesday Jan 13.
          expect($task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13');
      });

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Tasks;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use App\Services\Schedule\DependencyValidator;
      use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * TSK-1..TSK-4 (P0): tasks with name/start/duration/priority, edit, delete,
       * reorder, nesting up to 4 levels [A], parents calculated from children.
       * P1: milestones (duration 0), percent complete, indent/outdent (TSK-7).
       * DEP-1..DEP-6: predecessors with FS/SS + lag, cycle prevention with a message
       * naming the cycle. ASN-1/ASN-2: assignments shown in the list.
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          // Task form state
          public bool $showModal = false;
      
          public ?int $editingId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $name = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:2000')]
          public string $description = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|date')]
          public ?string $startInput = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:3650')]
          public int $duration = 1;
      
          #[Validate('required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical')]
          public string $priority = 'Medium';
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:100')]
          public int $percentComplete = 0;
      
          #[Validate('nullable|integer')]
          public ?int $parentId = null;
      
          /** @var list<int> */
          public array $assignedResourceIds = [];
      
          // Predecessor quick-add (DEP-1..DEP-4)
          public array $newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
      
          public array $dependencyErrors = [];
      
          public ?int $deleteId = null;
      
          /** ASN-5: filter the schedule by member */
          public ?int $memberFilter = null;
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              $this->editingId = $task->id;
              $this->name = $task->name;
              $this->description = (string) $task->description;
              $this->startInput = $task->start_input?->format('Y-m-d');
              $this->duration = $task->duration;
              $this->priority = $task->priority;
              $this->percentComplete = $task->percent_complete;
              $this->parentId = $task->parent_id;
              $this->assignedResourceIds = $task->assignments()->pluck('resource_id')->map('intval')->all();
              $this->reset(['newPredecessor', 'dependencyErrors']);
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              $data = [
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'description' => $this->description ?: null,
                  'start_input' => $this->startInput ?: null,
                  'duration' => $this->duration,
                  'priority' => $this->priority,
                  'percent_complete' => $this->percentComplete,
                  'parent_id' => $this->parentId,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $data['order'] = (int) $this->project->tasks()->whereNull('parent_id')->max('order') + 1;
                  $task = Task::create($data);
              } else {
                  $task = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
                  $task->update($data);
                  $this->syncDescendantsTypes($task);
              }
      
              $task->refresh();
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
      
              // ASN-1: assign one or more members
              Assignment::query()->where('task_id', $task->id)->delete();
              foreach (array_unique($this->assignedResourceIds) as $resourceId) {
                  $resource = Resource::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->find($resourceId);
      
                  if ($resource !== null) {
                      Assignment::create([
                          'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                          'task_id' => $task->id,
                          'resource_id' => $resource->id,
                          'role' => $resource->role,
                      ]);
                  }
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }
      
          public function askDelete(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = $taskId;
          }
      
          public function cancelDelete(): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function delete(): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask((int) $this->deleteId);
      
              // Sub-activities are unparented (FK nullOnDelete), dependencies cascade.
              $task->children()->update(['parent_id' => null]);
              $task->delete();
      
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function moveUp(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, -1);
          }
      
          public function moveDown(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, 1);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: indent = make the task a child of its previous sibling.
           */
          public function indent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
      
              if ($index === false || $index === 0) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $newParent = $siblings[$index - 1];
      
              if (app(DependencyValidator::class)->depthOf($newParent->id, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                  session()->now('warning', __('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $task->update(['parent_id' => $newParent->id, 'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $newParent->id)->max('order') + 1]);
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: outdent = move the task up to its grandparent level.
           */
          public function outdent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              if ($task->parent_id === null) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $parent = $this->findTask($task->parent_id);
      
              $task->update([
                  'parent_id' => $parent->parent_id,
                  'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $parent->parent_id)->max('order') + 1,
              ]);
      
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
              $this->syncTaskType($parent);
          }
      
          /**
           * DEP-5: adding a predecessor runs cycle detection first and shows a
           * message identifying the cycle.
           */
          public function addPredecessor(): void
          {
              $this->dependencyErrors = [];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null || $this->newPredecessor['task_id'] === null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_missing');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $predecessor = $this->findTask((int) $this->newPredecessor['task_id']);
              $successor = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
              $type = (string) $this->newPredecessor['type'];
              $lag = (int) $this->newPredecessor['lag'];
      
              $errors = app(DependencyValidator::class)
                  ->validateDependency($this->project, $predecessor, $successor, $type, $lag);
      
              if ($errors !== []) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors = $errors;
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $existing = Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('predecessor_id', $predecessor->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $successor->id)
                  ->first();
      
              if ($existing !== null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_exists');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              Dependency::create([
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'predecessor_id' => $predecessor->id,
                  'successor_id' => $successor->id,
                  'type' => in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true) ? $type : 'FS',
                  'lag' => $lag,
              ]);
      
              $this->reset('newPredecessor');
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          public function removePredecessor(int $dependencyId): void
          {
              Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                  ->findOrFail($dependencyId)
                  ->delete();
          }
      
          private function move(int $taskId, int $direction): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
              $targetIndex = $index === false ? null : $index + $direction;
      
              if ($index === false || $targetIndex === null || ! isset($siblings[$targetIndex])) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $other = $siblings[$targetIndex];
      
              $order = $task->order;
              $task->update(['order' => $other->order]);
              $other->update(['order' => $order]);
          }
      
          /** @return \Illuminate\Support\Collection<int, Task> */
          private function siblingsOf(Task $task)
          {
              return $this->project->tasks()
                  ->where('parent_id', $task->parent_id)
                  ->orderBy('order')
                  ->get();
          }
      
          /** @return array<string, mixed> */
          protected function rules(): array
          {
              return [
                  'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
                  'description' => 'nullable|string|max:2000',
                  'startInput' => 'nullable|date',
                  'duration' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:3650',
                  'priority' => 'required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical',
                  'percentComplete' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:100',
                  'parentId' => ['nullable', 'integer', function (string $attribute, $value, callable $fail): void {
                      if ($value === null || $this->editingId === null) {
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($value === $this->editingId) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_self'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      $validator = app(DependencyValidator::class);
      
                      if ($validator->isAncestorOf($this->editingId, $value, $this->project)) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_descendant'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($validator->depthOf($value, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
                      }
                  }],
              ];
          }
      
          private function findTask(int $taskId): Task
          {
              return Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($taskId);
          }
      
          private function resetForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset([
                  'editingId',
                  'name',
                  'description',
                  'startInput',
                  'duration',
                  'priority',
                  'percentComplete',
                  'parentId',
                  'assignedResourceIds',
                  'dependencyErrors',
              ]);
      
              $this->duration = 1;
              $this->priority = 'Medium';
              $this->percentComplete = 0;
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          /**
           * Keep the denormalised task_type in sync: Milestone (duration 0),
           * Parent (has children), Task (TSK-5 / display only).
           */
          private function syncTaskType(Task $task): void
          {
              $task->refresh();
      
              $type = match (true) {
                  $task->children()->exists() => 'Parent',
                  $task->duration === 0 => 'Milestone',
                  default => 'Task',
              };
      
              if ($task->task_type !== $type) {
                  $task->forceFill(['task_type' => $type])->saveQuietly();
              }
          }
      
          private function syncDescendantsTypes(Task $task): void
          {
              foreach ($task->children as $child) {
                  $this->syncTaskType($child);
              }
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
              $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');
      
              $rows = [];
              $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walk(null, 0);
      
              $assignments = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->with('resource:id,name')
                  ->get()
                  ->groupBy('task_id');
      
              // ASN-3: warn when an assigned member is on leave or double-booked.
              $warnings = [];
              foreach ($rows as $row) {
                  $task = $row['task'];
      
                  if ($task->effective_start === null || $task->effective_end === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  foreach ($assignments[$task->id] ?? [] as $assignment) {
                      $resource = $assignment->resource;
      
                      if ($resource === null || $resource->trashed()) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $onLeave = $resource->leaves()
                          ->where('start_date', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->where('end_date', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($onLeave) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_leave', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
      
                      $overlapping = Assignment::query()
                          ->where('resource_id', $resource->id)
                          ->where('task_id', '!=', $task->id)
                          ->whereHas('task', static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                              $query->where('effective_start', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                                  ->where('effective_end', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'));
                          })
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($overlapping) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_overlap', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              $filtered = $this->memberFilter === null
                  ? $rows
                  : array_values(array_filter($rows, static fn (array $row): bool => $assignments[$row['task']->id]
                      ?->contains(static fn (Assignment $assignment): bool => $assignment->resource_id === $this->memberFilter) ?? false));
      
              $predecessors = $this->editingId === null
                  ? collect()
                  : Dependency::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                      ->with('predecessor:id,name')
                      ->get();
      
              return view('livewire.tasks.index', [
                  'rows' => $filtered,
                  'allTasks' => $tasks,
                  'resources' => $this->project->resources()->orderBy('name')->get(),
                  'assignments' => $assignments,
                  'warnings' => $warnings,
                  'predecessors' => $predecessors,
                  'parentCandidates' => $tasks
                      ->whereNull('parent_id')
                      ->reject(fn (Task $task): bool => $this->editingId !== null && $task->id === $this->editingId)
                      ->values(),
              ]);
          }
      }

      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Tasks;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;

      use App\Services\Schedule\DependencyValidator;
      use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * TSK-1..TSK-4 (P0): tasks with name/start/duration/priority, edit, delete,
       * reorder, nesting up to 4 levels [A], parents calculated from children.
       * P1: milestones (duration 0), percent complete, indent/outdent (TSK-7).
       * DEP-1..DEP-6: predecessors with FS/SS + lag, cycle prevention with a message

      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {

              $this->editingId = $task->id;
              $this->name = $task->name;
              $this->description = (string) $task->description;
              $this->startInput = $task->start_input?->format('Y-m-d');
              $this->duration = $task->duration;
              $this->priority = $task->priority;
              $this->percentComplete = $task->percent_complete;
              $this->parentId = $task->parent_id;

                  'start_input' => $this->startInput ?: null,

                  'parent_id' => $this->parentId,

                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->find($resourceId);

                          'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                          'task_id' => $task->id,
                          'resource_id' => $resource->id,

              $lag = (int) $this->newPredecessor['lag'];
      
              $errors = app(DependencyValidator::class)

                  ->where('predecessor_id', $predecessor->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $successor->id)

                  'predecessor_id' => $predecessor->id,
                  'successor_id' => $successor->id,

              $task->update(['order' => $other->order]);
              $other->update(['order' => $order]);

              $this->priority = 'Medium';

              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];

          private function syncTaskType(Task $task): void
          {

              $type = match (true) {
                  $task->children()->exists() => 'Parent',
                  $task->duration === 0 => 'Milestone',
                  default => 'Task',
              };
      
              if ($task->task_type !== $type) {
                  $task->forceFill(['task_type' => $type])->saveQuietly();
              }
          }

          {
              foreach ($task->children as $child) {
                  $this->syncTaskType($child);
              }
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
              $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');
      
              $rows = [];
              $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walk(null, 0);
      
              $assignments = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->with('resource:id,name')
                  ->get()
                  ->groupBy('task_id');
      
              // ASN-3: warn when an assigned member is on leave or double-booked.
              $warnings = [];
              foreach ($rows as $row) {
                  $task = $row['task'];
      
                  if ($task->effective_start === null || $task->effective_end === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  foreach ($assignments[$task->id] ?? [] as $assignment) {
                      $resource = $assignment->resource;
      
                      if ($resource === null || $resource->trashed()) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $onLeave = $resource->leaves()
                          ->where('start_date', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->where('end_date', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($onLeave) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_leave', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
      
                      $overlapping = Assignment::query()
                          ->where('resource_id', $resource->id)
                          ->where('task_id', '!=', $task->id)
                          ->whereHas('task', static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                              $query->where('effective_start', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                                  ->where('effective_end', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'));
                          })
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($overlapping) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_overlap', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              $filtered = $this->memberFilter === null
                  ? $rows
                  : array_values(array_filter($rows, static fn (array $row): bool => $assignments[$row['task']->id]
                      ?->contains(static fn (Assignment $assignment): bool => $assignment->resource_id === $this->memberFilter) ?? false));
      
              $predecessors = $this->editingId === null
                  ? collect()
                  : Dependency::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                      ->with('predecessor:id,name')
                      ->get();
      
              return view('livewire.tasks.index', [
                  'rows' => $filtered,
                  'allTasks' => $tasks,
                  'resources' => $this->project->resources()->orderBy('name')->get(),
                  'assignments' => $assignments,
                  'warnings' => $warnings,
                  'predecessors' => $predecessors,
                  'parentCandidates' => $tasks
                      ->whereNull('parent_id')
                      ->reject(fn (Task $task): bool => $this->editingId !== null && $task->id === $this->editingId)
                      ->values(),
              ]);
          }

      namespace App\Livewire\Resources;

      /**

      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component

          public Project $project;

          public string $name = '';

          public string $email = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:50')]
          public string $phone = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:255')]
          public string $role = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|integer|min:0|max:1000000000000')]
          public ?int $salary = null;

          public string $leaveStart = '';

          public string $leaveEnd = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:255')]
          public string $leaveNote = '';
      
          public function toggleSalaryVisibility(): void
          {
              session()->put('hide_salary', ! session()->get('hide_salary', false));
          }
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $resource = $this->findResource($resourceId);
      
              $this->editingId = $resource->id;
              $this->name = $resource->name;
              $this->email = (string) $resource->email;
              $this->phone = (string) $resource->phone;
              $this->role = (string) $resource->role;
              $this->salary = $resource->salary; // decrypted by the cast on read (RES-4)
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate([
                  'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('resources', 'name')->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->ignore($this->editingId)],
              ]);
      
              $data = [
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'email' => $this->email ?: null,
                  'phone' => $this->phone ?: null,
                  'role' => $this->role ?: null,
                  'salary' => $this->salary,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $this->project->resources()->create($data);
              } else {
                  $this->findResource($this->editingId)->update($data);
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }

              $this->deleteTarget = $resourceId;

          {
              $this->deleteTarget = null;

                  ->findOrFail((int) $this->deleteTarget)

          }

              $this->reset(['editingId', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'salary']);
          }

                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($resourceId);
          }

              $resources = $this->project->resources()
                  ->with('leaves')
                  ->orderBy('name')
                  ->get();
      
              return view('livewire.resources.index', [

                  'salaryHidden' => (bool) session()->get('hide_salary', false),

                      ? collect()

                          ->groupBy('resource_id')
                          ->selectRaw('resource_id, count(*) as total')
                          ->pluck('total', 'resource_id'),
              ]);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Resources\Index as ResourcesIndex;
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
      
      // RES-1..RES-5 resource management requirements.
      
      it('creates and edits team members (RES-1)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Team project']);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Dewi Lestari')
              ->set('email', 'dewi@example.com')
              ->set('phone', '0812-0000-0000')
              ->set('role', 'Backend Developer')
              ->set('salary', 15000000)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $resource = Resource::first();
      
          expect($resource->name)->toBe('Dewi Lestari')
              ->and($resource->role)->toBe('Backend Developer');
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $resource->id)
              ->set('role', 'Tech Lead')
              ->call('save');
      
          expect($resource->fresh()->role)->toBe('Tech Lead');
      });
      
      it('stores salary encrypted, never in plaintext, and hidden from JSON (RES-4)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Salary project']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Secretive', 'salary' => 123456789]);
      
          // Encrypted at rest: the raw column value is ciphertext, not the number.
          $raw = DB::table('resources')->where('id', $resource->id)->value('salary');
          expect($raw)->not->toContain('123456789');
      
          // The model decrypts on read…
          expect($resource->fresh()->salary)->toBe(123456789);
      
          // …but salary never appears in JSON serialisations (hidden).
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->toArray()))->not->toContain('salary')
              ->and(json_encode($resource->fresh()->makeHidden([])->toArray()))->not->toContain('123456789');
      });
      
      it('warns before deleting a member who still has assignments (RES-2)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Warn project']);
          $task = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'T1', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Busy Person']);
          Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $resource->id]);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Assigned to 1 task');
      
          // Deleting is still possible (MVP has no hard block) — assignments cascade.
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $resource->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          expect(Resource::withTrashed()->find($resource->id)->trashed())->toBeTrue()
              ->and(Assignment::count())->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('records personal leave per member (RES-3)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Leave project']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Holiday Maker']);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('addLeave', $resource->id)
              ->set('leaveStart', '2026-03-15')
              ->set('leaveEnd', '2026-03-17')
              ->set('leaveNote', 'Conference')
              ->call('saveLeave')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $leave = $resource->leaves()->first();
      
          expect($leave->start_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-15')
              ->and($leave->end_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-17')
              ->and($leave->note)->toBe('Conference');
      });
      
      it('toggles salary visibility in views (RES-5)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Toggle project']);
          $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Shown', 'salary' => 5000000]);
      
          $component = Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('5,000,000')
              ->call('toggleSalaryVisibility');
      
          expect(session()->get('hide_salary'))->toBeTrue();
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertDontSee('5,000,000')
              ->assertSee('••••••');
      });

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Resources;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\ResourceLeave;
      use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * RES-1 (name/contact/role/salary), RES-2 (edit/delete with warning when the
       * member still has assignments), RES-3 (personal leave), RES-4 (salary stored
       * encrypted, hidden from JSON, never logged), RES-5 (hide salary toggle).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public bool $showModal = false;
      
          public ?int $editingId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $name = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|email|max:255')]
          public string $email = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:50')]
          public string $phone = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:255')]
          public string $role = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|integer|min:0|max:1000000000000')]
          public ?int $salary = null;
      
          // Leave form
          public ?int $leaveResourceId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|date')]
          public string $leaveStart = '';
      
          #[Validate('required|date|after_or_equal:leaveStart')]
          public string $leaveEnd = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:255')]
          public string $leaveNote = '';
      
          public function toggleSalaryVisibility(): void
          {
              session()->put('hide_salary', ! session()->get('hide_salary', false));
          }
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $resource = $this->findResource($resourceId);
      
              $this->editingId = $resource->id;
              $this->name = $resource->name;
              $this->email = (string) $resource->email;
              $this->phone = (string) $resource->phone;
              $this->role = (string) $resource->role;
              $this->salary = $resource->salary; // decrypted by the cast on read (RES-4)
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate([
                  'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('resources', 'name')->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->ignore($this->editingId)],
              ]);
      
              $data = [
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'email' => $this->email ?: null,
                  'phone' => $this->phone ?: null,
                  'role' => $this->role ?: null,
                  'salary' => $this->salary,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $this->project->resources()->create($data);
              } else {
                  $this->findResource($this->editingId)->update($data);
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }
      
          public ?int $deleteTarget = null;
      
          public function askDelete(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $this->editingId = null;
              $this->deleteTarget = $resourceId;
          }
      
          public function cancelDelete(): void
          {
              $this->deleteTarget = null;
          }
      
          public function delete(): void
          {
              Resource::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail((int) $this->deleteTarget)
                  ->delete();
      
              $this->deleteTarget = null;
          }
      
          public function addLeave(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $this->leaveResourceId = $resourceId;
              $this->reset(['leaveStart', 'leaveEnd', 'leaveNote']);
          }
      
          public function saveLeave(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              if ($this->leaveResourceId === null) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $resource = $this->findResource($this->leaveResourceId);
      
              $resource->leaves()->create([
                  'start_date' => $this->leaveStart,
                  'end_date' => $this->leaveEnd,
                  'note' => $this->leaveNote ?: null,
              ]);
      
              $this->reset(['leaveResourceId', 'leaveStart', 'leaveEnd', 'leaveNote']);
          }
      
          public function deleteLeave(int $leaveId): void
          {
              ResourceLeave::query()
                  ->whereHas('resource', fn ($query) => $query->where('project_id', $this->project->id))
                  ->findOrFail($leaveId)
                  ->delete();
          }
      
          public function cancelLeave(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['leaveResourceId', 'leaveStart', 'leaveEnd', 'leaveNote']);
          }
      
          private function resetForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['editingId', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'salary']);
          }
      
          private function findResource(int $resourceId): Resource
          {
              return Resource::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($resourceId);
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              $resources = $this->project->resources()
                  ->with('leaves')
                  ->orderBy('name')
                  ->get();
      
              return view('livewire.resources.index', [
                  'resources' => $resources,
                  'salaryHidden' => (bool) session()->get('hide_salary', false),
                  'assignmentCounts' => $resources->isEmpty()
                      ? collect()
                      : Assignment::query()
                          ->whereIn('resource_id', $resources->pluck('id'))
                          ->groupBy('resource_id')
                          ->selectRaw('resource_id, count(*) as total')
                          ->pluck('total', 'resource_id'),
              ]);
          }
      }
