  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Gantt;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Holiday;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * GNT-1..GNT-4 (P0): task list + bars on a timeline, dependency arrows,
       * weekend/holiday shading, day/week/month zoom, distinct parent/milestone
       * shapes and a today line. CPM-2: critical bars are highlighted (red + thicker
       * border + ⚠ marker — not colour alone, PRD §9 accessibility).
       *
       * Only layout geometry is computed here — every date comes from the persisted
       * engine output (build rule; D-24).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public string $zoom = 'day';
      
          public ?int $memberFilter = null;
      
          private const ROW_HEIGHT = 28;
      
          private const HEADER_HEIGHT = 34;
      
          public function mount(Project $project): void
          {
              $this->project = $project;
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
              $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');
      
              $rows = [];
              $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walk(null, 0);
      
              $assignments = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->with('resource:id,name')
                  ->get();
      
              if ($this->memberFilter !== null) {
                  $rows = array_values(array_filter(
                      $rows,
                      static fn (array $row): bool => $assignments
                          ->where('task_id', $row['task']->id)
                          ->contains('resource_id', $this->memberFilter),
                  ));
              }
      
              $dated = $tasks->filter(static fn (Task $task): bool => $task->effective_start !== null && $task->effective_end !== null);
      
              if ($dated->isEmpty()) {
                  return view('livewire.gantt.index', [
                      'rows' => $rows,
                      'barRows' => [],
                      'empty' => true,
                      'resources' => Resource::where('project_id', $this->project->id)->orderBy('name')->get(),
                  ]);
              }
      
              $start = $dated->min('effective_start')->startOfDay()->subDays(2);
              $end = $dated->max('effective_end')->startOfDay()->addDays(3);
      
              $dayWidth = match ($this->zoom) {
                  'week' => 8,
                  'month' => 4,
                  default => 26,
              };
      
              $totalDays = $start->diffInDays($end) + 1;
              $width = $totalDays * $dayWidth;
      
              // Timeline units for the header (GNT-3 zoom).
              $units = [];
              if ($this->zoom === 'day') {
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      $units[] = [
                          'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,
                          'w' => $dayWidth,
                          'label' => $date->format('j'),
                          'bold' => $date->format('j') === '1',
                          'nonworking' => ! $this->isWorking($date),
                      ];
                  }
              } elseif ($this->zoom === 'week') {
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addWeek()) {
                      $units[] = [
                          'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,
                          'w' => 7 * $dayWidth,
                          'label' => $date->format('d M'),
                          'bold' => false,
                          'nonworking' => false,
                      ];
                  }
              } else {
                  for ($date = $start->startOfMonth(); $date <= $end; $date = $date->addMonthNoOverflow()) {
                      $x = max(0, $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth);
                      $next = $date->addMonthNoOverflow();
                      $w = min($width - $x, $date->diffInDays($next) * $dayWidth);
                      $units[] = [
                          'x' => $x,
                          'w' => $w,
                          'label' => $date->format('M Y'),
                          'bold' => false,
                          'nonworking' => false,
                      ];
                  }
              }
      
              // Non-working day columns (weekends + holidays) for shading (GNT-2).
              $shaded = [];
              if ($this->zoom === 'day') {
                  $holidays = Holiday::query()
                      ->where('calendar_id', $this->project->calendar_id)
                      ->get()
                      ->flatMap(static function (Holiday $holiday): array {
                          $days = [];
                          $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();
                          $finish = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;
      
                          for ($date = $start; $date <= $finish; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                              $days[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');
                          }
      
                          return $days;
                      })
                      ->flip();
      
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      if ($this->isWorking($date)) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $shaded[] = [
                          'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,
                          'holiday' => isset($holidays[$date->format('Y-m-d')]),
                      ];
                  }
              }
      
              // Bars (x positions come from persisted engine dates only).
              $barRows = [];
              foreach ($rows as $index => $row) {
                  $task = $row['task'];
      
                  $bar = [
                      'y' => self::HEADER_HEIGHT + $index * self::ROW_HEIGHT,
                      'depth' => $row['depth'],
                      'task' => $task,
                      'assignees' => $assignments->where('task_id', $task->id)->pluck('resource.name')->filter()->implode(', '),
                      'warning' => $this->hasLeaveConflict($task),
                  ];
      
                  if ($task->effective_start !== null && $task->effective_end !== null) {
                      $x = max(0, $start->diffInDays($task->effective_start) * $dayWidth);
                      $spanDays = $task->effective_start->diffInDays($task->effective_end) + 1;
      
                      $bar['x'] = $x;
                      $bar['w'] = max($task->task_type === 'Milestone' ? 12 : 8, $spanDays * $dayWidth - 2);
                      $bar['isMilestone'] = $task->task_type === 'Milestone';
                  }
      
                  $barRows[] = $bar;
              }
      
              // Dependency arrows between bars (GNT-2).
              $indexByTask = [];
              foreach ($barRows as $index => $bar) {
                  $indexByTask[$bar['task']->id] = $index;
              }
      
              $arrows = [];
              foreach (Dependency::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->get() as $dependency) {
                  if (! isset($indexByTask[$dependency->predecessor_id], $indexByTask[$dependency->successor_id])) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $predecessor = $barRows[$indexByTask[$dependency->predecessor_id]];
                  $successor = $barRows[$indexByTask[$dependency->successor_id]];
      
                  if (! isset($predecessor['x'], $successor['x'])) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $x1 = $predecessor['x'] + $predecessor['w'];
                  $y1 = $predecessor['y'] + 13;
                  $x2 = $successor['x'];
                  $y2 = $successor['y'] + 13;
      
                  $arrows[] = ['d' => "M {$x1} {$y1} h 8 v " . ($y2 - $y1) . ' h ' . max(2, $x2 - $x1 - 10), 'end' => [$x2 - 4, $y2]];
              }
      
              // Today line (GNT-4).
              $today = CarbonImmutable::today();
              $todayX = ($today < $start || $today > $end) ? null : ($start->diffInDays($today) * $dayWidth) + ($dayWidth / 2);
      
              return view('livewire.gantt.index', [
                  'rows' => $rows,
                  'barRows' => $barRows,
                  'units' => $units,
                  'shaded' => $shaded,
                  'arrows' => array_values(array_filter($arrows, static fn ($arrow): bool => is_array($arrow))),
                  'height' => self::HEADER_HEIGHT + count($barRows) * self::ROW_HEIGHT + 10,
                  'width' => $width,
                  'dayWidth' => $dayWidth,
                  'todayX' => $todayX,
                  'empty' => false,
                  'resources' => Resource::where('project_id', $this->project->id)->orderBy('name')->get(),
              ]);
          }
      
          private function isWorking(CarbonImmutable $date): bool
          {
              $calendar = $this->project->calendar()->first();
      
              if ($calendar === null) {
                  return true;
              }
      
              if (! in_array((int) $date->format('N'), array_map('intval', $calendar->working_days ?? []), true)) {
                  return false;
              }
      
              return ! Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $calendar->id)
                  ->whereDate('date', '<=', $date->format('Y-m-d'))
                  ->where(function ($query) use ($date): void {
                      $query->whereDate('end_date', '>=', $date->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->orWhereNull('end_date');
                  })
                  ->exists();
          }
      
          private function hasLeaveConflict(Task $task): bool
          {
              if ($task->effective_start === null || $task->effective_end === null) {
                  return false;
              }
      
              return Assignment::query()
                  ->where('task_id', $task->id)
                  ->whereHas('resource', static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                      $query->whereHas('leaves', static fn ($leave) => $leave
                          ->where('start_date', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->where('end_date', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d')));
                  })
                  ->exists();
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Resources;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\ResourceLeave;
      use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * RES-1 (name/contact/role/salary), RES-2 (edit/delete with warning when the
       * member still has assignments), RES-3 (personal leave), RES-4 (salary stored
       * encrypted, hidden from JSON, never logged), RES-5 (hide salary toggle).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public bool $showModal = false;
      
          public ?int $editingId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $name = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|email|max:255')]
          public string $email = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:50')]
          public string $phone = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:255')]
          public string $role = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|integer|min:0|max:1000000000000')]
          public ?int $salary = null;
      
          // Leave form
          public ?int $leaveResourceId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|date')]
          public string $leaveStart = '';
      
          #[Validate('required|date|after_or_equal:leaveStart')]
          public string $leaveEnd = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:255')]
          public string $leaveNote = '';
      
          public function toggleSalaryVisibility(): void
          {
              session()->put('hide_salary', ! session()->get('hide_salary', false));
          }
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $resource = $this->findResource($resourceId);
      
              $this->editingId = $resource->id;
              $this->name = $resource->name;
              $this->email = (string) $resource->email;
              $this->phone = (string) $resource->phone;
              $this->role = (string) $resource->role;
              $this->salary = $resource->salary; // decrypted by the cast on read (RES-4)
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate([
                  'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('resources', 'name')->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->ignore($this->editingId)],
                  'email' => 'nullable|email|max:255',
                  'phone' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
                  'role' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
                  'salary' => 'nullable|integer|min:0|max:1000000000000',
              ]);
      
              $data = [
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'email' => $this->email ?: null,
                  'phone' => $this->phone ?: null,
                  'role' => $this->role ?: null,
                  'salary' => $this->salary,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $this->project->resources()->create($data);
              } else {
                  $this->findResource($this->editingId)->update($data);
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }
      
          public ?int $deleteTarget = null;
      
          public function askDelete(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $this->editingId = null;
              $this->deleteTarget = $resourceId;
          }
      
          public function cancelDelete(): void
          {
              $this->deleteTarget = null;
          }
      
          public function delete(): void
          {
              Resource::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail((int) $this->deleteTarget)
                  ->delete();
      
              $this->deleteTarget = null;
          }
      
          public function addLeave(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $this->leaveResourceId = $resourceId;
              $this->reset(['leaveStart', 'leaveEnd', 'leaveNote']);
          }
      
          public function saveLeave(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              if ($this->leaveResourceId === null) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $resource = $this->findResource($this->leaveResourceId);
      
              $resource->leaves()->create([
                  'start_date' => $this->leaveStart,
                  'end_date' => $this->leaveEnd,
                  'note' => $this->leaveNote ?: null,
              ]);
      
              $this->reset(['leaveResourceId', 'leaveStart', 'leaveEnd', 'leaveNote']);
          }
      
          public function deleteLeave(int $leaveId): void
          {
              ResourceLeave::query()
                  ->whereHas('resource', fn ($query) => $query->where('project_id', $this->project->id))
                  ->findOrFail($leaveId)
                  ->delete();
          }
      
          public function cancelLeave(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['leaveResourceId', 'leaveStart', 'leaveEnd', 'leaveNote']);
          }
      
          private function resetForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['editingId', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'salary']);
          }
      
          private function findResource(int $resourceId): Resource
          {
              return Resource::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($resourceId);
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              $resources = $this->project->resources()
                  ->with('leaves')
                  ->orderBy('name')
                  ->get();
      
              return view('livewire.resources.index', [
                  'resources' => $resources,
                  'salaryHidden' => (bool) session()->get('hide_salary', false),
                  'assignmentCounts' => $resources->isEmpty()
                      ? collect()
                      : Assignment::query()
                          ->whereIn('resource_id', $resources->pluck('id'))
                          ->groupBy('resource_id')
                          ->selectRaw('resource_id, count(*) as total')
                          ->pluck('total', 'resource_id'),
              ]);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Resources\Index as ResourcesIndex;
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
      
      // RES-1..RES-5 resource management requirements.
      
      it('creates and edits team members (RES-1)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Team project']);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Dewi Lestari')
              ->set('email', 'dewi@example.com')
              ->set('phone', '0812-0000-0000')
              ->set('role', 'Backend Developer')
              ->set('salary', 15000000)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $resource = Resource::first();
      
          expect($resource->name)->toBe('Dewi Lestari')
              ->and($resource->role)->toBe('Backend Developer');
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $resource->id)
              ->set('role', 'Tech Lead')
              ->call('save');
      
          expect($resource->fresh()->role)->toBe('Tech Lead');
      });
      
      it('stores salary encrypted, never in plaintext, and hidden from JSON (RES-4)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Salary project']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Secretive', 'salary' => 123456789]);
      
          // Encrypted at rest: the raw column value is ciphertext, not the number.
          $raw = DB::table('resources')->where('id', $resource->id)->value('salary');
          expect($raw)->not->toContain('123456789');
      
          // The model decrypts on read…
          expect($resource->fresh()->salary)->toBe(123456789);
      
          // …but salary never appears in JSON serialisations (hidden).
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->toArray()))->not->toContain('"salary"');
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->toArray()))->toContain('"salary":null');
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->makeHidden([])->toArray()))->not->toContain('123456789');
      });
      
      it('warns before deleting a member who still has assignments (RES-2)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Warn project']);
          $task = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'T1', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Busy Person']);
          Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $resource->id]);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Assigned to 1 task');
      
          // Deleting is still possible (MVP has no hard block) — the member is
          // soft-deleted, so their assignment becomes hidden but the row still
          // exists until cascade cleanup.
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $resource->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          expect(Resource::withTrashed()->find($resource->id)->trashed())->toBeTrue();
          expect(Assignment::where('resource_id', $resource->id)->whereNull('deleted_at')->count())->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('records personal leave per member (RES-3)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Leave project']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Holiday Maker']);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('addLeave', $resource->id)
              ->set('leaveStart', '2026-03-15')
              ->set('leaveEnd', '2026-03-17')
              ->set('leaveNote', 'Conference')
              ->call('saveLeave')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $leave = $resource->leaves()->first();
      
          expect($leave->start_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-15')
              ->and($leave->end_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-17')
              ->and($leave->note)->toBe('Conference');
      });
      
      it('toggles salary visibility in views (RES-5)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Toggle project']);
          $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Shown', 'salary' => 5000000]);
      
          $component = Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('5,000,000')
              ->call('toggleSalaryVisibility');
      
          expect(session()->get('hide_salary'))->toBeTrue();
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertDontSee('5,000,000')
              ->assertSee('••••••');
      });

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Resources\Index as ResourcesIndex;
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
      
      // RES-1..RES-5 resource management requirements.
      
      it('creates and edits team members (RES-1)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Team project']);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Dewi Lestari')
              ->set('email', 'dewi@example.com')
              ->set('phone', '0812-0000-0000')
              ->set('role', 'Backend Developer')
              ->set('salary', 15000000)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $resource = Resource::first();
      
          expect($resource->name)->toBe('Dewi Lestari')
              ->and($resource->role)->toBe('Backend Developer');
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $resource->id)
              ->set('role', 'Tech Lead')
              ->call('save');
      
          expect($resource->fresh()->role)->toBe('Tech Lead');
      });
      
      it('stores salary encrypted, never in plaintext, and hidden from JSON (RES-4)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Salary project']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Secretive', 'salary' => 123456789]);
      
          // Encrypted at rest: the raw column value is ciphertext, not the number.
          $raw = DB::table('resources')->where('id', $resource->id)->value('salary');
          expect($raw)->not->toContain('123456789');
      
          // The model decrypts on read…
          expect($resource->fresh()->salary)->toBe(123456789);
      
          // …but salary never appears in JSON serialisations (hidden).
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->toArray()))->not->toContain('"salary"');
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->toArray()))->toContain('"salary":null');
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->makeHidden([])->toArray()))->not->toContain('123456789');
      });
      
      it('warns before deleting a member who still has assignments (RES-2)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Warn project']);
          $task = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'T1', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Busy Person']);
          Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $resource->id]);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Assigned to 1 task');
      
          // Deleting is still possible (MVP has no hard block) — the member is
          // soft-deleted, so their assignment becomes hidden but the row still
          // exists until cascade cleanup.
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $resource->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          expect(Resource::withTrashed()->find($resource->id)->trashed())->toBeTrue();
          expect(Assignment::where('resource_id', $resource->id)->whereNull('deleted_at')->count())->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('records personal leave per member (RES-3)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Leave project']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Holiday Maker']);
      
          $component = Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project]);
      
          $component
              ->call('openLeaveForm', $resource->id)
              ->set('leaveState.start', '2026-03-15')
              ->set('leaveState.end', '2026-03-17')
              ->set('leaveState.note', 'Conference')
              ->call('saveLeave')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $leave = $resource->fresh()->leaves()->first();
      
          $leave = $resource->fresh()->leaves()->first();
      
          expect($leave->start_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-15')
              ->and($leave->end_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-17')
              ->and($leave->note)->toBe('Conference');
      });
      
      it('toggles salary visibility in views (RES-5)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Toggle project']);
          $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Shown', 'salary' => 5000000]);
      
          $component = Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('5,000,000')
              ->call('toggleSalaryVisibility');
      
          expect(session()->get('hide_salary'))->toBeTrue();
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertDontSee('5,000,000')
              ->assertSee('••••••');
      });
      
  referencedBy: {}

      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
      
      class Assignment extends Model
      {
          use HasFactory;
          use SoftDeletes;
      
          protected $fillable = [
              'project_id',
              'task_id',
              'resource_id',
              'role',
          ];
      
          protected $hidden = [
              'project_id',
              'task_id',
              'resource_id',
          ];
      
          public function project(): BelongsTo
          {
              return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
          }
      
          public function task(): BelongsTo
          {
              return $this->belongsTo(Task::class);
          }
      
          public function resource(): BelongsTo
          {
              return $this->belongsTo(Resource::class);
          }

      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
      
      // RES-1..RES-5 resource management requirements.
      
      it('creates and edits team members (RES-1)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Team project']);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('name', 'Dewi Lestari')
              ->set('email', 'dewi@example.com')
              ->set('phone', '0812-0000-0000')
              ->set('role', 'Backend Developer')
              ->set('salary', 15000000)
              ->call('save')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $resource = Resource::first();
      
          expect($resource->name)->toBe('Dewi Lestari')
              ->and($resource->role)->toBe('Backend Developer');
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $resource->id)
              ->set('role', 'Tech Lead')
              ->call('save');
      
          expect($resource->fresh()->role)->toBe('Tech Lead');
      });
      
      it('stores salary encrypted, never in plaintext, and hidden from JSON (RES-4)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Salary project']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Secretive', 'salary' => 123456789]);
      
          // Encrypted at rest: the raw column value is ciphertext, not the number.
          $raw = DB::table('resources')->where('id', $resource->id)->value('salary');
          expect($raw)->not->toContain('123456789');
      
          // The model decrypts on read…
          expect($resource->fresh()->salary)->toBe(123456789);
      
          // …but salary never appears in JSON serialisations (hidden).
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->toArray()))->not->toContain('"salary"');
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->toArray()))->toContain('"salary":null');
          expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->makeHidden([])->toArray()))->not->toContain('123456789');
      });
      
      it('warns before deleting a member who still has assignments (RES-2)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Warn project']);
          $task = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'T1', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Busy Person']);
          Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $resource->id]);
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Assigned to 1 task');
      
          // Deleting is still possible (MVP has no hard block) — the member is
          // soft-deleted, so their assignment becomes hidden but the row still
          // exists until cascade cleanup.
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('askDelete', $resource->id)
              ->call('delete');
      
          expect(Resource::withTrashed()->find($resource->id)->trashed())->toBeTrue();
          expect(Assignment::where('resource_id', $resource->id)->whereNull('deleted_at')->count())->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('records personal leave per member (RES-3)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Leave project']);
          $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Holiday Maker']);
      
          $component = Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project]);
      
          $component
              ->call('openLeaveForm', $resource->id)
              ->set('leaveState.start', '2026-03-15')
              ->set('leaveState.end', '2026-03-17')
              ->set('leaveState.note', 'Conference')
              ->call('saveLeave')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $leave = $resource->fresh()->leaves()->first();
      
          expect($leave->start_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-15')
              ->and($leave->end_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-17')
              ->and($leave->note)->toBe('Conference');
      });
      
      it('toggles salary visibility in views (RES-5)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Toggle project']);
          $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Shown', 'salary' => 5000000]);
      
          $component = Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('5,000,000')
              ->call('toggleSalaryVisibility');
      
          expect(session()->get('hide_salary'))->toBeTrue();
      
          Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertDontSee('5,000,000')
              ->assertSee('••••••');
      });
      
  referencedBy: {}

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Models;
      
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
      
      class Resource extends Model
      {
          use HasFactory;
          use SoftDeletes;
      
          protected static function boot(): void
          {
              parent::boot();
      
              static::deleting(function (self $model): void {
                  // Soft-delete every assignment that points to this resource.
                  // The resource itself is being soft-deleted, so we hide its
                  // assignments too — the test expects Assignment::where(...id)
                  // to return 0 rows after the resource is gone.
                  $model->assignments()->delete();
              });
          }
      
          protected static function boot(): void
          {
              parent::boot();
      
              static::deleting(function (self $model): void {
                  // Soft-delete every assignment that points to this resource.
                  // The resource itself is being soft-deleted, so we hide its
                  // assignments too.
                  $model->assignments()->delete();
              });
          }
      
          protected $fillable = [
              'project_id',
              'name',
              'email',
              'phone',
              'role',
              'salary',
          ];
      
          protected $casts = [
              'salary' => 'encrypted:integer',
              'project_id' => 'integer',
          ];
      
          protected $hidden = [
              'salary',
              'project_id',
          ];
      
          public function project(): BelongsTo
          {
              return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
          }
      
          public function assignments(): HasMany
          {
              return $this->hasMany(Assignment::class);
          }
      
          public function leaves(): HasMany
          {
              return $this->hasMany(ResourceLeave::class);
          }
      }

      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * GNT-1..GNT-4 (P0): task list + bars on a timeline, dependency arrows,
       * weekend/holiday shading, day/week/month zoom, distinct parent/milestone
       * shapes and a today line. CPM-2: critical bars are highlighted (red + thicker
       * border + ⚠ marker — not colour alone, PRD §9 accessibility).
       *
       * Only layout geometry is computed here — every date comes from the persisted
       * engine output (build rule; D-24).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public string $zoom = 'day';
      
          public ?int $memberFilter = null;
      
          private const ROW_HEIGHT = 28;
      
          private const HEADER_HEIGHT = 34;
      
          public function mount(Project $project): void
          {
              $this->project = $project;
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
              $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');
      
              $rows = [];
              $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walk(null, 0);
      
              $assignments = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->with('resource:id,name')
                  ->get();
      
              if ($this->memberFilter !== null) {
                  $rows = array_values(array_filter(
                      $rows,
                      static fn (array $row): bool => $assignments
                          ->where('task_id', $row['task']->id)
                          ->contains('resource_id', $this->memberFilter),
                  ));
              }
      
              $dated = $tasks->filter(static fn (Task $task): bool => $task->effective_start !== null && $task->effective_end !== null);
      
              if ($dated->isEmpty()) {
                  return view('livewire.gantt.index', [
                      'rows' => $rows,
                      'barRows' => [],
                      'empty' => true,
                      'resources' => Resource::where('project_id', $this->project->id)->orderBy('name')->get(),
                  ]);
              }
      
              $start = $dated->min('effective_start')->startOfDay()->subDays(2);
              $end = $dated->max('effective_end')->startOfDay()->addDays(3);
      
              $dayWidth = match ($this->zoom) {
                  'week' => 8,
                  'month' => 4,
                  default => 26,
              };
      
              $totalDays = $start->diffInDays($end) + 1;
              $width = $totalDays * $dayWidth;
      
              // Timeline units for the header (GNT-3 zoom).
              $units = [];
              if ($this->zoom === 'day') {
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      $units[] = [
                          'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,
                          'w' => $dayWidth,
                          'label' => $date->format('j'),
                          'bold' => $date->format('j') === '1',
                          'nonworking' => ! $this->isWorking($date),
                      ];
                  }
              } elseif ($this->zoom === 'week') {
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addWeek()) {
                      $units[] = [
                          'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,
                          'w' => 7 * $dayWidth,
                          'label' => $date->format('d M'),
                          'bold' => false,
                          'nonworking' => false,
                      ];
                  }
              } else {
                  for ($date = $start->startOfMonth(); $date <= $end; $date = $date->addMonthNoOverflow()) {
                      $x = max(0, $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth);
                      $next = $date->addMonthNoOverflow();
                      $w = min($width - $x, $date->diffInDays($next) * $dayWidth);
                      $units[] = [
                          'x' => $x,
                          'w' => $w,
                          'label' => $date->format('M Y'),
                          'bold' => false,
                          'nonworking' => false,
                      ];
                  }
              }
      
              // Non-working day columns (weekends + holidays) for shading (GNT-2).
              $shaded = [];
              if ($this->zoom === 'day') {
                  $holidays = Holiday::query()
                      ->where('calendar_id', $this->project->calendar_id)
                      ->get()
                      ->flatMap(static function (Holiday $holiday): array {
                          $days = [];
                          $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();
                          $finish = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;
      
                          for ($date = $start; $date <= $finish; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                              $days[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');
                          }
      
                          return $days;
                      })
                      ->flip();
      
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      if ($this->isWorking($date)) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $shaded[] = [
                          'x' => $start->diffInDays($date) * $dayWidth,
                          'holiday' => isset($holidays[$date->format('Y-m-d')]),
                      ];
                  }
              }
      
              // Bars (x positions come from persisted engine dates only).
              $barRows = [];
              foreach ($rows as $index => $row) {
                  $task = $row['task'];
      
                  $bar = [
                      'y' => self::HEADER_HEIGHT + $index * self::ROW_HEIGHT,
                      'depth' => $row['depth'],
                      'task' => $task,
                      'assignees' => $assignments->where('task_id', $task->id)->pluck('resource.name')->filter()->implode(', '),
                      'warning' => $this->hasLeaveConflict($task),
                  ];
      
                  if ($task->effective_start !== null && $task->effective_end !== null) {
                      $x = max(0, $start->diffInDays($task->effective_start) * $dayWidth);
                      $spanDays = $task->effective_start->diffInDays($task->effective_end) + 1;
      
                      $bar['x'] = $x;
                      $bar['w'] = max($task->task_type === 'Milestone' ? 12 : 8, $spanDays * $dayWidth - 2);
                      $bar['isMilestone'] = $task->task_type === 'Milestone';
                  }
      
                  $barRows[] = $bar;
              }
      
              // Dependency arrows between bars (GNT-2).
              $indexByTask = [];
              foreach ($barRows as $index => $bar) {
                  $indexByTask[$bar['task']->id] = $index;
              }
      
              $arrows = [];
              foreach (Dependency::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->get() as $dependency) {
                  if (! isset($indexByTask[$dependency->predecessor_id], $indexByTask[$dependency->successor_id])) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $predecessor = $barRows[$indexByTask[$dependency->predecessor_id]];
                  $successor = $barRows[$indexByTask[$dependency->successor_id]];
      
                  if (! isset($predecessor['x'], $successor['x'])) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $x1 = $predecessor['x'] + $predecessor['w'];
                  $y1 = $predecessor['y'] + 13;
                  $x2 = $successor['x'];
                  $y2 = $successor['y'] + 13;
      
                  $arrows[] = ['d' => "M {$x1} {$y1} h 8 v " . ($y2 - $y1) . ' h ' . max(2, $x2 - $x1 - 10), 'end' => [$x2 - 4, $y2]];
              }
      
              // Today line (GNT-4).
              $today = CarbonImmutable::today()->startOfDay();
              $todayX = ($today < $start || $today > $end) ? null : ($start->diffInDays($today) * $dayWidth) + ($dayWidth / 2);
      
              return view('livewire.gantt.index', [
                  'rows' => $rows,
                  'barRows' => $barRows,
                  'units' => $units,
                  'shaded' => $shaded,
                  'arrows' => array_values(array_filter($arrows, static fn ($arrow): bool => is_array($arrow))),
                  'height' => self::HEADER_HEIGHT + count($barRows) * self::ROW_HEIGHT + 10,
                  'width' => $width,
                  'dayWidth' => $dayWidth,
                  'todayX' => $todayX,
                  'empty' => false,
                  'resources' => Resource::where('project_id', $this->project->id)->orderBy('name')->get(),
              ]);
          }
      
          private function isWorking(CarbonImmutable $date): bool
          {
              $calendar = $this->project->calendar()->first();
      
              if ($calendar === null) {
                  return true;
              }
      
              if (! in_array((int) $date->format('N'), array_map('intval', $calendar->working_days ?? []), true)) {
                  return false;
              }
      
              return ! Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $calendar->id)
                  ->whereDate('date', '<=', $date->toImmutable()->format('Y-m-d'))
                  ->where(function ($query) use ($date): void {
                      $query->whereDate('end_date', '>=', $date->toImmutable()->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->orWhereNull('end_date');
                  })
                  ->exists();
          }
      
          private function hasLeaveConflict(Task $task): bool
          {
              if ($task->effective_start === null || $task->effective_end === null) {
                  return false;
              }
      
              return Assignment::query()
                  ->where('task_id', $task->id)
                  ->whereHas('resource', static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                      $query->whereHas('leaves', static fn ($leave) => $leave
                          ->where('start_date', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->where('end_date', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d')));
                  })
                  ->exists();
          }
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Calendar;
      
      use App\Models\Calendar;
      use App\Models\Holiday;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Support\IndonesianHolidayTemplate;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * CAL-1 (working days + hours), CAL-2 (weekends excluded — derived from
       * working days), CAL-3 (custom holidays with optional range), CAL-4 (Indonesian
       * holiday template import). Any change triggers recalculation via the observer
       * (CAL-5).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public Calendar $calendar;
      
          /** @var list<int> */
          #[Validate('required|array|min:1')]
          public array $workingDays = [];
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:1|max:24')]
          public int $hoursPerDay = 8;
      
          // Holiday form
          public ?int $holidayId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $holidayName = '';
      
          #[Validate('required|date')]
          public string $holidayDate = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|date|after_or_equal:holidayDate')]
          public string $holidayEndDate = '';
      
          // CAL-4 import
          public int $importYear;
      
          public function mount(Project $project): void
          {
              $this->project = $project;
              $this->calendar = $project->calendar()->firstOrFail();
              $this->workingDays = array_map('intval', $this->calendar->working_days ?? []);
              $this->hoursPerDay = (int) $this->calendar->working_hours_per_day;
              $this->importYear = now()->year;
          }
      
          public function saveCalendar(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              $workingDays = collect($this->workingDays)->unique()->sort()->values();
      
              $this->calendar->update([
                  'working_days' => $workingDays->all(),
                  'weekend_days' => array_values(array_diff([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], $workingDays->all())),
                  'working_hours_per_day' => $this->hoursPerDay,
              ]);
          }
      
          public function saveHoliday(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              $data = [
                  'name' => $this->holidayName,
                  'date' => $this->holidayDate,
                  'end_date' => $this->holidayEndDate ?: null,
              ];
      
              if ($this->holidayId === null) {
                  $this->calendar->holidays()->create($data);
              } else {
                  Holiday::query()
                      ->where('calendar_id', $this->calendar->id)
                      ->findOrFail($this->holidayId)
                      ->update($data);
              }
      
              $this->resetHolidayForm();
          }
      
          public function editHoliday(int $holidayId): void
          {
              $holiday = Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $this->calendar->id)
                  ->findOrFail($holidayId);
      
              $this->holidayId = $holiday->id;
              $this->holidayName = $holiday->name;
              $this->holidayDate = $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d');
              $this->holidayEndDate = $holiday->end_date?->format('Y-m-d') ?? '';
          }
      
          public function deleteHoliday(int $holidayId): void
          {
              Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $this->calendar->id)
                  ->findOrFail($holidayId)
                  ->delete();
      
              if ($this->holidayId === $holidayId) {
                  $this->resetHolidayForm();
              }
          }
      
          public function cancelHoliday(): void
          {
              $this->resetHolidayForm();
          }
      
          /**
           * CAL-4: import the curated Indonesian national holiday template.
           */
          public function importTemplate(): void
          {
              $existing = $this->calendar->holidays()
                  ->get()
                  ->map(static fn (Holiday $holiday): string => $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d'))
                  ->all();
      
              foreach (IndonesianHolidayTemplate::forYear($this->importYear) as $holiday) {
                  if (in_array($holiday['date'], $existing, true)) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $this->calendar->holidays()->create([
                      'name' => $holiday['name'],
                      'date' => $holiday['date'],
                  ]);
      
                  $existing[] = $holiday['date'];
              }
          }
      
          private function resetHolidayForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['holidayId', 'holidayName', 'holidayDate', 'holidayEndDate']);
          }
      
          /** @return array<string, string> */
          protected function rules(): array
          {
              return [
                  'workingDays' => 'required|array|min:1',
                  'workingDays.*' => 'integer|in:1,2,3,4,5,6,7',
                  'hoursPerDay' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:24',
                  'holidayName' => 'required|string|max:255',
                  'holidayDate' => 'required|date',
                  'holidayEndDate' => 'nullable|date|after_or_equal:holidayDate',
              ];
          }

                  ],
                  'holidays' => $this->calendar->holidays()->orderBy('date')->get(),
                  'weekendDays' => array_values(array_diff([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], $this->workingDays)),
                  'importYears' => IndonesianHolidayTemplate::availableYears(),
              ]);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Calendar\Index as CalendarIndex;
      use App\Models\Holiday;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      // CAL-1..CAL-5 working calendar requirements.
      
      function makeProjectWithTask(): Project
      {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Cal project']);
      
          Task::create([
              'project_id' => $project->id,
              'name' => 'First task',
              'start_input' => '2026-01-05', // Monday
              'duration' => 5,
              'order' => 0,
          ]);
      
          Task::create([
              'project_id' => $project->id,
              'name' => 'Second task',
              'duration' => 3,
              'order' => 1,
          ]);
      
          Task::query()
              ->where('project_id', $project->id)
              ->where('name', 'First task')
              ->first()
              ->dependencies()
              ->create([
                  'project_id' => $project->id,
                  'successor_id' => Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->where('name', 'Second task')->value('id'),
                  'type' => 'FS',
                  'lag' => 0,
              ]);
      
          return $project->fresh();
      }
      
      it('saves working days and hours and derives weekend days (CAL-1/CAL-2)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Six day week']);
      
          Livewire::test(CalendarIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('workingDays', [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])
              ->set('hoursPerDay', 6)
              ->call('saveCalendar')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $calendar = $project->calendar()->first();
      
          expect($calendar->working_days)->toBe([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])
              ->and($calendar->weekend_days)->toBe([7])
              ->and($calendar->working_hours_per_day)->toBe(6);
      });
      
      it('requires at least one working day (CAL-1)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'No work']);
      
          Livewire::test(CalendarIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('workingDays', [])
              ->call('saveCalendar')
              ->assertHasErrors(['workingDays']);
      });
      
      it('adds, edits and deletes holidays (CAL-3)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Holidays']);
      
          $component = Livewire::test(CalendarIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('holidayName', 'Independence Day')
              ->set('holidayDate', '2026-08-17')
              ->call('saveHoliday')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          $holiday = Holiday::first();
          expect($holiday->name)->toBe('Independence Day')
              ->and($holiday->date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-08-17');
      
          $component
              ->call('editHoliday', $holiday->id)
              ->set('holidayName', 'Independence Day (observed)')
              ->set('holidayEndDate', '2026-08-18')
              ->call('saveHoliday');
      
          expect($holiday->fresh()->name)->toBe('Independence Day (observed)')
              ->and($holiday->fresh()->end_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-08-18');
      
          $component->call('deleteHoliday', $holiday->id);
          expect(Holiday::count())->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('shifts a task and its successors when a holiday lands inside the task (CAL-5 AC)', function () {
          $project = makeProjectWithTask();
      
          // Before: First task Jan 5–9 (5wd), Second task starts Mon Jan 12.
          expect(Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->where('name', 'First task')->value('effective_end'))->toBe('2026-01-09')
              ->and(Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->where('name', 'Second task')->value('effective_start'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      
          // Add a holiday in the middle of the task (Wed Jan 7).
          Livewire::test(CalendarIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('holidayName', 'Mid-week holiday')
              ->set('holidayDate', '2026-01-07')
              ->call('saveHoliday');
      
          // Task now ends Jan 12 and its successor shifts to Jan 13.
          expect(Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->where('name', 'First task')->value('effective_end'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and(Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->where('name', 'Second task')->value('effective_start'))->toBe('2026-01-13');
      });
      
      it('imports the Indonesian national holiday template without duplicates (CAL-4)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Cuti nasional']);
      
          Livewire::test(CalendarIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('importYear', 2026)
              ->call('importTemplate');
      
          $count = Holiday::where('calendar_id', $project->calendar()->first()->id)->count();
          expect($count)->toBeGreaterThan(3)
              ->and(Holiday::where('date', '2026-08-17')->exists())->toBeTrue(); // Independence Day
      
          // Importing again must not duplicate (same names/dates are skipped by date).
          Livewire::test(CalendarIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->set('importYear', 2026)
              ->call('importTemplate');
      
          expect(Holiday::where('calendar_id', $project->calendar()->first()->id)->count())->toBe($count);
      });

## What's missing and how to get it

**`intl` is not enabled.** The `intl` extension (ICU) is required for many Laravel features, including:
- Localization / translators and `trans_choice`
- `NumberFormatter`, `MessageFormatter`, `DateFormatter` (used by Laravel's Intl-based validation/serialization)
- Some packages such as `moontoast/math` (used by Laravel) and `symfony/intl`

It is **not** a Laravel version problem — PHP 8.5.10 and Composer 2.10.3 are fine for the current Laravel. The only blocker is the missing `intl` extension.

### How to install `intl` on your system

You're on Windows with XAMPP (`C:\xampp\php`). The easiest way is to add the `php_intl.dll` extension and its ICU dependency:

1. **Check your PHP version and thread-safety/arch:**
   ```bash
   php -v
   ```
   You already have `PHP 8.5.10` (ZTS Visual C++ 2022 x64), so you need the **8.5** VC17 (VS 2022) x64 non-NTS or appropriate build.

2. **Download the `php_intl.dll` for PHP 8.5 (VC17 x64)** from a trusted PHP DLL repository, e.g.:
   - https://windows.php.net/download/#php-8.5
   - Or use the Pandawa/PECL-style builds if you prefer pre-built extensions.

3. **Place the DLL** in your XAMPP extension folder:
   ```
   C:\xampp\php\ext\php_intl.dll
   ```

4. **Enable it** in your `php.ini`:
   ```ini
   extension=php_intl.dll
   ```

5. **Ensure the ICU DLL is available.** The `php_intl.dll` depends on `icu*.dll`. These are usually bundled in the same download package — place them in `C:\xampp\php` (or add that path to your system `PATH`).

6. **Restart your web server** (Apache) and verify:
   ```bash
   php -m | grep -i intl
   ```
   You should see `intl` listed.

### Alternative (if you can use a different PHP build)

If you prefer not to manage DLLs, install a PHP 8.5 build that includes `intl` by default, such as:
- **XAMPP** (their Windows builds bundle `intl` for many versions)
- **Laravel Sail / Docker** (uses `php:8.3-cli` or newer, which always has `intl`)
- **Windows PHP binaries** from `windows.php.net` (choose the one with `intl` included)

> **Note:** `pdo_sqlite` is loaded, but your app's `composer.json` likely requires `pdo_mysql` for production. If you're deploying to a hosted environment, make sure `pdo_mysql` is active there as well.

## Is PHP too old for current Laravel?

**No.** PHP 8.5.10 is well within the current Laravel requirements (Laravel 11/12 supports PHP 8.2+). Your PHP and Composer are sufficient; you only need to enable the `intl` extension (and probably `pdo_mysql` if it's not active in your web server config).

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Models\Project;
      
      // PRD §9: Indonesian and English interface (D-21).
      
      it('renders the UI in English by default', function () {
          Project::create(['name' => 'Locale project']);
      
          $this->get(route('home'))
              ->assertOk()
              ->assertSee('Projects');

      it('renders the UI in Indonesian after switching the language', function () {

          $this->get(route('lang.switch', 'id'))->assertRedirect();

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * UI language switcher (PRD §9: English and Indonesian interface, D-21).
 */
class LanguageController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(Request $request, string $locale): RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! in_array($locale, ['en', 'id'], true)) {
            abort(404);
        }

        $request->session()->put('locale', $locale);

        return back();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Livewire\Projects;

use App\Models\Project;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * PRJ-1 (create with name/organization/description) and PRJ-2 (list, open,
 * edit link, delete with confirmation).
 */
#[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
class Index extends Component
{
    #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
    public string $name = '';

    #[Validate('nullable|string|max:255')]
    public string $organization = '';

    #[Validate('nullable|string|max:2000')]
    public string $description = '';

    public bool $showCreate = false;

    public ?int $deleteId = null;

    public function create(): void
    {
        $this->validate();

        $project = Project::create([
            'name' => $this->name,
            'organization' => $this->organization ?: null,
            'description' => $this->description ?: null,
        ]);

        $this->reset(['name', 'organization', 'description', 'showCreate']);

        $this->redirectRoute('projects.show', $project);
    }

    public function askDelete(int $projectId): void
    {
        $this->deleteId = $projectId;
    }

    public function cancelDelete(): void
    {
        $this->deleteId = null;
    }

    public function delete(): void
    {
        Project::findOrFail($this->deleteId)->delete();
        $this->deleteId = null;
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.projects.index', [
            'projects' => Project::query()->withCount(['tasks', 'resources'])->latest()->get(),
        ]);
    }
}
---Projects/Show---
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Livewire\Projects;

use App\Models\Project;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * Project overview: counts, calculated project end date and total duration
 * (CPM-4), and the list of critical tasks (CPM-2).
 */
#[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
class Show extends Component
{
    public Project $project;

    public function render()
    {
        $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();

        return view('livewire.projects.show', [
            'taskCount' => $tasks->count(),
            'resourceCount' => $this->project->resources()->count(),
            'dependencyCount' => $this->project->dependencies()->count(),
            'totalDuration' => (int) $this->project->total_duration,
            'criticalTasks' => $tasks->where('is_critical', true)->values(),
        ]);
    }
}

'<?php

namespace Illuminate\\Foundation\\Bootstrap;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\\Config\\Repository;
use Illuminate\\Contracts\\Config\\Repository as RepositoryContract;
use Illuminate\\Contracts\\Foundation\\Application;
use Illuminate\\Support\\Collection;
use SplFileInfo;
use Symfony\\Component\\Finder\\Finder;

class LoadConfiguration
{
    /**
     * The closure that resolves the permanent, static configuration if applicable.
     *
     * @var (Closure(Application): array<array-key, mixed>)|null
     */
    protected static ?Closure $alwaysUseConfig = null;

    /**
     * Bootstrap the given application.
     *
     * @param  \\Illuminate\\Contracts\\Foundation\\Application  $app
     * @return void
     */
    public function bootstrap(Application $app)
    {
        $items = [];

        // First we will see if we have a cache configuration file. If we do, we\'ll load
        // the configuration items from that file so that it is very quick. Otherwise
        // we will need to spin through every configuration file and load them all.
        $loadedFromCache = false;

        if (static::$alwaysUseConfig !== null) {
            $items = $app->call(self::$alwaysUseConfig);

            $loadedFromCache = true;
        } elseif (file_exists($cached = $app->getCachedConfigPath())) {
            $items = require $cached;

            $loadedFromCache = true;
        }

        $app->instance(\'config_loaded_from_cache\', $loadedFromCache);

        // Next we will spin through all of the configuration files in the configuration
        // directory and load each one into the repository. This will make all of the
        // options available to the developer for use in various parts of this app.
        $app->instance(\'config\', $config = new Repository($items));

        if (! $loadedFromCache) {
            $this->loadConfigurationFiles($app, $config);
        }

        // Finally, we will set the application\'s environment based on the configuration
        // values that were loaded. We will pass a callback which will be used to get
        // the environment in a web context where an "--env" switch is not present.

use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * UI language switcher (PRD §9: English and Indonesian interface, D-21).
 */
class LanguageController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(Request $request, string $locale): RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! in_array($locale, ['en', 'id'], true)) {
            abort(404);
        }

        $request->session()->put('locale', $locale);

        return back();
    }
}

namespace App\Providers;

use App\Models\Calendar;
use App\Models\Dependency;
use App\Models\Holiday;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\Task;
use App\Observers\ProjectObserver;
use App\Observers\ScheduleObserver;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;

class AppServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    /**
     * Register any application services.
     */
    public function register(): void
    {
        //
    }

    /**
     * Bootstrap any application services.
     */
    public function boot(): void
    {
        // UI language: English + Indonesian (PRD §9, D-21).
        app()->setLocale(session('locale', config('app.locale')));

        // Scheduling data changes always trigger a full recalculation (PRD CAL-5, CPM-6).
        Project::observe(ProjectObserver::class);

        $scheduleObserver = ScheduleObserver::class;
        Task::observe($scheduleObserver);
        Dependency::observe($scheduleObserver);
        Calendar::observe($scheduleObserver);
        Holiday::observe($scheduleObserver);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

class Project extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;
    use SoftDeletes;

    protected $fillable = [
        'name',
        'organization',
        'description',
        'calendar_id',
        'started_at',
        'completed_at',
        'total_duration',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'started_at' => 'datetime',
        'completed_at' => 'datetime',
        'total_duration' => 'integer',
    ];

    protected $hidden = [
        'calendar_id',
    ];

    public function calendar(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Calendar::class);
    }

    public function tasks(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Task::class);
    }

    public function resources(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Resource::class);
    }

    public function dependencies(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Dependency::class);
    }

    public function assignments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Assignment::class);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\Calendar;
use App\Models\Project;

/**
 * PRJ-1 acceptance criteria: creating a project automatically creates its
 * default calendar (Mon–Fri, 8 hours/day — CAL-1 [A] defaults).
 */
final class ProjectObserver
{
    public function created(Project $project): void
    {
        if ($project->calendar_id !== null) {
            return;
        }

        $calendar = Calendar::create([
            'project_id' => $project->id,
            'name' => 'Default Calendar',
            'working_days' => [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
            'weekend_days' => [6, 7],
            'working_hours_per_day' => 8,
            'holidays' => [],
        ]);

        $project->forceFill(['calendar_id' => $calendar->id])->saveQuietly();
    }
}
---ScheduleObserver---
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Observers;

use App\Models\Calendar;
use App\Models\Dependency;
use App\Models\Holiday;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\Task;
use App\Services\Schedule\ScheduleRecalculator;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * Any change to scheduling data recalculates the whole project schedule
 * (PRD CAL-5, CPM-6, §8.6).
 *
 * Recalculated fields are written with saveQuietly(), so no recursion occurs.
 */
final class ScheduleObserver
{
    public function __construct(private readonly ScheduleRecalculator $recalculator) {}

    public function saved(Model $model): void
    {
        $this->recalculateFor($model);
    }

    public function deleted(Model $model): void
    {
        $this->recalculateFor($model);
    }

    private function recalculateFor(Model $model): void
    {
        $projectId = match (true) {
            $model instanceof Task => $model->project_id,
            $model instanceof Dependency => $model->project_id,
            $model instanceof Calendar => $model->project_id,
            $model instanceof Holiday => $model->calendar()->value('project_id'),
            default => null,
        };

        if ($projectId === null) {
            return;
        }

        $project = Project::query()->find($projectId);

        if ($project === null) {
            return;
        }

        $this->recalculator->recalculate($project);
    }
}

    // Walk own enumerable keys so JSON.stringify cannot auto-invoke a proxy fake toJSON (e.g. Livewire's `$wire`) and fire a real request.\n
    function toSafeValue(value, seen) {\n
        if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') {\n
            return value;\n
        }\n
        if (value instanceof Error) {\n
            return { name: value.name, message: value.message, stack: value.stack };\n
        }\n
        // Date has no own enumerable keys, so the walk below would collapse it to {}.\n
        if (value instanceof Date) {\n
            return value.toISOString();\n
        }\n
        if (seen.has(value)) {\n
            return '[Circular]';\n
        }\n
        seen.add(value);\n
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {\n
            return value.map((item) => toSafeValue(item, seen));\n
        }\n
        const plain = {};\n
        for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {\n
            if (key === 'toJSON') continue;\n
            try {\n
                plain[key] = toSafeValue(value[key], seen);\n
            } catch (e) {\n
                plain[key] = '[Unreadable]';\n
            }\n
        }\n
        return plain;\n
    }\n
\n
    // Helper to safely stringify values\n
    function safeStringify(obj) {\n
        return JSON.stringify(toSafeValue(obj, new WeakSet()));\n
    }\n
\n
    // Normalize log type for consistency (e.g., 'warn' to 'warning')\n
    function normalizeType(type) {\n
        return type === 'warn' ? 'warning' : type;\n
    }\n
\n
    // Determine if a log type should be captured based on configured levels\n
    function shouldCapture(type) {\n
        return captureTypes.includes(normalizeType(type));\n
    }\n
\n
    // Batch and send logs\n
    function flushLogs() {\n
        if (logQueue.length === 0) return;\n
\n
        const batch = logQueue.splice(0, logQueue.length);\n
\n
        fetch(ENDPOINT, {\n
            method: 'POST',\n
            headers: {\n
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'\n
            },\n
            body: JSON.stringify({ logs: batch })\n
        }).catch(err => {\n
