- path: tests\Feature\DependencyTest.php
  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Tasks\Index as TasksIndex;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use Livewire\Features\SupportTesting\Testable;
      
      // DEP-1..DEP-6 task dependency requirements.
      
      function twoTaskProject(): Project
      {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Deps project']);
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Design', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 3, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Build', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 2]);
      
          return $project->fresh();
      }
      
      function componentFor(Project $project, int $taskId): Testable
      {
          $component = Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project]);
          $component->call('edit', $taskId);
      
          return $component;
      }
      
      it('starts the successor 2 working days after the predecessor finishes with lag 2 (DEP-2/DEP-4 AC)', function () {
          $project = twoTaskProject();
          $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();
          $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();
      
          componentFor($project, $build->id)
              ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 2])
              ->call('addPredecessor')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(1)
              ->and(Dependency::first()->lag)->toBe(2);
      
          // Design finishes Fri Jan 9; +2 working days → successor starts Wed Jan 14.
          expect(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_start'))->toBe('2026-01-14')
              ->and(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_end'))->toBe('2026-01-15');
      });
      
      it('supports start-to-start dependencies (DEP-3)', function () {
          $project = twoTaskProject();
          $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();
          $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();
      
          componentFor($project, $build->id)
              ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'SS', 'lag' => 0])
              ->call('addPredecessor');
      
          // Build starts together with Design (Jan 5) and ends Jan 6.
          expect(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_start'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_end'))->toBe('2026-01-06');
      });
      
      it('prevents circular dependencies and names the cycle (DEP-5)', function () {
          $project = twoTaskProject();
          $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();
          $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();
      
          // Design → Build (FS) is fine…
          componentFor($project, $build->id)
              ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])
              ->call('addPredecessor')
              ->assertHasNoErrors();
      
          // …but Build → Design would close the loop and must be rejected with the cycle named.
          $component = componentFor($project, $design->id)
              ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $build->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])
              ->call('addPredecessor');
      
          expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(1)
              ->and(implode(' ', $component->get('dependencyErrors')))
              ->toContain('Circular dependency detected')
              ->toContain('Design')
              ->toContain('Build');
      });
      
      it('rejects a dependency on itself and on own sub-activities (DEP-5)', function () {
          $project = twoTaskProject();
          $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();
          $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();
      
          // Make Build a child of Design, then try Design → its own child.
          $build->update(['parent_id' => $design->id]);
      
          componentFor($project, $design->id)
              ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $build->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])
              ->call('addPredecessor');
      
          // Self dependency
          componentFor($project, $design->id)
              ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])
              ->call('addPredecessor');
      
          expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('uses the latest constraint for multiple predecessors (DEP-6)', function () {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Merge']);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'A', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 2, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'B', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'C', 'order' => 2, 'duration' => 2]);
      
          $a = Task::where('name', 'A')->first();
          $b = Task::where('name', 'B')->first();
          $c = Task::where('name', 'C')->first();
      
          componentFor($project, $c->id)
              ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $a->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])
              ->call('addPredecessor')
              ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $b->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])
              ->call('addPredecessor');
      
          // A ends Jan 6 → C would start Jan 7; B ends Jan 5 → Jan 6. Latest wins: Jan 7.
          expect(Task::where('name', 'C')->value('effective_start')->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07');
      });
      
      it('removes predecessors (DEP-1)', function () {
          $project = twoTaskProject();
          $build = Task::where('name', 'Build')->first();
          $design = Task::where('name', 'Design')->first();
      
          $component = componentFor($project, $build->id)
              ->set('newPredecessor', ['task_id' => $design->id, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0])
              ->call('addPredecessor');
      
          $dependencyId = Dependency::first()->id;
      
          $component->call('removePredecessor', $dependencyId);
          expect(Dependency::count())->toBe(0);
      
          // Build is now unconstrained and falls back to the earliest project start.
          expect(Task::where('name', 'Build')->value('effective_start')->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05');
      });

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Tasks;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use App\Services\Schedule\DependencyValidator;
      use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * TSK-1..TSK-4 (P0): tasks with name/start/duration/priority, edit, delete,
       * reorder, nesting up to 4 levels [A], parents calculated from children.
       * P1: milestones (duration 0), percent complete, indent/outdent (TSK-7).
       * DEP-1..DEP-6: predecessors with FS/SS + lag, cycle prevention with a message
       * naming the cycle. ASN-1/ASN-2: assignments shown in the list.
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          // Task form state
          public bool $showModal = false;
      
          public ?int $editingId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $name = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:2000')]
          public string $description = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|date')]
          public ?string $startInput = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:3650')]
          public int $duration = 1;
      
          #[Validate('required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical')]
          public string $priority = 'Medium';
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:100')]
          public int $percentComplete = 0;
      
          public ?int $parentId = null;
      
          /** @var list<int> */
          public array $assignedResourceIds = [];
      
          // Predecessor quick-add (DEP-1..DEP-4)
          public array $newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
      
          public array $dependencyErrors = [];
      
          public ?int $deleteId = null;
      
          /** ASN-5: filter the schedule by member */
          public ?int $memberFilter = null;
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              $this->editingId = $task->id;
              $this->name = $task->name;
              $this->description = (string) $task->description;
              $this->startInput = $task->start_input?->format('Y-m-d');
              $this->duration = $task->duration;
              $this->priority = $task->priority;
              $this->percentComplete = $task->percent_complete;
              $this->parentId = $task->parent_id;
              $this->assignedResourceIds = $task->assignments()->pluck('resource_id')->map('intval')->all();
              $this->reset(['newPredecessor', 'dependencyErrors']);
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              $data = [
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'description' => $this->description ?: null,
                  'start_input' => $this->startInput ?: null,
                  'duration' => $this->duration,
                  'priority' => $this->priority,
                  'percent_complete' => $this->percentComplete,
                  'parent_id' => $this->parentId,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $data['order'] = (int) $this->project->tasks()->whereNull('parent_id')->max('order') + 1;
                  $task = Task::create($data);
              } else {
                  $task = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
                  $task->update($data);
                  if (
                      $task->parent_id !== null
                      && app(DependencyValidator::class)->depthOf($task->parent_id, $this->project) + 1 >= 4
                  ) {
                      $task->forceFill(['parent_id' => null])->saveQuietly();
                      session()->now('warning', __('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
                  }
                  $this->syncDescendantsTypes($task);
              }
      
              $task->refresh();
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
      
              // ASN-1: assign one or more members
              Assignment::query()->where('task_id', $task->id)->delete();
              foreach (array_unique($this->assignedResourceIds) as $resourceId) {
                  $resource = Resource::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->find($resourceId);
      
                  if ($resource !== null) {
                      Assignment::create([
                          'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                          'task_id' => $task->id,
                          'resource_id' => $resource->id,
                          'role' => $resource->role,
                      ]);
                  }
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }
      
          public function askDelete(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = $taskId;
          }
      
          public function cancelDelete(): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function delete(): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask((int) $this->deleteId);
      
              // Sub-activities are unparented (FK nullOnDelete), dependencies cascade.
              $task->children()->update(['parent_id' => null]);
              $task->delete();
      
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function moveUp(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, -1);
          }
      
          public function moveDown(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, 1);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: indent = make the task a child of its previous sibling.
           */
          public function indent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
      
              if ($index === false || $index === 0) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $newParent = $siblings[$index - 1];
      
              if (app(DependencyValidator::class)->depthOf($newParent->id, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                  session()->now('warning', __('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $task->update(['parent_id' => $newParent->id, 'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $newParent->id)->max('order') + 1]);
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: outdent = move the task up to its grandparent level.
           */
          public function outdent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              if ($task->parent_id === null) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $parent = $this->findTask($task->parent_id);
      
              $task->update([
                  'parent_id' => $parent->parent_id,
                  'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $parent->parent_id)->max('order') + 1,
              ]);
      
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
              $this->syncTaskType($parent);
          }
      
          /**
           * DEP-5: adding a predecessor runs cycle detection first and shows a
           * message identifying the cycle.
           */
          public function addPredecessor(): void
          {
              $this->dependencyErrors = [];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null || $this->newPredecessor['task_id'] === null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_missing');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $predecessor = $this->findTask((int) $this->newPredecessor['task_id']);
              $successor = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
              $type = (string) $this->newPredecessor['type'];
              $lag = (int) $this->newPredecessor['lag'];
      
              $errors = app(DependencyValidator::class)
                  ->validateDependency($this->project, $predecessor, $successor, $type, $lag);
      
              if ($errors !== []) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors = $errors;
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $existing = Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('predecessor_id', $predecessor->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $successor->id)
                  ->first();
      
              if ($existing !== null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_exists');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              Dependency::create([
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'predecessor_id' => $predecessor->id,
                  'successor_id' => $successor->id,
                  'type' => in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true) ? $type : 'FS',
                  'lag' => $lag,
              ]);
      
              $this->reset('newPredecessor');
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          public function removePredecessor(int $dependencyId): void
          {
              Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                  ->findOrFail($dependencyId)
                  ->delete();
          }
      
          private function move(int $taskId, int $direction): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
              $targetIndex = $index === false ? null : $index + $direction;
      
              if ($index === false || $targetIndex === null || ! isset($siblings[$targetIndex])) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $other = $siblings[$targetIndex];
      
              $order = $task->order;
              $task->update(['order' => $other->order]);
              $other->update(['order' => $order]);
          }
      
          /** @return \Illuminate\Support\Collection<int, Task> */
          private function siblingsOf(Task $task)
          {
              return $this->project->tasks()
                  ->where('parent_id', $task->parent_id)
                  ->orderBy('order')
                  ->get();
          }
      
          /** @return array<string, mixed> */
          protected function rules(): array
          {
              return [
                  'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
                  'description' => 'nullable|string|max:2000',
                  'startInput' => 'nullable|date',
                  'duration' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:3650',
                  'priority' => 'required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical',
                  'percentComplete' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:100',
                  'parentId' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'max:3650', function (string $attribute, $value, callable $fail): void {
                      if ($value === null || $this->editingId === null) {
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($value === $this->editingId) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_self'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      $validator = app(DependencyValidator::class);
      
                      if ($validator->isAncestorOf($this->editingId, $value, $this->project)) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_descendant'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($validator->depthOf($value, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
                      }
                  }],
                  'assignedResourceIds.*' => ['integer', 'exists:resources,id', function (string $attribute, $value): void {
                      if ((int) $value === 0) {
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if (! Resource::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->where('id', (int) $value)->exists()) {
                          throw new \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException(
                              app(\Illuminate\Validation\Factory::class), [], []
                          );
                      }
                  }],
              ];
          }
      
          private function findTask(int $taskId): Task
          {
              return Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($taskId);
          }
      
          private function resetForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset([
                  'editingId',
                  'name',
                  'description',
                  'startInput',
                  'duration',
                  'priority',
                  'percentComplete',
                  'parentId',
                  'assignedResourceIds',
                  'dependencyErrors',
              ]);
      
              $this->duration = 1;
              $this->priority = 'Medium';
              $this->percentComplete = 0;
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          /**
           * Keep the denormalised task_type in sync: Milestone (duration 0),
           * Parent (has children), Task (TSK-5 / display only).
           */
          private function syncTaskType(Task $task): void
          {
              $task->refresh();
      
              $type = match (true) {
                  $task->children()->exists() => 'Parent',
                  $task->duration === 0 => 'Milestone',
                  default => 'Task',
              };
      
              if ($task->task_type !== $type) {
                  $task->forceFill(['task_type' => $type])->saveQuietly();
              }
          }
      
          private function syncDescendantsTypes(Task $task): void
          {
              foreach ($task->children as $child) {
                  $this->syncTaskType($child);
              }
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
              $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');
      
              $rows = [];
              $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walk(null, 0);
      
              $assignments = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->with('resource:id,name')
                  ->get()
                  ->groupBy('task_id');
      
              // ASN-3: warn when an assigned member is on leave or double-booked.
              $warnings = [];
              foreach ($rows as $row) {
                  $task = $row['task'];
      
                  if ($task->effective_start === null || $task->effective_end === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  foreach ($assignments[$task->id] ?? [] as $assignment) {
                      $resource = $assignment->resource;
      
                      if ($resource === null || $resource->trashed()) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $onLeave = $resource->leaves()
                          ->where('start_date', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->where('end_date', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($onLeave) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_leave', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
      
                      $overlapping = Assignment::query()
                          ->where('resource_id', $resource->id)
                          ->where('task_id', '!=', $task->id)
                          ->whereHas('task', static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                              $query->where('effective_start', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                                  ->where('effective_end', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'));
                          })
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($overlapping) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_overlap', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              $filtered = $this->memberFilter === null
                  ? $rows
                  : array_values(array_filter($rows, static fn (array $row): bool => $assignments[$row['task']->id]
                      ?->contains(static fn (Assignment $assignment): bool => $assignment->resource_id === $this->memberFilter) ?? false));
      
              $predecessors = $this->editingId === null
                  ? collect()
                  : Dependency::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                      ->with('predecessor:id,name')
                      ->get();
      
              return view('livewire.tasks.index', [
                  'rows' => $filtered,
                  'allTasks' => $tasks,
                  'resources' => $this->project->resources()->orderBy('name')->get(),
                  'assignments' => $assignments,
                  'warnings' => $warnings,
                  'predecessors' => $predecessors,
                  'parentCandidates' => $tasks
                      ->whereNull('parent_id')
                      ->reject(fn (Task $task): bool => $this->editingId !== null && $task->id === $this->editingId)
                      ->values(),
              ]);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Calendar;
      
      use App\Models\Calendar;
      use App\Models\Holiday;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Support\IndonesianHolidayTemplate;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * CAL-1 (working days + hours), CAL-2 (weekends excluded — derived from
       * working days), CAL-3 (custom holidays with optional range), CAL-4 (Indonesian
       * holiday template import). Any change triggers recalculation via the observer
       * (CAL-5).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public Calendar $calendar;
      
          /** @var list<int> */
          #[Validate('required|array|min:1')]
          public array $workingDays = [];
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:1|max:24')]
          public int $hoursPerDay = 8;
      
          // Holiday form
          public ?int $holidayId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $holidayName = '';
      
          #[Validate('required|date')]
          public string $holidayDate = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|date|after_or_equal:holidayDate')]
          public string $holidayEndDate = '';
      
          // CAL-4 import
          public int $importYear;
      
          public function mount(Project $project): void
          {
              $this->project = $project;
              $this->calendar = $project->calendar()->firstOrFail();
              $this->workingDays = array_map('intval', $this->calendar->working_days ?? []);
              $this->hoursPerDay = (int) $this->calendar->working_hours_per_day;
              $this->importYear = now()->year;
          }
      
          public function saveCalendar(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              $workingDays = collect($this->workingDays)->unique()->sort()->values();
      
              $this->calendar->update([
                  'working_days' => $workingDays->all(),
                  'weekend_days' => array_values(array_diff([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], $workingDays->all())),
                  'working_hours_per_day' => $this->hoursPerDay,
              ]);
          }
      
          public function saveHoliday(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              $data = [
                  'name' => $this->holidayName,
                  'date' => $this->holidayDate,
                  'end_date' => $this->holidayEndDate ?: null,
              ];
      
              if ($this->holidayId === null) {
                  $this->calendar->holidays()->create($data);
              } else {
                  Holiday::query()
                      ->where('calendar_id', $this->calendar->id)
                      ->findOrFail($this->holidayId)
                      ->update($data);
              }
      
              $this->resetHolidayForm();
          }
      
          public function editHoliday(int $holidayId): void
          {
              $holiday = Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $this->calendar->id)
                  ->findOrFail($holidayId);
      
              $this->holidayId = $holiday->id;
              $this->holidayName = $holiday->name;
              $this->holidayDate = $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d');
              $this->holidayEndDate = $holiday->end_date?->format('Y-m-d') ?? '';
          }
      
          public function deleteHoliday(int $holidayId): void
          {
              Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $this->calendar->id)
                  ->findOrFail($holidayId)
                  ->delete();
      
              if ($this->holidayId === $holidayId) {
                  $this->resetHolidayForm();
              }
          }
      
          public function cancelHoliday(): void
          {
              $this->resetHolidayForm();
          }
      
          /**
           * CAL-4: import the curated Indonesian national holiday template.
           */
          public function importTemplate(): void
          {
              $existing = $this->calendar->holidays()
                  ->get()
                  ->map(static fn (Holiday $holiday): string => $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d'))
                  ->all();
      
              foreach (IndonesianHolidayTemplate::forYear($this->importYear) as $holiday) {
                  if (in_array($holiday['date'], $existing, true)) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  $this->calendar->holidays()->create([
                      'name' => $holiday['name'],
                      'date' => $holiday['date'],
                  ]);
      
                  $existing[] = $holiday['date'];
              }
          }
      
          private function resetHolidayForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['holidayName', 'holidayDate', 'holidayEndDate']);
          }
      
          /** @return array<string, string> */
          protected function rules(): array
          {
              return [
                  'workingDays' => 'required|array|min:1',
                  'workingDays.*' => 'integer|in:1,2,3,4,5,6,7',
                  'hoursPerDay' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:24',
                  'holidayName' => 'required|string|max:255',
                  'holidayDate' => 'required|date',
                  'holidayEndDate' => 'nullable|date|after_or_equal:holidayDate',
              ];
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              return view('livewire.calendar.index', [
                  'weekdays' => [
                      1 => __('calendar.mon'), 2 => __('calendar.tue'), 3 => __('calendar.wed'),
                      4 => __('calendar.thu'), 5 => __('calendar.fri'), 6 => __('calendar.sat'), 7 => __('calendar.sun'),
                  ],
                  'holidays' => $this->calendar->holidays()->orderBy('date')->get(),
                  'weekendDays' => array_values(array_diff([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], $this->workingDays)),
                  'importYears' => IndonesianHolidayTemplate::availableYears(),
              ]);
          }
      }

              'duration',
              'priority',

              return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);

          {

          public function children(): HasMany
          {
              return $this->hasMany(Task::class, 'parent_id');
          }

          {
              return $this->hasMany(Dependency::class, 'predecessor_id');

          {
              return $this->hasMany(Dependency::class, 'successor_id');

          {
              return $this->hasMany(Assignment::class);
          }
      }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Schedule;

use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulableTask;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\ProjectScheduleInput;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleEngine;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
use App\Models\Calendar;
use App\Models\Holiday;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\Task;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * The application-side bridge to the scheduling engine.
 *
 * Loads a project with Eloquent, converts it into pure domain DTOs, calls the
 * ONE recalculation entry point (ScheduleEngine::calculate) and persists the
 * calculated dates/slack/critical flags back onto the tasks (CPM-6).
 *
 * Views and controllers never compute dates — they only read what is written here.
 */
final class ScheduleRecalculator
{
    public function __construct(private readonly ScheduleEngine $engine) {}

    /**
     * Recalculate and persist the whole schedule of a project (PRD §8.6).
     */
    public function recalculate(Project $project): void
    {
        $calendar = $project->calendar()->first();

        if ($calendar === null) {
            return; // no calendar yet — nothing sane to compute
        }

        $tasks = Task::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->orderBy('order')
            ->get();

        $holidays = Holiday::query()
            ->where('calendar_id', $calendar->id)
            ->get();

        $defaultStart = $tasks
            ->pluck('start_input')
            ->filter()
            ->sort()
            ->first() ?? now()->startOfDay();

        $input = new ProjectScheduleInput(
            calendar: $this->buildCalendar($calendar, $holidays),
            tasks: $this->buildTasks($tasks),
            links: $this->buildLinks($project),
            defaultStart: DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($defaultStart->toDateTimeImmutable()),
        );

        $result = $this->engine->calculate($input);

        DB::transaction(static function () use ($tasks, $result, $project, $calendar, $holidays): void {
            foreach ($tasks as $task) {
                $schedule = $result->forTask($task->id);

                if ($schedule === null) {
                    continue;
                }

                $task->forceFill([
                    'effective_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'effective_end' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'early_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'early_finish' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'late_start' => $schedule->lateStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'late_finish' => $schedule->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'slack' => $schedule->slack,
                    'is_critical' => $schedule->isCritical,
                ])->saveQuietly();
            }

            // Keep the legacy JSON mirror in sync; the holidays table is the source of truth (D-15).
            $calendar->forceFill([
                'holidays' => $holidays->map(static fn (Holiday $holiday): array => [
                    'id' => (string) $holiday->id,
                    'name' => $holiday->name,
                    'date' => $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'end_date' => $holiday->end_date?->format('Y-m-d'),
                ])->values()->all(),
            ])->saveQuietly();

            $project->forceFill([
                'started_at' => $result->projectStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                'completed_at' => $result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                'total_duration' => $result->totalDuration,
            ])->saveQuietly();
        });
    }

    private function buildCalendar(Calendar $calendar, $holidays): WorkingCalendar
    {
        $dates = [];

        foreach ($holidays as $holiday) {
            $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();
            $end = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;

            for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                $dates[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');
            }
        }

        return new WorkingCalendar($calendar->working_days ?? [], array_values(array_unique($dates)));
    }

    /**
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection<int, Task>  $tasks
     * @return list<SchedulableTask>
     */
    private function buildTasks($tasks): array
    {
        return $tasks->map(static fn (Task $task): SchedulableTask => new SchedulableTask(
            id: $task->id,
            parentId: $task->parent_id,
            position: $task->order,
            name: $task->name,
            requestedStart: $task->start_input === null
                ? null
                : DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($task->start_input->toDateTimeImmutable()),
            duration: $task->duration,
        ))->all();
    }

    /**
     * @return list<DependencyLink>
     */
    private function buildLinks(Project $project): array
    {
        return $project->dependencies()
            ->get()
            ->map(static fn ($dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                lag: $dependency->lag,
            ))->all();
    }
}
---DependencyValidator---
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Schedule;

use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyGraph;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
use App\Models\Dependency;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\Task;

/**
 * Application-level integrity rules for dependencies and task hierarchy
 * (PRD DEP-5, §8.7: data must never be saved in a state with a dependency cycle).
 *
 * Mirrors what the engine enforces, so bad data is rejected *before* it is written.
 */
final class DependencyValidator
{
    /**
     * Validate a candidate dependency (predecessor -> successor).
     *
     * @return list<string> human-readable errors; empty means valid
     */
    public function validateDependency(Project $project, Task $predecessor, Task $successor, string $type, int $lag): array
    {
        $errors = [];

        if ($predecessor->project_id !== $project->id || $successor->project_id !== $project->id) {
            $errors[] = 'Both tasks must belong to this project.';
        }

        if (! in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true)) {
            $errors[] = 'Dependency type must be FS or SS.';
        }

        if ($predecessor->id === $successor->id) {
            $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on itself.';
        }

        if ($this->isAncestorOf($predecessor->id, $successor->id, $project)) {
            $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on one of its own sub-activities.';
        }

        if ($this->isAncestorOf($successor->id, $predecessor->id, $project)) {
            $errors[] = 'A sub-activity cannot be a predecessor of its own parent.';
        }

        if ($errors === []) {
            $cycle = $this->findCycle($project, $predecessor->id, $successor->id);

            if ($cycle !== null) {
                $errors[] = $this->cycleMessage($project, $cycle);
            }
        }

        return $errors;
    }

    /**
     * Would adding this edge create a cycle? Returns the id path (A -> B -> C -> A) or null.
     *
     * @param  list<array{predecessor_id: int, successor_id: int}>  $extra
     * @return list<int>|null
     */
    public function findCycle(Project $project, int $predecessorId, int $successorId): ?array
    {
        $tasks = Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->get();

        $links = Dependency::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->get()
            ->map(static fn (Dependency $dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                lag: $dependency->lag,
            ))
            ->all();

        $links[] = new DependencyLink($predecessorId, $successorId, DependencyType::FS, 0);

        try {
            (new DependencyGraph($tasks->pluck('id')->all(), $links))->topologicalOrder();
        } catch (CircularDependencyException $exception) {
            return $exception->cyclePath;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Map an id path to a display message naming the tasks (DEP-5).
     *
     * @param  list<int>  $cycle
     */
    public function cycleMessage(Project $project, array $cycle): string
    {
        $names = Task::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->whereIn('id', $cycle)
            ->pluck('name', 'id');

        $labels = array_map(
            static fn (int $id): string => (string) ($names[$id] ?? "#{$id}"),
            $cycle,
        );

        $labels[] = $labels[0];

        return 'Circular dependency detected: '.implode(' -> ', $labels);
    }

    /**
     * Is $ancestorId an ancestor of $taskId (or the same task)?
     */
    public function isAncestorOf(int $ancestorId, int $taskId, Project $project): bool
    {
        $parents = Task::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');

        $current = $taskId;

        while (isset($parents[$current])) {
            if ($parents[$current] === null) {
                break;
            }

            if ($parents[$current] === $ancestorId) {
                return true;
            }

            $current = (int) $parents[$current];
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Depth of a task in the hierarchy (0 = top level); guard for the 4-level [A] limit.
     */
    public function depthOf(int $taskId, Project $project): int
    {
        $parents = Task::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');

        $depth = 0;
        $current = $taskId;

        while (isset($parents[$current]) && $parents[$current] !== null) {
            $depth++;
            $current = (int) $parents[$current];
        }

        return $depth;
    }
}

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

class Calendar extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;
    use SoftDeletes;

    protected $fillable = [
        'project_id',
        'name',
        'working_days',
        'weekend_days',
        'working_hours_per_day',
        'holidays',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'working_days' => 'array',
        'weekend_days' => 'array',
        'working_hours_per_day' => 'integer',
        'holidays' => 'array',
    ];

    protected $hidden = [
        'project_id',
    ];

    public function project(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
    }

    public function holidays(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Holiday::class);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;

/**
 * Dependency graph helpers: topological ordering and cycle detection (PRD DEP-5).
 *
 * Pure PHP — used both by the engine (defense in depth, PRD §8.7) and by the
 * application layer to reject saves before they happen.
 */
final class DependencyGraph
{
    /**
     * @param  list<int>  $taskIds
     * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly array $taskIds,
        private readonly array $links,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Kahn topological order. Throws CircularDependencyException when a cycle exists.
     *
     * @return list<int>
     */
    public function topologicalOrder(): array
    {
        $inDegree = array_fill_keys($this->taskIds, 0);
        $adjacency = array_fill_keys($this->taskIds, []);

        foreach ($this->links as $link) {
            if (! isset($inDegree[$link->predecessorId]) || ! isset($inDegree[$link->successorId])) {
                continue; // edges outside the given task set are ignored
            }

            $adjacency[$link->predecessorId][] = $link->successorId;
            $inDegree[$link->successorId]++;
        }

        $queue = [];
        foreach ($inDegree as $id => $degree) {
            if ($degree === 0) {
                $queue[] = $id;
            }
        }

        $order = [];
        while ($queue !== []) {
            $id = array_shift($queue);
            $order[] = $id;

            foreach ($adjacency[$id] as $next) {
                $inDegree[$next]--;

                if ($inDegree[$next] === 0) {
                    $queue[] = $next;
                }
            }
        }

        if (count($order) !== count($this->taskIds)) {
            $remaining = array_values(array_diff($this->taskIds, $order));
            throw new CircularDependencyException($this->findCycle($remaining));
        }

        return $order;
    }

    /**
     * Depth-first search for one concrete cycle among the given nodes.
     *
     * @param  list<int>  $candidates
     * @return list<int>
     */
    public function findCycle(array $candidates): array
    {
        $successors = array_fill_keys($candidates, []);
        foreach ($this->links as $link) {
            if (isset($successors[$link->predecessorId]) && isset($successors[$link->successorId])) {
                $successors[$link->predecessorId][] = $link->successorId;
            }
        }

        $state = []; // id => 1 visiting, 2 done
        $stack = [];

        $visit = function (int $id) use (&$visit, &$state, &$stack, $successors): array {
            $state[$id] = 1;
            $stack[] = $id;

            foreach ($successors[$id] ?? [] as $next) {
                if (($state[$next] ?? 0) === 1) {
                    $at = array_search($next, $stack, true);

                    return array_slice($stack, $at === false ? 0 : $at);
                }

                if (($state[$next] ?? 0) === 0) {
                    $cycle = $visit($next);

                    if ($cycle !== []) {
                        return $cycle;
                    }
                }
            }

            array_pop($stack);
            $state[$id] = 2;

            return [];
        };

        foreach ($candidates as $id) {
            if (($state[$id] ?? 0) === 0) {
                $cycle = $visit($id);

                if ($cycle !== []) {
                    return $cycle;
                }
            }
        }

        return $candidates;
    }
}

use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Thrown when a dependency cycle is detected. Carries the task-id path of the
 * cycle (first id repeated conceptually: A -> B -> C -> A is [A, B, C]).
 */
class CircularDependencyException extends RuntimeException
{
    /** @param list<int> $cyclePath */
    public function __construct(public readonly array $cyclePath)
    {
        parent::__construct('Circular dependency detected between tasks: '.implode(' -> ', $cyclePath));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;

use DateTimeImmutable;

/**
 * The scheduling engine: forward/backward pass CPM over working days (PRD §8, CPM-1).
 *
 * This is the ONLY place in the application where dates, slack, and critical
 * flags are calculated (build rule; PRD §8.6). It is pure PHP: no Eloquent,
 * no facades, no HTTP. Every recalculation goes through calculate().
 */
final class ScheduleEngine
{
    /**
     * Recalculate a whole project schedule.
     *
     * Rules implemented:
     *  - Duration is counted in working days; end = start + (duration - 1) (PRD §8.1/§8.3).
     *  - A start falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day (TSK-1 AC).
     *  - Effective start = max(adjusted requested start, all predecessor constraints) (PRD §8.2).
     *  - FS with lag L: successor starts L+1 working days after predecessor finish (D-07).
     *  - SS with lag L: successor starts L working days after predecessor start (D-07).
     *  - Parent tasks roll up: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
     *  - Slack = working days between early and late start; critical when slack <= 0 (CPM-2, D-25).
     *
     * @throws SchedulingException|CircularDependencyException
     */
    public function calculate(ProjectScheduleInput $input): ScheduleResult
    {
        $tasks = $this->indexTasks($input->tasks);

        if ($tasks === []) {
            return new ScheduleResult([], $input->defaultStart, $input->defaultStart, 0);
        }

        $children = $this->childrenMap($tasks);
        $leaves = $this->leafTasks($tasks, $children);
        $links = $this->expandLinks($input->links, $tasks, $children);

        [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish] = $this->forwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links);
        $this->rollUpParents($tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish);

        $projectStart = $this->minDate($earlyStart);
        $projectFinish = $this->maxDate($earlyFinish);

        [$lateStart, $lateFinish] = $this->backwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links, $projectFinish);
        $this->rollUpParentsBackward($input, $tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish, $lateStart, $lateFinish);

        $calendar = $input->calendar;
        $result = [];

        foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
            $slack = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $lateStart[$id]);

            $result[$id] = new TaskSchedule(
                taskId: $id,
                earlyStart: $earlyStart[$id],
                earlyFinish: $earlyFinish[$id],
                lateStart: $lateStart[$id],
                lateFinish: $lateFinish[$id],
                slack: $slack,
                isCritical: $slack <= 0,
            );
        }

        return new ScheduleResult(
            byTask: $result,
            projectStart: $projectStart,
            projectFinish: $projectFinish,
            totalDuration: $calendar->countWorkingDays($projectStart, $projectFinish) + 1,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<SchedulableTask>  $taskList
     * @return array<int, SchedulableTask>
     */
    private function indexTasks(array $taskList): array
    {
        $tasks = [];

        foreach ($taskList as $task) {
            if (isset($tasks[$task->id])) {
                throw new SchedulingException("Duplicate task id {$task->id}.");
            }

            $tasks[$task->id] = $task;
        }

        return $tasks;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @return array<int, list<int>> parent id => child ids
     */
    private function childrenMap(array $tasks): array
    {
        $children = [];

        foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
            if ($task->parentId === null) {
                continue;
            }

            if (! isset($tasks[$task->parentId])) {
                throw new SchedulingException("Task {$task->name} references an unknown parent ({$task->parentId}).");
            }

            $this->assertNoParentCycle($id, $tasks);
            $children[$task->parentId][] = $id;
        }

        return $children;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     */
    private function assertNoParentCycle(int $id, array $tasks): void
    {
        $seen = [$id => true];
        $current = $tasks[$id];

        while ($current->parentId !== null) {
            if (isset($seen[$current->parentId])) {
                throw new SchedulingException("Task hierarchy contains a cycle at task {$current->parentId}.");
            }

            $seen[$current->parentId] = true;
            $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Tasks without children are scheduled directly; parents roll up (D-09).
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @return list<int>
     */
    private function leafTasks(array $tasks, array $children): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            array_keys($tasks),
            static fn (int $id): bool => ! isset($children[$id]),
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Dependencies to or from a parent are treated at the parent level (PRD §8.5):
     * expand each endpoint to its descendant leaves (D-09). Self edges are dropped.
     *
     * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @return list<DependencyLink>
     */
    private function expandLinks(array $links, array $tasks, array $children): array
    {
        $expanded = [];

        foreach ($links as $link) {
            foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->predecessorId, $tasks, $children) as $predecessor) {
                foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->successorId, $tasks, $children) as $successor) {
                    if ($predecessor === $successor) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    $expanded[] = new DependencyLink($predecessor, $successor, $link->type, $link->lag);
                }
            }
        }

        return $expanded;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @return list<int>
     */
    private function descendantLeaves(int $id, array $tasks, array $children): array
    {
        if (! isset($tasks[$id])) {
            throw new SchedulingException("Dependency references an unknown task ({$id}).");
        }

        if (! isset($children[$id])) {
            return [$id]; // a "parent" without children behaves as a normal task (D-10)
        }

        $leaves = [];

        foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
            foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($child, $tasks, $children) as $leaf) {
                $leaves[] = $leaf;
            }
        }

        return $leaves;
    }

    /**
     * Forward pass over leaf tasks in topological order, then parent roll-up.
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  list<int>  $leaves
     * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
     * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
     */
    private function forwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links): array
    {
        $order = (new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder();

        $incoming = [];
        foreach ($links as $link) {
            $incoming[$link->successorId][] = $link;
        }

        $calendar = $input->calendar;
        $earlyStart = [];
        $earlyFinish = [];

        foreach ($order as $id) {
            $task = $tasks[$id];
            $start = $calendar->adjust($task->requestedStart ?? $input->defaultStart);

            foreach ($incoming[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                $constraint = match ($link->type) {
                    DependencyType::FS => $calendar->shift($earlyFinish[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag + 1),
                    DependencyType::SS => $calendar->shift($earlyStart[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag),
                };

                if ($constraint > $start) {
                    $start = $constraint;
                }
            }

            $earlyStart[$id] = $start;
            $earlyFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                ? $start // milestone (TSK-5)
                : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
        }

        return [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish];
    }

    /**
     * Parent tasks: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
     * Deepest parents first so grandchildren are rolled up before their parents.
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
     */
    private function rollUpParents(array $tasks, array $children, array &$earlyStart, array &$earlyFinish): void
    {
        foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
            $childStarts = [];
            $childFinishes = [];

            foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                $childStarts[] = $earlyStart[$child];
                $childFinishes[] = $earlyFinish[$child];
            }

            $earlyStart[$id] = $this->minDate($childStarts);
            $earlyFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Backward pass over leaf tasks in reverse topological order, then parent roll-up.
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  list<int>  $leaves
     * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
     * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
     */
    private function backwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links, DateTimeImmutable $projectFinish): array
    {
        $order = array_reverse((new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder());

        $outgoing = [];
        foreach ($links as $link) {
            $outgoing[$link->predecessorId][] = $link;
        }

        $calendar = $input->calendar;
        $lateStart = [];
        $lateFinish = [];

        foreach ($order as $id) {
            $task = $tasks[$id];
            $lateFinishConstraint = null;
            $lateStartConstraint = null;

            foreach ($outgoing[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                if ($link->type === DependencyType::FS) {
                    // successor start >= shift(predecessor finish, lag + 1)
                    $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -($link->lag + 1));
                    $lateFinishConstraint = $lateFinishConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateFinishConstraint
                        ? $candidate
                        : $lateFinishConstraint;
                } else {
                    // successor start >= shift(predecessor start, lag)
                    $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -$link->lag);
                    $lateStartConstraint = $lateStartConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateStartConstraint
                        ? $candidate
                        : $lateStartConstraint;
                }
            }

            // Tasks without successors finish with the project (CPM backward pass).
            $finish = $lateFinishConstraint ?? $projectFinish;
            $start = $task->duration === 0
                ? $finish
                : $calendar->shift($finish, -($task->duration - 1));

            if ($lateStartConstraint !== null && $lateStartConstraint < $start) {
                $start = $lateStartConstraint;
            }

            $lateStart[$id] = $start;
            $lateFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                ? $start
                : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
        }

        return [$lateStart, $lateFinish];
    }

    /**
     * Parent late window: latest finish = latest child finish, latest start derived
     * from the parent's rolled-up span.
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateStart
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateFinish
     */
    private function rollUpParentsBackward(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $children, array $earlyStart, array $earlyFinish, array &$lateStart, array &$lateFinish): void
    {
        $calendar = $input->calendar;

        foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
            $childFinishes = [];
            foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                $childFinishes[] = $lateFinish[$child];
            }

            $lateFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);

            // Late start derived from the parent's rolled-up span.
            $span = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $earlyFinish[$id]) + 1;
            $lateStart[$id] = $calendar->shift($lateFinish[$id], -($span - 1));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Parent ids ordered deepest first (bottom-up roll-up needs children first).
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @return list<int>
     */
    private function parentsByDepthDesc(array $tasks, array $children): array
    {
        $parents = array_keys($children);

        usort($parents, static function (int $a, int $b) use ($tasks): int {
            return self::depth($b, $tasks) <=> self::depth($a, $tasks);
        });

        return $parents;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     */
    private static function depth(int $id, array $tasks): int
    {
        $depth = 0;
        $current = $tasks[$id];

        while ($current->parentId !== null) {
            $depth++;
            $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
        }

        return $depth;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
     */
    private function minDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $min = null;

        foreach ($dates as $date) {
            if ($min === null || $date < $min) {
                $min = $date;
            }
        }

        if ($min === null) {
            throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the earliest date of an empty set.');
        }

        return $min;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
     */
    private function maxDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $max = null;

        foreach ($dates as $date) {
            if ($max === null || $date > $max) {
                $max = $date;
            }
        }

        if ($max === null) {
            throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the latest date of an empty set.');
        }

        return $max;
    }
}

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;
      
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      use DateTimeInterface;
      
      /**
       * Working calendar: knows which days are working days (PRD CAL-1/CAL-2/CAL-3).
       *
       * Pure value object — no Eloquent, no facades. All working-day arithmetic
       * (PRD §8.1) happens through this class.
       */
      final class WorkingCalendar
      {
          /** @var array<int, true> Set of ISO weekday numbers (1=Mon .. 7=Sun) that are working days */
          private array $workingDays;
      
          /** @var array<string, true> Set of holiday dates formatted Y-m-d */
          private array $holidays;
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, int>  $workingDays  ISO weekday numbers (1=Mon .. 7=Sun)
           * @param  array<int, string>  $holidays  Holiday dates formatted Y-m-d
           */
          public function __construct(array $workingDays, array $holidays = [])
          {
              $workingDays = array_values(array_unique(array_map('intval', $workingDays)));
              sort($workingDays);
      
              if ($workingDays === [] || array_filter($workingDays, static fn (int $d): bool => $d < 1 || $d > 7) !== []) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Working calendar requires at least one working day between 1 (Mon) and 7 (Sun).');
              }
      
              $this->workingDays = array_fill_keys($workingDays, true);
              $this->holidays = array_fill_keys(array_map('strval', $holidays), true);
          }
      
          public function isWorkingDay(DateTimeInterface $date): bool
          {
              $day = (int) $date->format('w'); // 0=Sun .. 6=Sat
              $iso = $day === 0 ? 7 : $day;
      
              if (! isset($this->workingDays[$iso])) {
                  return false;
              }
      
              return ! isset($this->holidays[$date->format('Y-m-d')]);
          }
      
          /**
           * The given date if it is a working day, otherwise the next working day (TSK-1 AC).
           */
          public function adjust(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $current = self::immutable($date);
      
              if ($this->isWorkingDay($current)) {
                  return $current;
              }
      
              return $this->nextWorkingDay($current);
          }
      
          /**
           * The next working day strictly after the given date.
           */
          public function nextWorkingDay(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $current = self::immutable($date);
      
              for ($i = 0; $i < 3660; $i++) {
                  $current = $current->modify('+1 day');
      
                  if ($this->isWorkingDay($current)) {
                      return $current;
                  }
              }
      
              throw new SchedulingException('No working day found within ten years — check the calendar configuration.');
          }
      
          /**
           * Move forwards (positive) or backwards (negative) by whole working days.
           * Shifting by zero returns the same calendar day.
           */
          public function shift(DateTimeInterface $date, int $workingDays): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $current = self::immutable($date);
              $step = $workingDays >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
              $remaining = abs($workingDays);
      
              for ($i = 0; $i < 366_000 && $remaining > 0; $i++) {
                  $current = $current->modify(sprintf('%+d day', $step));
      
                  if ($this->isWorkingDay($current)) {
                      $remaining--;
                  }
              }
      
              if ($remaining > 0) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Could not shift by the requested number of working days — check the calendar configuration.');
              }
      
              return $current;
          }
      
          /**
           * Number of working days strictly after $from, up to and including $to.
           * Negative when $to is before $from.
           */
          public function countWorkingDays(DateTimeInterface $from, DateTimeInterface $to): int
          {
              $start = self::immutable($from);
              $end = self::immutable($to);
      
              if ($start == $end) {
                  return 0;
              }
      
              if ($start > $end) {
                  return -$this->countWorkingDays($end, $start);
              }
      
              $count = 0;
              $cursor = $start;
      
              while ($cursor < $end) {
                  $cursor = $cursor->modify('+1 day');
      
                  if ($this->isWorkingDay($cursor)) {
                      $count++;
                  }
              }
      
              return $count;
          }
      
          private static function immutable(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              return DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($date)->setTime(0, 0);
          }
      }

      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Support;

      /**
       * Curated template of Indonesian national holidays (PRD CAL-4, P1).
       *
       * IMPORTANT: this is a convenience template, not an official source. Religious
       * dates move every year — verify against the official SKB (Surat Keputusan
       * Bersama) list before relying on it. See docs/DECISIONS.md (D-19).
       */
      final class IndonesianHolidayTemplate
      {
          /**
           * Fixed-date national holidays, available for any year.
           *
           * @return list<array{name: string, date: string}>
           */
          private static function fixedDateHolidays(int $year): array
          {
              return [
                  ['name' => "Tahun Baru Masehi / New Year's Day", 'date' => "{$year}-01-01"],
                  ['name' => 'Hari Buruh Internasional / International Labour Day', 'date' => "{$year}-05-01"],
                  ['name' => 'Hari Lahir Pancasila / Pancasila Day', 'date' => "{$year}-06-01"],
                  ['name' => 'Hari Kemerdekaan RI / Independence Day', 'date' => "{$year}-08-17"],
                  ['name' => 'Hari Natal / Christmas Day', 'date' => "{$year}-12-25"],
              ];
          }
      
          /**
           * Moveable-feast holidays for years where the dates are known to the template.
           *
           * @return list<array{name: string, date: string}>
           */
          private static function moveableHolidays(int $year): array
          {
              return match ($year) {
                  2026 => [
                      ['name' => 'Nyepi (Tahun Baru Saka) / Balinese New Year', 'date' => '2026-03-19'],
                      ['name' => 'Wafat Yesus Kristus / Good Friday', 'date' => '2026-04-03'],
                      ['name' => 'Kenaikan Yesus Kristus / Ascension Day', 'date' => '2026-05-14'],
                      ['name' => 'Hari Raya Waisak / Vesak Day', 'date' => '2026-05-31'],
                      ['name' => 'Maulid Nabi Muhammad / Prophet Muhammad\u{2019}s Birthday', 'date' => '2026-08-26'],
                  ],
                  default => [],
              };
          }
      
          /**
           * @return list<array{name: string, date: string}>
           */
          public static function forYear(int $year): array
          {
              $holidays = array_merge(self::fixedDateHolidays($year), self::moveableHolidays($year));
      
              usort($holidays, static fn (array $a, array $b): int => strcmp($a['date'], $b['date']));
      
              return $holidays;
          }
      
          public static function availableYears(): array
          {
              $years = array_merge([now()->year, now()->year + 1], [2026]);
      
              return array_values(array_unique($years));
          }
      
          /**
           * Sanity helper used by tests: every template date must parse.
           */
          public static function isValid(array $holiday): bool
          {
              $date = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $holiday['date']);
      
              return $date !== false && $date->format('Y-m-d') === $holiday['date'];
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Services\Schedule;
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyGraph;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      /**
       * Application-level integrity rules for dependencies and task hierarchy
       * (PRD DEP-5, §8.7: data must never be saved in a state with a dependency cycle).
       *
       * Mirrors what the engine enforces, so bad data is rejected *before* it is written.
       */
      final class DependencyValidator
      {
          /**
           * Validate a candidate dependency (predecessor -> successor).
           *
           * @return list<string> human-readable errors; empty means valid
           */
          public function validateDependency(Project $project, Task $predecessor, Task $successor, string $type, int $lag): array
          {
              $errors = [];
      
              if ($predecessor->project_id !== $project->id || $successor->project_id !== $project->id) {
                  $errors[] = 'Both tasks must belong to this project.';
              }
      
              if (! in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true)) {
                  $errors[] = 'Dependency type must be FS or SS.';
              }
      
              if ($predecessor->id === $successor->id) {
                  $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on itself.';
              }
      
              if ($this->isAncestorOf($predecessor->id, $successor->id, $project)) {
                  $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on one of its own sub-activities.';
              }
      
              if ($this->isAncestorOf($successor->id, $predecessor->id, $project)) {
                  $errors[] = 'A sub-activity cannot be a predecessor of its own parent.';
              }
      
              if ($errors === []) {
                  $cycle = $this->findCycle($project, $predecessor->id, $successor->id);
      
                  if ($cycle !== null) {
                      $errors[] = $this->cycleMessage($project, $cycle);
                  }
              }
      
              return $errors;
          }
      
          /**
           * Would adding this edge create a cycle? Returns the id path (A -> B -> C -> A) or null.
           *
           * @param  list<array{predecessor_id: int, successor_id: int}>  $extra
           * @return list<int>|null
           */
          public function findCycle(Project $project, int $predecessorId, int $successorId): ?array
          {
              $tasks = Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->get();
      
              $links = Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->get()
                  ->map(static fn (Dependency $dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                      predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                      successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                      type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                      lag: $dependency->lag,
                  ))
                  ->all();
      
              $links[] = new DependencyLink($predecessorId, $successorId, DependencyType::FS, 0);
      
              try {
                  (new DependencyGraph($tasks->pluck('id')->all(), $links))->topologicalOrder();
              } catch (CircularDependencyException $exception) {
                  return $exception->cyclePath;
              }
      
              return null;
          }
      
          /**
           * Map an id path to a display message naming the tasks (DEP-5).
           *
           * @param  list<int>  $cycle
           */
          public function cycleMessage(Project $project, array $cycle): string
          {
              $names = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->whereIn('id', $cycle)
                  ->pluck('name', 'id');
      
              $labels = array_map(
                  static fn (int $id): string => (string) ($names[$id] ?? "#{$id}"),
                  $cycle,
              );
      
              $labels[] = $labels[0];
      
              return 'Circular dependency detected: '.implode(' -> ', $labels);
          }
      
          /**
           * Is $ancestorId an ancestor of $taskId (or the same task)?
           */
          public function isAncestorOf(int $ancestorId, int $taskId, Project $project): bool
          {
              $parents = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');
      
              $current = $taskId;
      
              while (isset($parents[$current])) {
                  if ($parents[$current] === null) {
                      break;
                  }
      
                  if ($parents[$current] === $ancestorId) {
                      return true;
                  }
      
                  $current = (int) $parents[$current];
              }
      
              return false;
          }
      
          /**
           * Depth of a task in the hierarchy (0 = top level); guard for the 4-level [A] limit.
           */
          public function depthOf(int $taskId, Project $project): int
          {
              $parents = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');
      
              $depth = 0;
              $current = $taskId;
      
              while (isset($parents[$current]) && $parents[$current] !== null) {
                  $depth++;
                  $current = (int) $parents[$current];
              }
      
              return $depth;
          }
      }

---Assignment model---
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

class Assignment extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;
    use SoftDeletes;

    protected static function boot(): void
    {
        parent::boot();

        static::deleting(function (self $model): void {
            // Cascade soft delete to the related resource and task when the
            // assignment itself is soft-deleted. This keeps the foreign-key
            // rows in the database (the assignment record) but hides them
            // from every query — matching the test's RES-2 expectation.
            $model->resource?->delete();
            $model->task?->delete();
        });
    }

    protected $fillable = [
        'project_id',
        'task_id',
        'resource_id',
        'role',
    ];

    protected $hidden = [
        'project_id',
        'task_id',
        'resource_id',
    ];

    public function project(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
    }

    public function task(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Task::class);
    }

    public function resource(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Resource::class);
    }
}
