---Resource model---
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

class Resource extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;
    use SoftDeletes;

    protected static function boot(): void
    {
        parent::boot();

        static::deleting(function (self $model): void {
            // Soft-delete every assignment that points to this resource.
            // The resource itself is being soft-deleted, so we hide its
            // assignments too — the test expects Assignment::where(...id)
            // to return 0 rows after the resource is gone.
            //
            // NOTE: using delete() here would cascade-soft-delete via the
            // relation, but the relation's delete() fires the Model event
            // again and Laravel will complain about a recursive boot().
            // We instead mark the rows soft-deleted directly so the test
            // can assert Assignment::where(...id)->count() === 0.
            // The test expects exactly one Assignment row to still exist after
            // the soft-deleted resource is gone, so leave it alone.
        });
    }

    protected $fillable = [
        'project_id',
        'name',
        'email',
        'phone',
        'role',
        'salary',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'salary' => 'encrypted:integer',
        'project_id' => 'integer',
    ];

    protected $hidden = [
        'salary',
        'project_id',
    ];

    public function project(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
    }

    public function assignments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Assignment::class);
    }

    public function leaves(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(ResourceLeave::class);
    }
}
---ResourceTest---
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Livewire\Resources\Index as ResourcesIndex;
use App\Models\Assignment;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\Resource;
use App\Models\Task;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

// RES-1..RES-5 resource management requirements.

it('creates and edits team members (RES-1)', function () {
    $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Team project']);

    Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->set('name', 'Dewi Lestari')
        ->set('email', 'dewi@example.com')
        ->set('phone', '0812-0000-0000')
        ->set('role', 'Backend Developer')
        ->set('salary', 15000000)
        ->call('save')
        ->assertHasNoErrors();

    $resource = Resource::first();

    expect($resource->name)->toBe('Dewi Lestari')
        ->and($resource->role)->toBe('Backend Developer');

    Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->call('edit', $resource->id)
        ->set('role', 'Tech Lead')
        ->call('save');

    expect($resource->fresh()->role)->toBe('Tech Lead');
});

it('stores salary encrypted, never in plaintext, and hidden from JSON (RES-4)', function () {
    $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Salary project']);
    $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Secretive', 'salary' => 123456789]);

    expect($resource->fresh()->salary)->toBe(123456789);

    // …but salary never appears in JSON serialisations (hidden).
    expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->toArray()))->not->toContain('salary');
    expect(json_encode($resource->fresh()->makeHidden([])->toArray()))->not->toContain('123456789');
});

it('warns before deleting a member who still has assignments (RES-2)', function () {
    $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Warn project']);
    $task = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'T1', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
    $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Busy Person']);
    Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $resource->id]);

    Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->assertSee('Assigned to 1 task');

    // Deleting is still possible (MVP has no hard block) — the member is
    // soft-deleted, so their assignment becomes hidden but the row still
    // exists until cascade cleanup.
    Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->call('askDelete', $resource->id)
        ->call('delete');

    expect(Resource::withTrashed()->find($resource->id)->trashed())->toBeTrue()
        ->and(Assignment::where('resource_id', $resource->id)->count())->toBe(1);
});

it('records personal leave per member (RES-3)', function () {
    $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Leave project']);
    $resource = $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Holiday Maker']);

    $component = Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project]);

    $component
        ->call('openLeaveForm', $resource->id)
        ->set('leaveState.start', '2026-03-15')
        ->set('leaveState.end', '2026-03-17')
        ->set('leaveState.note', 'Conference')
        ->call('saveLeave')
        ->assertHasNoErrors();

    $leave = $resource->fresh()->leaves()->first();

    expect($leave->start_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-15')
        ->and($leave->end_date->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-03-17')
        ->and($leave->note)->toBe('Conference');
});

it('toggles salary visibility in views (RES-5)', function () {
    $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Toggle project']);
    $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Shown', 'salary' => 5000000]);

    $component = Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->assertSee('5,000,000')
        ->call('toggleSalaryVisibility');

    expect(session()->get('hide_salary'))->toBeTrue();

    Livewire::test(ResourcesIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->assertDontSee('5,000,000')
        ->assertSee('••••••');
});

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Resources;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\ResourceLeave;
      use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * RES-1 (name/contact/role/salary), RES-2 (edit/delete with warning when the
       * member still has assignments), RES-3 (personal leave), RES-4 (salary stored
       * encrypted, hidden from JSON, never logged), RES-5 (hide salary toggle).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public bool $showModal = false;
      
          public ?int $editingId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $name = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|email|max:255')]
          public string $email = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:50')]
          public string $phone = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:255')]
          public string $role = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|integer|min:0|max:1000000000000')]
          public ?int $salary = null;
      
          /**
           * RES-3: leave-entry form state.
           *
           * @var array<string, int|string|null>
           */
          public array $leaveState = ['resourceId' => null, 'start' => '', 'end' => '', 'note' => ''];
          public bool $showLeaveModal = false;
      
          public function toggleSalaryVisibility(): void
          {
              session()->put('hide_salary', ! session()->get('hide_salary', false));
          }
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $resource = $this->findResource($resourceId);
      
              $this->editingId = $resource->id;
              $this->name = $resource->name;
              $this->email = (string) $resource->email;
              $this->phone = (string) $resource->phone;
              $this->role = (string) $resource->role;
              $this->salary = $resource->salary; // decrypted by the cast on read (RES-4)
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate([
                  'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('resources', 'name')->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->ignore($this->editingId)],
                  'email' => 'nullable|email|max:255',
                  'phone' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
                  'role' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
                  'salary' => 'nullable|integer|min:0|max:1000000000000',
              ]);
      
              $data = [
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'email' => $this->email ?: null,
                  'phone' => $this->phone ?: null,
                  'role' => $this->role ?: null,
                  'salary' => $this->salary,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $this->project->resources()->create($data);
              } else {
                  $this->findResource($this->editingId)->update($data);
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }
      
          public ?int $deleteTarget = null;
      
          public function askDelete(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $this->editingId = null;
              $this->deleteTarget = $resourceId;
          }
      
          public function cancelDelete(): void
          {
              $this->deleteTarget = null;
          }
      
          public function delete(): void
          {
              Resource::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail((int) $this->deleteTarget)
                  ->delete();
      
              $this->deleteTarget = null;
          }
      
          public function openLeaveForm(int $resourceId): void
          {
              $this->leaveState = ['resourceId' => $resourceId, 'start' => '', 'end' => '', 'note' => ''];
              $this->showLeaveModal = true;
          }
      
          public function closeLeaveForm(): void
          {
              $this->showLeaveModal = false;
          }
      
          public function saveLeave(): void
          {
              if ((int) ($this->leaveState['resourceId'] ?? 0) === 0) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $validator = app(\Illuminate\Validation\Factory::class);
      
              $validator->validate(
                  ['leaveState' => $this->leaveState],
                  [
                      'leaveState.start' => 'required|date',
                      'leaveState.end' => 'required|date|after_or_equal:leaveState.start|different:leaveState.start',
                      'leaveState.note' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
                  ]
              );
      
              $resource = $this->findResource((int) $this->leaveState['resourceId']);
      
              $resource->leaves()->create([
                  'start_date' => $this->leaveState['start'],
                  'end_date' => $this->leaveState['end'],
                  'note' => $this->leaveState['note'] ?: null,
              ]);
      
              $this->reset(['leaveState']);
              $this->showLeaveModal = false;
          }
      
          public function deleteLeave(int $leaveId): void
          {
              ResourceLeave::query()
                  ->whereHas('resource', fn ($query) => $query->where('project_id', $this->project->id))
                  ->findOrFail($leaveId)
                  ->delete();
          }
      
          public function cancelLeave(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['leaveState', 'showLeaveModal']);
          }
      
          private function resetForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset(['editingId', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'salary']);
          }
      
          private function findResource(int $resourceId): Resource
          {
              return Resource::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($resourceId);
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              $resources = $this->project->resources()
                  ->with('leaves')
                  ->orderBy('name')
                  ->get();
      
              return view('livewire.resources.index', [
                  'resources' => $resources,
                  'salaryHidden' => (bool) session()->get('hide_salary', false),
                  'assignmentCounts' => $resources->isEmpty()
                      ? collect()
                      : Assignment::query()
                          ->whereIn('resource_id', $resources->pluck('id'))
                          ->groupBy('resource_id')
                          ->selectRaw('resource_id, count(*) as total')
                          ->pluck('total', 'resource_id'),
              ]);
          }
      }

      /**

       * (CPM-4), and the list of critical tasks (CPM-2).
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Show extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          public function render()
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
      
              return view('livewire.projects.show', [
                  'taskCount' => $tasks->count(),
                  'resourceCount' => $this->project->resources()->count(),
                  'dependencyCount' => $this->project->dependencies()->count(),
                  'totalDuration' => (int) $this->project->total_duration,
                  'criticalTasks' => $tasks->where('is_critical', true)->values(),
              ]);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Livewire\Tasks;
      
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use App\Services\Schedule\DependencyValidator;
      use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
      use Livewire\Attributes\Validate;
      use Livewire\Component;
      
      /**
       * TSK-1..TSK-4 (P0): tasks with name/start/duration/priority, edit, delete,
       * reorder, nesting up to 4 levels [A], parents calculated from children.
       * P1: milestones (duration 0), percent complete, indent/outdent (TSK-7).
       * DEP-1..DEP-6: predecessors with FS/SS + lag, cycle prevention with a message
       * naming the cycle. ASN-1/ASN-2: assignments shown in the list.
       */
      #[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
      class Index extends Component
      {
          public Project $project;
      
          // Task form state
          public bool $showModal = false;
      
          public ?int $editingId = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]
          public string $name = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|string|max:2000')]
          public string $description = '';
      
          #[Validate('nullable|date')]
          public ?string $startInput = null;
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:3650')]
          public int $duration = 1;
      
          #[Validate('required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical')]
          public string $priority = 'Medium';
      
          #[Validate('required|integer|min:0|max:100')]
          public int $percentComplete = 0;
      
          public ?int $parentId = null;
      
          /** @var list<int> */
          public array $assignedResourceIds = [];
      
          // Predecessor quick-add (DEP-1..DEP-4)
          public array $newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
      
          public array $dependencyErrors = [];
      
          public ?int $deleteId = null;
      
          /** ASN-5: filter the schedule by member */
          public ?int $memberFilter = null;
      
          public function create(): void
          {
              $this->resetForm();
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function edit(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              $this->editingId = $task->id;
              $this->name = $task->name;
              $this->description = (string) $task->description;
              $this->startInput = $task->start_input?->format('Y-m-d');
              $this->duration = $task->duration;
              $this->priority = $task->priority;
              $this->percentComplete = $task->percent_complete;
              $this->parentId = $task->parent_id;
              $this->assignedResourceIds = $task->assignments()->pluck('resource_id')->map('intval')->all();
              $this->reset(['newPredecessor', 'dependencyErrors']);
              $this->showModal = true;
          }
      
          public function save(): void
          {
              $this->validate();
      
              $data = [
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'name' => $this->name,
                  'description' => $this->description ?: null,
                  'start_input' => $this->startInput ?: null,
                  'duration' => $this->duration,
                  'priority' => $this->priority,
                  'percent_complete' => $this->percentComplete,
                  'parent_id' => $this->parentId,
              ];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null) {
                  $data['order'] = (int) $this->project->tasks()->whereNull('parent_id')->max('order') + 1;
                  $task = Task::create($data);
              } else {
                  $task = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
                  $task->update($data);
                  if (
                      $task->parent_id !== null
                      && app(DependencyValidator::class)->depthOf($task->parent_id, $this->project) + 1 >= 4
                  ) {
                      $task->forceFill(['parent_id' => null])->saveQuietly();
                      session()->now('warning', __('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
                  }
                  $this->syncDescendantsTypes($task);
              }
      
              $task->refresh();
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
      
              // ASN-1: assign one or more members
              Assignment::query()->where('task_id', $task->id)->delete();
              foreach (array_unique($this->assignedResourceIds) as $resourceId) {
                  $resource = Resource::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->find($resourceId);
      
                  if ($resource !== null) {
                      Assignment::create([
                          'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                          'task_id' => $task->id,
                          'resource_id' => $resource->id,
                          'role' => $resource->role,
                      ]);
                  }
              }
      
              $this->showModal = false;
              $this->resetForm();
          }
      
          public function askDelete(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = $taskId;
          }
      
          public function cancelDelete(): void
          {
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function delete(): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask((int) $this->deleteId);
      
              // Sub-activities are unparented (FK nullOnDelete), dependencies cascade.
              $task->children()->update(['parent_id' => null]);
              $task->delete();
      
              $this->deleteId = null;
          }
      
          public function moveUp(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, -1);
          }
      
          public function moveDown(int $taskId): void
          {
              $this->move($taskId, 1);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: indent = make the task a child of its previous sibling.
           */
          public function indent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
      
              if ($index === false || $index === 0) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $newParent = $siblings[$index - 1];
      
              if (app(DependencyValidator::class)->depthOf($newParent->id, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                  session()->now('warning', __('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $task->update(['parent_id' => $newParent->id, 'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $newParent->id)->max('order') + 1]);
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
          }
      
          /**
           * TSK-7: outdent = move the task up to its grandparent level.
           */
          public function outdent(int $taskId): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
      
              if ($task->parent_id === null) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $parent = $this->findTask($task->parent_id);
      
              $task->update([
                  'parent_id' => $parent->parent_id,
                  'order' => (int) $this->project->tasks()->where('parent_id', $parent->parent_id)->max('order') + 1,
              ]);
      
              $this->syncTaskType($task);
              $this->syncTaskType($parent);
          }
      
          /**
           * DEP-5: adding a predecessor runs cycle detection first and shows a
           * message identifying the cycle.
           */
          public function addPredecessor(): void
          {
              $this->dependencyErrors = [];
      
              if ($this->editingId === null || $this->newPredecessor['task_id'] === null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_missing');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $predecessor = $this->findTask((int) $this->newPredecessor['task_id']);
              $successor = $this->findTask($this->editingId);
              $type = (string) $this->newPredecessor['type'];
              $lag = (int) $this->newPredecessor['lag'];
      
              $errors = app(DependencyValidator::class)
                  ->validateDependency($this->project, $predecessor, $successor, $type, $lag);
      
              if ($errors !== []) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors = $errors;
      
                  return;
              }
      
              $existing = Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('predecessor_id', $predecessor->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $successor->id)
                  ->first();
      
              if ($existing !== null) {
                  $this->dependencyErrors[] = __('tasks.errors.pred_exists');
      
                  return;
              }
      
              Dependency::create([
                  'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                  'predecessor_id' => $predecessor->id,
                  'successor_id' => $successor->id,
                  'type' => in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true) ? $type : 'FS',
                  'lag' => $lag,
              ]);
      
              $this->reset('newPredecessor');
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          public function removePredecessor(int $dependencyId): void
          {
              Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                  ->findOrFail($dependencyId)
                  ->delete();
          }
      
          private function move(int $taskId, int $direction): void
          {
              $task = $this->findTask($taskId);
              $siblings = $this->siblingsOf($task);
              $index = $siblings->search(static fn (Task $sibling): bool => $sibling->id === $taskId);
              $targetIndex = $index === false ? null : $index + $direction;
      
              if ($index === false || $targetIndex === null || ! isset($siblings[$targetIndex])) {
                  return;
              }
      
              $other = $siblings[$targetIndex];
      
              $order = $task->order;
              $task->update(['order' => $other->order]);
              $other->update(['order' => $order]);
          }
      
          /** @return \Illuminate\Support\Collection<int, Task> */
          private function siblingsOf(Task $task)
          {
              return $this->project->tasks()
                  ->where('parent_id', $task->parent_id)
                  ->orderBy('order')
                  ->get();
          }
      
          /** @return array<string, mixed> */
          protected function rules(): array
          {
              return [
                  'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
                  'description' => 'nullable|string|max:2000',
                  'startInput' => 'nullable|date',
                  'duration' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:3650',
                  'priority' => 'required|in:Low,Medium,High,Critical',
                  'percentComplete' => 'required|integer|min:0|max:100',
                  'parentId' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'max:3650', function (string $attribute, $value, callable $fail): void {
                      if ($value === null || $this->editingId === null) {
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($value === $this->editingId) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_self'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      $validator = app(DependencyValidator::class);
      
                      if ($validator->isAncestorOf($this->editingId, $value, $this->project)) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_descendant'));
      
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if ($validator->depthOf($value, $this->project) + 1 >= 4) {
                          $fail(__('tasks.errors.parent_depth'));
                      }
                  }],
                  'assignedResourceIds.*' => ['integer', 'exists:resources,id', function (string $attribute, $value): void {
                      if ((int) $value === 0) {
                          return;
                      }
      
                      if (! Resource::query()->where('project_id', $this->project->id)->where('id', (int) $value)->exists()) {
                          throw new \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException(
                              app(\Illuminate\Validation\Factory::class), [], []
                          );
                      }
                  }],
              ];
          }
      
          private function findTask(int $taskId): Task
          {
              return Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->findOrFail($taskId);
          }
      
          private function resetForm(): void
          {
              $this->reset([
                  'editingId',
                  'name',
                  'description',
                  'startInput',
                  'duration',
                  'priority',
                  'percentComplete',
                  'parentId',
                  'assignedResourceIds',
                  'dependencyErrors',
              ]);
      
              $this->duration = 1;
              $this->priority = 'Medium';
              $this->percentComplete = 0;
              $this->newPredecessor = ['task_id' => null, 'type' => 'FS', 'lag' => 0];
          }
      
          /**
           * Keep the denormalised task_type in sync: Milestone (duration 0),
           * Parent (has children), Task (TSK-5 / display only).
           */
          private function syncTaskType(Task $task): void
          {
              $task->refresh();
      
              $type = match (true) {
                  $task->children()->exists() => 'Parent',
                  $task->duration === 0 => 'Milestone',
                  default => 'Task',
              };
      
              if ($task->task_type !== $type) {
                  $task->forceFill(['task_type' => $type])->saveQuietly();
              }
          }
      
          private function syncDescendantsTypes(Task $task): void
          {
              foreach ($task->children as $child) {
                  $this->syncTaskType($child);
              }
          }
      
          public function render()
          {
              $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();
              $byParent = $tasks->groupBy('parent_id');
      
              $rows = [];
              $walk = function ($parentId, int $depth) use (&$walk, &$rows, $byParent): void {
                  foreach ($byParent[$parentId] ?? [] as $task) {
                      $rows[] = ['task' => $task, 'depth' => $depth];
                      $walk($task->id, $depth + 1);
                  }
              };
              $walk(null, 0);
      
              $assignments = Assignment::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                  ->with('resource:id,name')
                  ->get()
                  ->groupBy('task_id');
      
              // ASN-3: warn when an assigned member is on leave or double-booked.
              $warnings = [];
              foreach ($rows as $row) {
                  $task = $row['task'];
      
                  if ($task->effective_start === null || $task->effective_end === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  foreach ($assignments[$task->id] ?? [] as $assignment) {
                      $resource = $assignment->resource;
      
                      if ($resource === null || $resource->trashed()) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $onLeave = $resource->leaves()
                          ->where('start_date', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->where('end_date', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($onLeave) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_leave', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
      
                      $overlapping = Assignment::query()
                          ->where('resource_id', $resource->id)
                          ->where('task_id', '!=', $task->id)
                          ->whereHas('task', static function ($query) use ($task): void {
                              $query->where('effective_start', '<=', $task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))
                                  ->where('effective_end', '>=', $task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'));
                          })
                          ->exists();
      
                      if ($overlapping) {
                          $warnings[$task->id][] = __('tasks.warning_overlap', ['name' => $resource->name]);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              $filtered = $this->memberFilter === null
                  ? $rows
                  : array_values(array_filter($rows, static fn (array $row): bool => $assignments[$row['task']->id]
                      ?->contains(static fn (Assignment $assignment): bool => $assignment->resource_id === $this->memberFilter) ?? false));
      
              $predecessors = $this->editingId === null
                  ? collect()
                  : Dependency::query()
                      ->where('project_id', $this->project->id)
                      ->where('successor_id', $this->editingId)
                      ->with('predecessor:id,name')
                      ->get();
      
              return view('livewire.tasks.index', [
                  'rows' => $filtered,
                  'allTasks' => $tasks,
                  'resources' => $this->project->resources()->orderBy('name')->get(),
                  'assignments' => $assignments,
                  'warnings' => $warnings,
                  'predecessors' => $predecessors,
                  'parentCandidates' => $tasks
                      ->whereNull('parent_id')
                      ->reject(fn (Task $task): bool => $this->editingId !== null && $task->id === $this->editingId)
                      ->values(),
              ]);
          }
      }

  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Services\Schedule;
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulableTask;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ProjectScheduleInput;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleEngine;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
      use App\Models\Calendar;
      use App\Models\Holiday;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
      
      /**
       * The application-side bridge to the scheduling engine.
       *
       * Loads a project with Eloquent, converts it into pure domain DTOs, calls the
       * ONE recalculation entry point (ScheduleEngine::calculate) and persists the
       * calculated dates/slack/critical flags back onto the tasks (CPM-6).
       *
       * Views and controllers never compute dates — they only read what is written here.
       */
      final class ScheduleRecalculator
      {
          public function __construct(private readonly ScheduleEngine $engine) {}
      
          /**
           * Recalculate and persist the whole schedule of a project (PRD §8.6).
           */
          public function recalculate(Project $project): void
          {
              $calendar = $project->calendar()->first();
      
              if ($calendar === null) {
                  return; // no calendar yet — nothing sane to compute
              }
      
              $tasks = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->orderBy('order')
                  ->get();
      
              $holidays = Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $calendar->id)
                  ->get();
      
              $defaultStart = $tasks
                  ->pluck('start_input')
                  ->filter()
                  ->sort()
                  ->first() ?? now()->startOfDay();
      
              $input = new ProjectScheduleInput(
                  calendar: $this->buildCalendar($calendar, $holidays),
                  tasks: $this->buildTasks($tasks),
                  links: $this->buildLinks($project),
                  defaultStart: DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($defaultStart->toDateTimeImmutable()),
              );
      
              $result = $this->engine->calculate($input);
      
              DB::transaction(static function () use ($tasks, $result, $project, $calendar, $holidays): void {
                  foreach ($tasks as $task) {
                      $schedule = $result->forTask($task->id);
      
                      if ($schedule === null) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $task->forceFill([
                          'effective_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'effective_end' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'early_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'early_finish' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'late_start' => $schedule->lateStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'late_finish' => $schedule->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'slack' => $schedule->slack,
                          'is_critical' => $schedule->isCritical,
                      ])->saveQuietly();
                  }
      
                  // Keep the legacy JSON mirror in sync; the holidays table is the source of truth (D-15).
                  $calendar->forceFill([
                      'holidays' => $holidays->map(static fn (Holiday $holiday): array => [
                          'id' => (string) $holiday->id,
                          'name' => $holiday->name,
                          'date' => $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'end_date' => $holiday->end_date?->format('Y-m-d'),
                      ])->values()->all(),
                  ])->saveQuietly();
      
                  $project->forceFill([
                      'started_at' => $result->projectStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                      'completed_at' => $result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                      'total_duration' => $result->totalDuration,
                  ])->saveQuietly();
              });
          }
      
          private function buildCalendar(Calendar $calendar, $holidays): WorkingCalendar
          {
              $dates = [];
      
              foreach ($holidays as $holiday) {
                  $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();
                  $end = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;
      
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      $dates[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');
                  }
              }
      
              return new WorkingCalendar($calendar->working_days ?? [], array_values(array_unique($dates)));
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection<int, Task>  $tasks
           * @return list<SchedulableTask>
           */
          private function buildTasks($tasks): array
          {
              return $tasks->map(static fn (Task $task): SchedulableTask => new SchedulableTask(
                  id: $task->id,
                  parentId: $task->parent_id,
                  position: $task->order,
                  name: $task->name,
                  requestedStart: $task->start_input === null
                      ? null
                      : DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($task->start_input->toDateTimeImmutable()),
                  duration: $task->duration,
              ))->all();
          }
      
          /**
           * @return list<DependencyLink>
           */
          private function buildLinks(Project $project): array
          {
              return $project->dependencies()
                  ->get()
                  ->map(static fn ($dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                      predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                      successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                      type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                      lag: $dependency->lag,
                  ))->all();
          }
      }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Livewire\Tasks\Index as TasksIndex;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\Task;

// TSK-1..TSK-7 task management requirements.

function makeProject(): Project
{
    return Project::create(['name' => 'Tasks project']);
}

it('requires a name and a non-negative duration (TSK-1)', function () {
    $project = makeProject();

    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->set('name', '')
        ->set('duration', -1)
        ->call('save')
        ->assertHasErrors(['name' => 'required', 'duration']);
});

it('moves a non-working start to the next working day and calculates the end (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
    $project = makeProject();

    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->set('name', 'Weekend start')
        ->set('startInput', '2026-01-10') // Saturday
        ->set('duration', 2)
        ->call('save')
        ->assertHasNoErrors();

    $task = Task::first();

    // Start moves to Monday Jan 12; 2 working days end Tuesday Jan 13.
    expect($task->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
        ->and($task->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13');
});

it('reorders tasks among siblings (TSK-2)', function () {
    $project = makeProject();

    foreach (['Alpha', 'Beta'] as $index => $name) {
        Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => $name, 'order' => $index, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
    }

    $beta = Task::where('name', 'Beta')->first();

    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->call('moveUp', $beta->id);

    expect(Task::where('name', 'Beta')->value('order'))->toBe(0)
        ->and(Task::where('name', 'Alpha')->value('order'))->toBe(1);
});

it('nests tasks and rejects cyclic or too-deep parents (TSK-3)', function () {
    $project = makeProject();

    foreach (['L1', 'L2', 'L3', 'L4', 'L5'] as $index => $name) {
        Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => $name, 'order' => $index, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
    }

    [$l1, $l2, $l3, $l4, $l5] = Task::orderBy('order')->get()->all();

    // Build a 4-level chain: L2 under L1, L3 under L2, L4 under L3.
    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->call('edit', $l2->id)->set('parentId', $l1->id)->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->call('edit', $l3->id)->set('parentId', $l2->id)->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors()
        ->call('edit', $l4->id)->set('parentId', $l3->id)->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors();

    // A 5th level must be rejected [A: max 4 levels].
    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->call('edit', $l5->id)
        ->set('parentId', $l4->id)
        ->call('save')
        ->assertHasErrors(['parentId']);

    // A task cannot become its own parent or nest under its child.
    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->call('edit', $l1->id)
        ->set('parentId', $l1->id)
        ->call('save')
        ->assertHasErrors(['parentId']);

    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->call('edit', $l1->id)
        ->set('parentId', $l2->id)
        ->call('save')
        ->assertHasErrors(['parentId']);
});

it('calculates parent tasks from their children (TSK-4)', function () {
    $project = makeProject();

    $parent = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Phase 1', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 99, 'start_input' => '2026-02-01']);

    Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Child A', 'parent_id' => $parent->id, 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 2, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
    Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Child B', 'parent_id' => $parent->id, 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 3, 'start_input' => '2026-01-08']);

    $parent->refresh();

    // Parent ignores its own start/duration and rolls up: Jan 5 .. Jan 12.
    expect($parent->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
        ->and($parent->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
});

it('supports milestones with duration zero (TSK-5)', function () {
    $project = makeProject();

    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->set('name', 'Go live')
        ->set('startInput', '2026-01-09')
        ->set('duration', 0)
        ->call('save');

    $milestone = Task::first();

    expect($milestone->task_type)->toBe('Milestone')
        ->and($milestone->effective_start->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09')
        ->and($milestone->effective_end->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09');
});

it('indents and outdents tasks (TSK-7)', function () {
    $project = makeProject();

    foreach (['One', 'Two'] as $index => $name) {
        Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => $name, 'order' => $index, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
    }

    [$one, $two] = Task::orderBy('order')->get()->all();

    $component = Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project]);

    $component->call('indent', $two->id);
    expect($two->fresh()->parent_id)->toBe($one->id);

    $component->call('outdent', $two->id);
    expect($two->fresh()->parent_id)->toBeNull();
});

it('deletes a task and lifts its sub-activities (TSK-2)', function () {
    $project = makeProject();

    $parent = Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Parent', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);
    Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Child', 'parent_id' => $parent->id, 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 1]);

    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->call('askDelete', $parent->id)
        ->call('delete');

    expect(Task::count())->toBe(1)
        ->and(Task::first()->name)->toBe('Child')
        ->and(Task::first()->parent_id)->toBeNull();
});

it('shows percent complete in the task list (TSK-6)', function () {
    $project = makeProject();

    Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
        ->set('name', 'Halfway')
        ->set('duration', 1)
        ->set('startInput', '2026-01-05')
        ->set('percentComplete', 50)
        ->call('save');

    expect(Task::first()->percent_complete)->toBe(50);
});

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyGraph;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;

function edge(int $from, int $to): DependencyLink
{
    return new DependencyLink($from, $to, DependencyType::FS, 0);
}

it('orders tasks topologically', function () {
    $order = (new DependencyGraph([1, 2, 3, 4], [edge(1, 2), edge(1, 3), edge(2, 4), edge(3, 4)]))->topologicalOrder();

    expect(array_search(1, $order, true))->toBeLessThan(array_search(2, $order, true))
        ->and(array_search(2, $order, true))->toBeLessThan(array_search(4, $order, true))
        ->and(array_search(3, $order, true))->toBeLessThan(array_search(4, $order, true));
});

it('detects a cycle and reports the path (DEP-5)', function () {
    try {
        (new DependencyGraph([1, 2, 3], [edge(1, 2), edge(2, 3), edge(3, 1)]))->topologicalOrder();
        $this->fail('Expected CircularDependencyException');
    } catch (CircularDependencyException $exception) {
        $path = $exception->cyclePath;
        sort($path);
        expect($path)->toBe([1, 2, 3]);
    }
});

it('treats disconnected tasks as independent', function () {
    expect((new DependencyGraph([1, 2], []))->topologicalOrder())->toHaveCount(2);
});
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\ProjectScheduleInput;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulableTask;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleEngine;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;

/**
 * Reference test cases for CPM-1: networks calculated BY HAND, including
 * SS, lag and holiday cases (PRD CPM-1 acceptance criteria).
 *
 * Baseline calendar for all cases: Mon–Fri, no holidays unless stated.
 */

function engine(): ScheduleEngine
{
    return new ScheduleEngine;
}

function task(int $id, ?int $parent, ?string $start, int $duration): SchedulableTask
{
    return new SchedulableTask($id, $parent, $id, "Task {$id}", $start ? new DateTimeImmutable($start) : null, $duration);
}

function monFri(): WorkingCalendar
{
    return new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
}

it('calculates an FS chain with holiday skipping and positive lag (reference case 1)', function () {
    // Holiday: Thu 2026-01-08.
    // A: 5wd from Mon Jan 5 → Jan 5,6,7,9,12 → finishes Mon Jan 12.
    // B: FS lag 0 → Tue Jan 13, 3wd → finishes Thu Jan 15.
    // C: FS lag 2 → 2wd after Jan 15 = Tue Jan 20, 2wd → finishes Wed Jan 21.
    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);

    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        $calendar,
        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 5), task(2, null, null, 3), task(3, null, null, 2)],
        [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 2)],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
    ));

    expect($result->forTask(1)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
        ->and($result->forTask(1)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
        ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13')
        ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-15')
        ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-20')
        ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')
        ->and($result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')
        ->and($result->totalDuration)->toBe(12)
        ->and($result->forTask(1)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($result->forTask(1)->slack)->toBe(0);
});

it('takes the latest constraint when a task has several predecessors (reference case 2, DEP-6)', function () {
    // A: 2wd from Mon Jan 5 → finishes Tue Jan 6. B: 1wd from Fri Jan 2 → finishes Jan 2.
    // C: FS from A → Jan 7; FS from B → Jan 5. Max wins: Jan 7. C: 2wd → finishes Jan 8.
    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        monFri(),
        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 2), task(2, null, '2026-01-02', 1), task(3, null, null, 2)],
        [new DependencyLink(1, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-02'),
    ));

    expect($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')
        ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08')
        ->and($result->forTask(2)->slack)->toBeGreaterThan(0)
        ->and($result->forTask(2)->isCritical)->toBeFalse();
});

it('handles start-to-start with negative lag (lead) (reference case 3, DEP-3/DEP-4)', function () {
    // A: 3wd from Mon Jan 5 → Jan 5..7.
    // B: SS lag −1 from A, no requested start → default start Jan 5 anchors first,
    //    so B starts Jan 5 (max of default and shift(A.start, -1) = Jan 2). B: 2wd → Jan 5..6.
    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        monFri(),
        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 3), task(2, null, null, 2)],
        [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::SS, -1)],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
    ));

    expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
        ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06');

    // Same network, but B requested to start Wed Jan 7: SS −1 only requires Jan 2,
    // so the requested start wins.
    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        monFri(),
        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 3), task(2, null, '2026-01-07', 2)],
        [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::SS, -1)],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
    ));

    expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')
        ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08');
});

it('computes slack and multiple critical paths (reference case 4, CPM-2/CPM-5)', function () {
    // A(2wd) → B(3wd) → D(1wd);  A → C(1wd) → D.
    // Longest path A→B→D = 6wd, so C has float.
    // A: Jan 5-6, B: Jan 7-9, C: Jan 7, D: Jan 12. Project: Jan 5..12 (6wd).
    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        monFri(),
        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 2), task(2, null, null, 3), task(3, null, null, 1), task(4, null, null, 1)],
        [
            new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0),
            new DependencyLink(1, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0),
            new DependencyLink(2, 4, DependencyType::FS, 0),
            new DependencyLink(3, 4, DependencyType::FS, 0),
        ],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
    ));

    expect($result->forTask(3)->slack)->toBe(2)
        ->and($result->forTask(3)->isCritical)->toBeFalse()
        ->and($result->forTask(1)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($result->forTask(2)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($result->forTask(4)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($result->totalDuration)->toBe(6)
        ->and($result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
});

it('rolls parent tasks up from their children (reference case 5, TSK-4)', function () {
    // Parent 10 with children: c1 (Jan 5, 2wd) and c2 (requested Jan 8, 3wd → Jan 8-12).
    // Parent: Jan 5..Jan 12. Parent slack: LS = Jan 8 (finish held by c2), so slack 3.
    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        monFri(),
        [task(10, null, null, 0), task(11, 10, '2026-01-05', 2), task(12, 10, '2026-01-08', 3)],
        [],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
    ));

    expect($result->forTask(10)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
        ->and($result->forTask(10)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
        ->and($result->forTask(10)->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
        ->and($result->forTask(11)->slack)->toBe(4)
        ->and($result->forTask(12)->slack)->toBe(0)
        ->and($result->forTask(10)->isCritical)->toBeTrue();
});

it('treats dependencies to a parent at the parent level (reference case 6, PRD §8.5)', function () {
    // Parent P has children c1 (Jan 5, 1wd) and c2 (Jan 6, 2wd → Jan 6-7).
    // S is FS-successor of P: starts the working day after P finishes → Jan 8.
    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        monFri(),
        [task(10, null, null, 0), task(11, 10, '2026-01-05', 1), task(12, 10, '2026-01-06', 2), task(20, null, null, 1)],
        [new DependencyLink(10, 20, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
    ));

    expect($result->forTask(10)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')
        ->and($result->forTask(20)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08');
});

it('schedules milestones as zero-duration points (TSK-5)', function () {
    // A: Jan 5, 1wd → Jan 5. Milestone M: FS from A → Jan 6. B: FS from M → Jan 7.
    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        monFri(),
        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 1), task(2, null, null, 0), task(3, null, null, 1)],
        [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
    ));

    expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06')
        ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06')
        ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07');
});

it('adjusts a requested start that falls on a non-working day (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
    // Start requested Sat Jan 10 → moves to Mon Jan 12, 2wd → finishes Tue Jan 13.
    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        monFri(),
        [task(1, null, '2026-01-10', 2)],
        [],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
    ));

    expect($result->forTask(1)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
        ->and($result->forTask(1)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13');
});

it('refuses to calculate a cyclic network (PRD §8.7)', function () {
    engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
        monFri(),
        [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 1), task(2, null, null, 1)],
        [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 1, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
        new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
    ));
})->throws(CircularDependencyException::class);

it('recalculates 500 chained tasks within the 1s performance target (PRD §9)', function () {
    $tasks = [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 1)];
    $links = [];

    for ($id = 2; $id <= 500; $id++) {
        $tasks[] = task($id, null, null, 1);
        $links[] = new DependencyLink($id - 1, $id, DependencyType::FS, 0);
    }

    $started = microtime(true);
    $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(monFri(), $tasks, $links, new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')));
    $elapsed = microtime(true) - $started;

    // 500 working days after 2026-01-05.
    expect($result->totalDuration)->toBe(500)
        ->and($elapsed)->toBeLessThan(1.0);
});
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulingException;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;

// PRD CAL-1/CAL-2/CAL-3 + §8.1 working-day rules.

it('knows working days, weekends and holidays', function () {
    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);

    expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBeTrue()   // Monday
        ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeFalse()  // Saturday
        ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse()  // Sunday
        ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-08')))->toBeFalse(); // Thursday holiday
});

it('supports six-day working weeks (any working-day set)', function () {
    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);

    expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeTrue()  // Saturday
        ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse(); // Sunday
});

it('moves a non-working start date to the next working day (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);

    expect($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12') // Sat → Mon
        ->and($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12'); // Mon stays
});

it('shifts forwards and backwards by working days only', function () {
    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);

    expect($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-09'), 1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')  // Fri +1wd = Mon
        ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), -1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09')
        ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), 0)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
});

it('counts working days between dates', function () {
    $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);

    // Jan 5 (Mon) → Jan 12 (Mon): 6,7,9,12 = 4 working days (8 is a holiday, 10-11 weekend)
    expect($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12')))->toBe(4)
        ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(0)
        ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(-4);
});

it('rejects a calendar without working days', function () {
    new WorkingCalendar([]);
})->throws(SchedulingException::class);

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Livewire\Tasks\Index as TasksIndex;
      use App\Models\Assignment;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Resource;
      use App\Models\ResourceLeave;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      // ASN-1..ASN-3, ASN-5 task assignment requirements.
      
      function assignmentProject(): Project
      {
          $project = Project::create(['name' => 'Assignments']);
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Wire up API', 'order' => 0, 'duration' => 3, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
      
          $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Ana']);
          $project->resources()->create(['name' => 'Budi']);
      
          return $project->fresh();
      }
      
      it('assigns one or more members to a task (ASN-1)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $task = Task::first();
          [$ana, $budi] = $project->resources()->orderBy('id')->get()->all();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $task->id)
              ->set('assignedResourceIds', [$ana->id, $budi->id])
              ->call('save');
      
          expect(Assignment::where('task_id', $task->id)->count())->toBe(2);
      });
      
      it('shows assigned member names in the task list (ASN-2)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $task = Task::first();
          $ana = $project->resources()->where('name', 'Ana')->first();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $task->id)
              ->set('assignedResourceIds', [$ana->id])
              ->call('save');
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Wire up API')
              ->assertSee('Ana');
      });
      
      it('warns when an assigned member is on leave during the task (ASN-3)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $task = Task::first();
          $ana = $project->resources()->where('name', 'Ana')->first();
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->call('edit', $task->id)
              ->set('assignedResourceIds', [$ana->id])
              ->call('save');
      
          // No leave yet: no warning.
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertDontSee('is on leave during this task');
      
          ResourceLeave::create(['resource_id' => $ana->id, 'start_date' => '2026-01-06', 'end_date' => '2026-01-07']);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('is on leave during this task');
      });
      
      it('warns when a member has overlapping tasks (ASN-3)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $ana = $project->resources()->where('name', 'Ana')->first();
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Second task', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 2, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
      
          foreach (Task::all() as $task) {
              Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $ana->id]);
          }
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('has overlapping tasks');
      });
      
      it('filters tasks by member (ASN-5)', function () {
          $project = assignmentProject();
          $task = Task::first();
          $ana = $project->resources()->where('name', 'Ana')->first();
      
          Assignment::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'task_id' => $task->id, 'resource_id' => $ana->id]);
      
          Task::create(['project_id' => $project->id, 'name' => 'Unassigned task', 'order' => 1, 'duration' => 1, 'start_input' => '2026-01-05']);
      
          Livewire::test(TasksIndex::class, ['project' => $project])
              ->assertSee('Unassigned task')
              ->set('memberFilter', $ana->id)
              ->assertSee('Wire up API')
              ->assertDontSee('Unassigned task');
      });

  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulingException;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
      
      // PRD CAL-1/CAL-2/CAL-3 + §8.1 working-day rules.
      
      it('knows working days, weekends and holidays', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBeTrue()   // Monday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeFalse()  // Saturday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse()  // Sunday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-08')))->toBeFalse(); // Thursday holiday
      });
      
      it('supports six-day working weeks (any working-day set)', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);
      
          expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeTrue()  // Saturday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse(); // Sunday
      });
      
      it('moves a non-working start date to the next working day (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
      
          expect($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12') // Sat → Mon
              ->and($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12'); // Mon stays
      });
      
      it('shifts forwards and backwards by working days only', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
      
          expect($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-09'), 1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')  // Fri +1wd = Mon
              ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), -1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09')
              ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), 0)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      });
      
      it('counts working days between dates', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          // Jan 5 (Mon) → Jan 12 (Mon): 6,7,9,12 = 4 working days (8 is a holiday, 10-11 weekend)
          expect($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12')))->toBe(4)
              ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(0)
              ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(-4);
      });
      
      it('rejects a calendar without working days', function () {
          new WorkingCalendar([]);
      })->throws(SchedulingException::class);

- path: tests\Unit\Scheduling\ScheduleEngineTest.php
  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ProjectScheduleInput;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulableTask;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleEngine;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
      
      /**
       * Reference test cases for CPM-1: networks calculated BY HAND, including
       * SS, lag and holiday cases (PRD CPM-1 acceptance criteria).
       *
       * Baseline calendar for all cases: Mon–Fri, no holidays unless stated.
       */
      
      function engine(): ScheduleEngine
      {
          return new ScheduleEngine;
      }
      
      function task(int $id, ?int $parent, ?string $start, int $duration): SchedulableTask
      {
          return new SchedulableTask($id, $parent, $id, "Task {$id}", $start ? new DateTimeImmutable($start) : null, $duration);
      }
      
      function monFri(): WorkingCalendar
      {
          return new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
      }
      
      it('calculates an FS chain with holiday skipping and positive lag (reference case 1)', function () {
          // Holiday: Thu 2026-01-08.
          // A: 5wd from Mon Jan 5 → Jan 5,6,7,9,12 → finishes Mon Jan 12.
          // B: FS lag 0 → Tue Jan 13, 3wd → finishes Thu Jan 15.
          // C: FS lag 2 → 2wd after Jan 15 = Tue Jan 20, 2wd → finishes Wed Jan 21.
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              $calendar,
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 5), task(2, null, null, 3), task(3, null, null, 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 2)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(1)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-15')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-20')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')
              ->and($result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')
              ->and($result->totalDuration)->toBe(12)
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->slack)->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('takes the latest constraint when a task has several predecessors (reference case 2, DEP-6)', function () {
          // A: 2wd from Mon Jan 5 → finishes Tue Jan 6. B: 1wd from Fri Jan 2 → finishes Jan 2.
          // C: FS from A → Jan 7; FS from B → Jan 5. Max wins: Jan 7. C: 2wd → finishes Jan 8.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 2), task(2, null, '2026-01-02', 1), task(3, null, null, 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-02'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->slack)->toBeGreaterThan(0)
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->isCritical)->toBeFalse();
      });
      
      it('handles start-to-start with negative lag (lead) (reference case 3, DEP-3/DEP-4)', function () {
          // A: 3wd from Mon Jan 5 → Jan 5..7.
          // B: SS lag −1 from A, no requested start → default start Jan 5 anchors first,
          //    so B starts Jan 5 (max of default and shift(A.start, -1) = Jan 2). B: 2wd → Jan 5..6.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 3), task(2, null, null, 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::SS, -1)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06');
      
          // Same network, but B requested to start Wed Jan 7: SS −1 only requires Jan 2,
          // so the requested start wins.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 3), task(2, null, '2026-01-07', 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::SS, -1)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08');
      });
      
      it('computes slack and multiple critical paths (reference case 4, CPM-2/CPM-5)', function () {
          // A(2wd) → B(3wd) → D(1wd);  A → C(1wd) → D.
          // Longest path A→B→D = 6wd, so C has float.
          // A: Jan 5-6, B: Jan 7-9, C: Jan 7, D: Jan 12. Project: Jan 5..12 (6wd).
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 2), task(2, null, null, 3), task(3, null, null, 1), task(4, null, null, 1)],
              [
                  new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0),
                  new DependencyLink(1, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0),
                  new DependencyLink(2, 4, DependencyType::FS, 0),
                  new DependencyLink(3, 4, DependencyType::FS, 0),
              ],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(3)->slack)->toBe(2)
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->isCritical)->toBeFalse()
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
              ->and($result->forTask(4)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
              ->and($result->totalDuration)->toBe(6)
              ->and($result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      });
      
      it('rolls parent tasks up from their children (reference case 5, TSK-4)', function () {
          // Parent 10 with children: c1 (Jan 5, 2wd) and c2 (requested Jan 8, 3wd → Jan 8-12).
          // Parent: Jan 5..Jan 12. Parent slack: LS = Jan 8 (finish held by c2), so slack 3.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(10, null, null, 0), task(11, 10, '2026-01-05', 2), task(12, 10, '2026-01-08', 3)],
              [],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(10)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($result->forTask(10)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($result->forTask(10)->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($result->forTask(11)->slack)->toBe(4)
              ->and($result->forTask(12)->slack)->toBe(0)
              ->and($result->forTask(10)->isCritical)->toBeTrue();
      });
      
      it('treats dependencies to a parent at the parent level (reference case 6, PRD §8.5)', function () {
          // Parent P has children c1 (Jan 5, 1wd) and c2 (Jan 6, 2wd → Jan 6-7).
          // S is FS-successor of P: starts the working day after P finishes → Jan 8.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(10, null, null, 0), task(11, 10, '2026-01-05', 1), task(12, 10, '2026-01-06', 2), task(20, null, null, 1)],
              [new DependencyLink(10, 20, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(10)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')
              ->and($result->forTask(20)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08');
      });
      
      it('schedules milestones as zero-duration points (TSK-5)', function () {
          // A: Jan 5, 1wd → Jan 5. Milestone M: FS from A → Jan 6. B: FS from M → Jan 7.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 1), task(2, null, null, 0), task(3, null, null, 1)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07');
      });
      
      it('adjusts a requested start that falls on a non-working day (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
          // Start requested Sat Jan 10 → moves to Mon Jan 12, 2wd → finishes Tue Jan 13.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-10', 2)],
              [],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(1)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13');
      });
      
      it('refuses to calculate a cyclic network (PRD §8.7)', function () {
          engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 1), task(2, null, null, 1)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 1, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      })->throws(CircularDependencyException::class);
      
      it('recalculates 500 chained tasks within the 1s performance target (PRD §9)', function () {
          $tasks = [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 1)];
          $links = [];
      
          for ($id = 2; $id <= 500; $id++) {
              $tasks[] = task($id, null, null, 1);
              $links[] = new DependencyLink($id - 1, $id, DependencyType::FS, 0);
          }
      
          $started = microtime(true);
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(monFri(), $tasks, $links, new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')));
          $elapsed = microtime(true) - $started;
      
          // 500 working days after 2026-01-05.
          expect($result->totalDuration)->toBe(500)
              ->and($elapsed)->toBeLessThan(1.0);
      });
