      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;
      
      /**
       * Dependency graph helpers: topological ordering and cycle detection (PRD DEP-5).
       *
       * Pure PHP — used both by the engine (defense in depth, PRD §8.7) and by the
       * application layer to reject saves before they happen.
       */
      final class DependencyGraph
      {
          /**
           * @param  list<int>  $taskIds
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           */
          public function __construct(
              private readonly array $taskIds,
              private readonly array $links,
          ) {}
      
          /**
           * Kahn topological order. Throws CircularDependencyException when a cycle exists.
           *
           * @return list<int>
           */
          public function topologicalOrder(): array
          {
              $inDegree = array_fill_keys($this->taskIds, 0);
              $adjacency = array_fill_keys($this->taskIds, []);
      
              foreach ($this->links as $link) {
                  if (! isset($inDegree[$link->predecessorId]) || ! isset($inDegree[$link->successorId])) {
                      continue; // edges outside the given task set are ignored
                  }
      
                  $adjacency[$link->predecessorId][] = $link->successorId;
                  $inDegree[$link->successorId]++;
              }
      
              $queue = [];
              foreach ($inDegree as $id => $degree) {
                  if ($degree === 0) {
                      $queue[] = $id;
                  }
              }
      
              $order = [];
              while ($queue !== []) {
                  $id = array_shift($queue);
                  $order[] = $id;
      
                  foreach ($adjacency[$id] as $next) {
                      $inDegree[$next]--;
      
                      if ($inDegree[$next] === 0) {
                          $queue[] = $next;
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              if (count($order) !== count($this->taskIds)) {
                  $remaining = array_values(array_diff($this->taskIds, $order));
                  throw new CircularDependencyException($this->findCycle($remaining));
              }
      
              return $order;
          }
      
          /**
           * Depth-first search for one concrete cycle among the given nodes.
           *
           * @param  list<int>  $candidates
           * @return list<int>
           */
          public function findCycle(array $candidates): array
          {
              $successors = array_fill_keys($candidates, []);
              foreach ($this->links as $link) {
                  if (isset($successors[$link->predecessorId]) && isset($successors[$link->successorId])) {
                      $successors[$link->predecessorId][] = $link->successorId;
                  }
              }
      
              $state = []; // id => 1 visiting, 2 done
              $stack = [];
      
              $visit = function (int $id) use (&$visit, &$state, &$stack, $successors): array {
                  $state[$id] = 1;
                  $stack[] = $id;
      
                  foreach ($successors[$id] ?? [] as $next) {
                      if (($state[$next] ?? 0) === 1) {
                          $at = array_search($next, $stack, true);
      
                          return array_slice($stack, $at === false ? 0 : $at);
                      }
      
                      if (($state[$next] ?? 0) === 0) {
                          $cycle = $visit($next);
      
                          if ($cycle !== []) {
                              return $cycle;
                          }
                      }
                  }
      
                  array_pop($stack);
                  $state[$id] = 2;
      
                  return [];
              };
      
              foreach ($candidates as $id) {
                  if (($state[$id] ?? 0) === 0) {
                      $cycle = $visit($id);
      
                      if ($cycle !== []) {
                          return $cycle;
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return $candidates;
          }
      }

      class CircularDependencyException extends RuntimeException

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;
      
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      
      /**
       * The scheduling engine: forward/backward pass CPM over working days (PRD §8, CPM-1).
       *
       * This is the ONLY place in the application where dates, slack, and critical
       * flags are calculated (build rule; PRD §8.6). It is pure PHP: no Eloquent,
       * no facades, no HTTP. Every recalculation goes through calculate().
       */
      final class ScheduleEngine
      {
          /**
           * Recalculate a whole project schedule.
           *
           * Rules implemented:
           *  - Duration is counted in working days; end = start + (duration - 1) (PRD §8.1/§8.3).
           *  - A start falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day (TSK-1 AC).
           *  - Effective start = max(adjusted requested start, all predecessor constraints) (PRD §8.2).
           *  - FS with lag L: successor starts L+1 working days after predecessor finish (D-07).
           *  - SS with lag L: successor starts L working days after predecessor start (D-07).
           *  - Parent tasks roll up: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
           *  - Slack = working days between early and late start; critical when slack <= 0 (CPM-2, D-25).
           *
           * @throws SchedulingException|CircularDependencyException
           */
          public function calculate(ProjectScheduleInput $input): ScheduleResult
          {
              $tasks = $this->indexTasks($input->tasks);
      
              if ($tasks === []) {
                  return new ScheduleResult([], $input->defaultStart, $input->defaultStart, 0);
              }
      
              $children = $this->childrenMap($tasks);
              $leaves = $this->leafTasks($tasks, $children);
              $links = $this->expandLinks($input->links, $tasks, $children);
      
              [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish] = $this->forwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links);
              $this->rollUpParents($tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish);
      
              $projectStart = $this->minDate($earlyStart);
              $projectFinish = $this->maxDate($earlyFinish);
      
              [$lateStart, $lateFinish] = $this->backwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links, $projectFinish);
              $this->rollUpParentsBackward($input, $tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish, $lateStart, $lateFinish);
      
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
              $result = [];
      
              foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
                  $slack = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $lateStart[$id]);
      
                  $result[$id] = new TaskSchedule(
                      taskId: $id,
                      earlyStart: $earlyStart[$id],
                      earlyFinish: $earlyFinish[$id],
                      lateStart: $lateStart[$id],
                      lateFinish: $lateFinish[$id],
                      slack: $slack,
                      isCritical: $slack <= 0,
                  );
              }
      
              return new ScheduleResult(
                  byTask: $result,
                  projectStart: $projectStart,
                  projectFinish: $projectFinish,
                  totalDuration: $calendar->countWorkingDays($projectStart, $projectFinish) + 1,
              );
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  list<SchedulableTask>  $taskList
           * @return array<int, SchedulableTask>
           */
          private function indexTasks(array $taskList): array
          {
              $tasks = [];
      
              foreach ($taskList as $task) {
                  if (isset($tasks[$task->id])) {
                      throw new SchedulingException("Duplicate task id {$task->id}.");
                  }
      
                  $tasks[$task->id] = $task;
              }
      
              return $tasks;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @return array<int, list<int>> parent id => child ids
           */
          private function childrenMap(array $tasks): array
          {
              $children = [];
      
              foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
                  if ($task->parentId === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  if (! isset($tasks[$task->parentId])) {
                      throw new SchedulingException("Task {$task->name} references an unknown parent ({$task->parentId}).");
                  }
      
                  $this->assertNoParentCycle($id, $tasks);
                  $children[$task->parentId][] = $id;
              }
      
              return $children;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           */
          private function assertNoParentCycle(int $id, array $tasks): void
          {
              $seen = [$id => true];
              $current = $tasks[$id];
      
              while ($current->parentId !== null) {
                  if (isset($seen[$current->parentId])) {
                      throw new SchedulingException("Task hierarchy contains a cycle at task {$current->parentId}.");
                  }
      
                  $seen[$current->parentId] = true;
                  $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Tasks without children are scheduled directly; parents roll up (D-09).
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<int>
           */
          private function leafTasks(array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              return array_values(array_filter(
                  array_keys($tasks),
                  static fn (int $id): bool => ! isset($children[$id]),
              ));
          }
      
          /**
           * Dependencies to or from a parent are treated at the parent level (PRD §8.5):
           * expand each endpoint to its descendant leaves (D-09). Self edges are dropped.
           *
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<DependencyLink>
           */
          private function expandLinks(array $links, array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              $expanded = [];
      
              foreach ($links as $link) {
                  foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->predecessorId, $tasks, $children) as $predecessor) {
                      foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->successorId, $tasks, $children) as $successor) {
                          if ($predecessor === $successor) {
                              continue;
                          }
      
                          $expanded[] = new DependencyLink($predecessor, $successor, $link->type, $link->lag);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return $expanded;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<int>
           */
          private function descendantLeaves(int $id, array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              if (! isset($tasks[$id])) {
                  throw new SchedulingException("Dependency references an unknown task ({$id}).");
              }
      
              if (! isset($children[$id])) {
                  return [$id]; // a "parent" without children behaves as a normal task (D-10)
              }
      
              $leaves = [];
      
              foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                  foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($child, $tasks, $children) as $leaf) {
                      $leaves[] = $leaf;
                  }
              }
      
              return $leaves;
          }
      
          /**
           * Forward pass over leaf tasks in topological order, then parent roll-up.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  list<int>  $leaves
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
           */
          private function forwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links): array
          {
              $order = (new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder();
      
              $incoming = [];
              foreach ($links as $link) {
                  $incoming[$link->successorId][] = $link;
              }
      
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
              $earlyStart = [];
              $earlyFinish = [];
      
              foreach ($order as $id) {
                  $task = $tasks[$id];
                  $start = $calendar->adjust($task->requestedStart ?? $input->defaultStart);
      
                  foreach ($incoming[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                      $constraint = match ($link->type) {
                          DependencyType::FS => $calendar->shift($earlyFinish[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag + 1),
                          DependencyType::SS => $calendar->shift($earlyStart[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag),
                      };
      
                      if ($constraint > $start) {
                          $start = $constraint;
                      }
                  }
      
                  $earlyStart[$id] = $start;
                  $earlyFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                      ? $start // milestone (TSK-5)
                      : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
              }
      
              return [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish];
          }
      
          /**
           * Parent tasks: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
           * Deepest parents first so grandchildren are rolled up before their parents.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
           */
          private function rollUpParents(array $tasks, array $children, array &$earlyStart, array &$earlyFinish): void
          {
              foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
                  $childStarts = [];
                  $childFinishes = [];
      
                  foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                      $childStarts[] = $earlyStart[$child];
                      $childFinishes[] = $earlyFinish[$child];
                  }
      
                  $earlyStart[$id] = $this->minDate($childStarts);
                  $earlyFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Backward pass over leaf tasks in reverse topological order, then parent roll-up.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  list<int>  $leaves
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
           */
          private function backwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links, DateTimeImmutable $projectFinish): array
          {
              $order = array_reverse((new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder());
      
              $outgoing = [];
              foreach ($links as $link) {
                  $outgoing[$link->predecessorId][] = $link;
              }
      
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
              $lateStart = [];
              $lateFinish = [];
      
              foreach ($order as $id) {
                  $task = $tasks[$id];
                  $lateFinishConstraint = null;
                  $lateStartConstraint = null;
      
                  foreach ($outgoing[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                      if ($link->type === DependencyType::FS) {
                          // successor start >= shift(predecessor finish, lag + 1)
                          $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -($link->lag + 1));
                          $lateFinishConstraint = $lateFinishConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateFinishConstraint
                              ? $candidate
                              : $lateFinishConstraint;
                      } else {
                          // successor start >= shift(predecessor start, lag)
                          $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -$link->lag);
                          $lateStartConstraint = $lateStartConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateStartConstraint
                              ? $candidate
                              : $lateStartConstraint;
                      }
                  }
      
                  // Tasks without successors finish with the project (CPM backward pass).
                  $finish = $lateFinishConstraint ?? $projectFinish;
                  $start = $task->duration === 0
                      ? $finish
                      : $calendar->shift($finish, -($task->duration - 1));
      
                  if ($lateStartConstraint !== null && $lateStartConstraint < $start) {
                      $start = $lateStartConstraint;
                  }
      
                  $lateStart[$id] = $start;
                  $lateFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                      ? $start
                      : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
              }
      
              return [$lateStart, $lateFinish];
          }
      
          /**
           * Parent late window: latest finish = latest child finish, latest start derived
           * from the parent's rolled-up span.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateStart
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateFinish
           */
          private function rollUpParentsBackward(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $children, array $earlyStart, array $earlyFinish, array &$lateStart, array &$lateFinish): void
          {
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
      
              foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
                  $childFinishes = [];
                  foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                      $childFinishes[] = $lateFinish[$child];
                  }
      
                  $lateFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);
      
                  // Late start derived from the parent's rolled-up span.
                  $span = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $earlyFinish[$id]) + 1;
                  $lateStart[$id] = $calendar->shift($lateFinish[$id], -($span - 1));
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Parent ids ordered deepest first (bottom-up roll-up needs children first).
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<int>
           */
          private function parentsByDepthDesc(array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              $parents = array_keys($children);
      
              usort($parents, static function (int $a, int $b) use ($tasks): int {
                  return self::depth($b, $tasks) <=> self::depth($a, $tasks);
              });
      
              return $parents;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           */
          private static function depth(int $id, array $tasks): int
          {
              $depth = 0;
              $current = $tasks[$id];
      
              while ($current->parentId !== null) {
                  $depth++;
                  $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
              }
      
              return $depth;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
           */
          private function minDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $min = null;
      
              foreach ($dates as $date) {
                  if ($min === null || $date < $min) {
                      $min = $date;
                  }
              }
      
              if ($min === null) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the earliest date of an empty set.');
              }
      
              return $min;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
           */
          private function maxDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $max = null;
      
              foreach ($dates as $date) {
                  if ($max === null || $date > $max) {
                      $max = $date;
                  }
              }
      
              if ($max === null) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the latest date of an empty set.');
              }
      
              return $max;
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulingException;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
      
      // PRD CAL-1/CAL-2/CAL-3 + §8.1 working-day rules.
      
      it('knows working days, weekends and holidays', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBeTrue()   // Monday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeFalse()  // Saturday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse()  // Sunday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-08')))->toBeFalse(); // Thursday holiday
      });
      
      it('supports six-day working weeks (any working-day set)', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);
      
          expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeTrue()  // Saturday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse(); // Sunday
      });
      
      it('moves a non-working start date to the next working day (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
      
          expect($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12') // Sat → Mon
              ->and($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12'); // Mon stays
      });
      
      it('shifts forwards and backwards by working days only', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
      
          expect($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-09'), 1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')  // Fri +1wd = Mon
              ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), -1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09')
              ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), 0)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      });
      
      it('counts working days between dates', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          // Jan 5 (Mon) → Jan 12 (Mon): 6,7,9,12 = 4 working days (8 is a holiday, 10-11 weekend)
          expect($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12')))->toBe(4)
              ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(0)
              ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(-4);
      });
      
      it('rejects a calendar without working days', function () {
          new WorkingCalendar([]);
      })->throws(SchedulingException::class);

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;
      
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      use DateTimeInterface;
      
      /**
       * Working calendar: knows which days are working days (PRD CAL-1/CAL-2/CAL-3).
       *
       * Pure value object — no Eloquent, no facades. All working-day arithmetic
       * (PRD §8.1) happens through this class.
       */
      final class WorkingCalendar
      {
          /** @var array<int, true> Set of ISO weekday numbers (1=Mon .. 7=Sun) that are working days */
          private array $workingDays;
      
          /** @var array<string, true> Set of holiday dates formatted Y-m-d */
          private array $holidays;
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, int>  $workingDays  ISO weekday numbers (1=Mon .. 7=Sun)
           * @param  array<int, string>  $holidays  Holiday dates formatted Y-m-d
           */
          public function __construct(array $workingDays, array $holidays = [])
          {
              $workingDays = array_values(array_unique(array_map('intval', $workingDays)));
              sort($workingDays);
      
              if ($workingDays === [] || array_filter($workingDays, static fn (int $d): bool => $d < 1 || $d > 7) !== []) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Working calendar requires at least one working day between 1 (Mon) and 7 (Sun).');
              }
      
              $this->workingDays = array_fill_keys($workingDays, true);
              $this->holidays = array_fill_keys(array_map('strval', $holidays), true);
          }
      
          public function isWorkingDay(DateTimeInterface $date): bool
          {
              $day = (int) $date->format('w'); // 0=Sun .. 6=Sat
              $iso = $day === 0 ? 7 : $day;
      
              if (! isset($this->workingDays[$iso])) {
                  return false;
              }
      
              return ! isset($this->holidays[$date->format('Y-m-d')]);
          }
      
          /**
           * The given date if it is a working day, otherwise the next working day (TSK-1 AC).
           */
          public function adjust(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $current = self::immutable($date);
      
              if ($this->isWorkingDay($current)) {
                  return $current;
              }
      
              return $this->nextWorkingDay($current);
          }
      
          /**
           * The next working day strictly after the given date.
           */
          public function nextWorkingDay(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $current = self::immutable($date);
      
              for ($i = 0; $i < 3660; $i++) {
                  $current = $current->modify('+1 day');
      
                  if ($this->isWorkingDay($current)) {
                      return $current;
                  }
              }
      
              throw new SchedulingException('No working day found within ten years — check the calendar configuration.');
          }
      
          /**
           * Move forwards (positive) or backwards (negative) by whole working days.
           * Shifting by zero returns the same calendar day.
           */
          public function shift(DateTimeInterface $date, int $workingDays): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $current = self::immutable($date);
              $step = $workingDays >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
              $remaining = abs($workingDays);
      
              for ($i = 0; $i < 366_000 && $remaining > 0; $i++) {
                  $current = $current->modify(sprintf('%+d day', $step));
      
                  if ($this->isWorkingDay($current)) {
                      $remaining--;
                  }
              }
      
              if ($remaining > 0) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Could not shift by the requested number of working days — check the calendar configuration.');
              }
      
              return $current;
          }
      
          /**
           * Number of working days strictly after $from, up to and including $to.
           * Negative when $to is before $from.
           */
          public function countWorkingDays(DateTimeInterface $from, DateTimeInterface $to): int
          {
              $start = self::immutable($from);
              $end = self::immutable($to);
      
              if ($start == $end) {
                  return 0;
              }
      
              if ($start > $end) {
                  return -$this->countWorkingDays($end, $start);
              }
      
              $count = 0;
              $cursor = $start;
      
              while ($cursor < $end) {
                  $cursor = $cursor->modify('+1 day');
      
                  if ($this->isWorkingDay($cursor)) {
                      $count++;
                  }
              }
      
              return $count;
          }
      
          private static function immutable(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              return DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($date)->setTime(0, 0);
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulingException;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
      
      // PRD CAL-1/CAL-2/CAL-3 + §8.1 working-day rules.
      
      it('knows working days, weekends and holidays', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBeTrue()   // Monday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeFalse()  // Saturday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse()  // Sunday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-08')))->toBeFalse(); // Thursday holiday
      });
      
      it('supports six-day working weeks (any working-day set)', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);
      
          expect($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10')))->toBeTrue()  // Saturday
              ->and($calendar->isWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-11')))->toBeFalse(); // Sunday
      });
      
      it('moves a non-working start date to the next working day (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
      
          expect($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12') // Sat → Mon
              ->and($calendar->adjust(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12'); // Mon stays
      });
      
      it('shifts forwards and backwards by working days only', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
      
          expect($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-09'), 1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')  // Fri +1wd = Mon
              ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), -1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09')
              ->and($calendar->shift(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), 0)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      });
      
      it('counts working days between dates', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          // Jan 5 (Mon) → Jan 12 (Mon): 6,7,9,12 = 4 working days (8 is a holiday, 10-11 weekend)
          expect($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12')))->toBe(4)
              ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(0)
              ->and($calendar->countWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')))->toBe(-4);
      });
      
      it('rejects a calendar without working days', function () {
          new WorkingCalendar([]);
      })->throws(SchedulingException::class);
      
      it('adds working days across a weekend (weekend crossing)', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], []);
      
          // Monday 2026-01-05, add 3 working days: +1wd=Tue06, +2wd=Wed07, +3wd=Thu08
          // endDate = addWorkingDays(01-05, 2) for duration 3 => Thu08
          expect($calendar->addWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 2)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08')
              ->and($calendar->nextWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-09'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12') // Fri → Mon
              ->and($calendar->endDate(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 3)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08') // Mon + 2wd = Thu
              ->and($calendar->endDate(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 5)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09'); // Mon + 4wd = Fri
      });
      
      it('handles a holiday inside a range', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']); // Thu holiday
      
          // Start Mon 2026-01-05, add 4wd: wd0=05, wd1=06, wd2=07, wd3=09(skip08), wd4=12 => 4wd lands Mon12
          expect($calendar->addWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 4)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($calendar->endDate(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 5)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12') // +4wd as above
              ->and($calendar->nextWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-08'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09'); // holiday → next working
      });
      
      it('moves a non-working start to the next working day and computes end', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], []);
      
          $first = $calendar->firstWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-10'));
      
          // First working day on Saturday 2026-01-10 → Monday 2026-01-12
          expect($first->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      
          // With a working start Monday 2026-01-12 + 3 working days = Thursday 2026-01-15
          // (Mon12 [wd0], Tue13 [wd1], Wed14 [wd2], Thu15 [wd3])
          expect($calendar->addWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), 3)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-15');
      
          // Single working day task: end = start = Monday 2026-01-12
          expect($calendar->endDate(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-12'), 1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      });
      
      it('handles a holiday inside a range', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']); // Thu holiday
      
          // Start Mon 2026-01-05, add 4wd: wd0=05, wd1=06, wd2=07, wd3=09(skip08), wd4=12 => 4wd lands Mon12
          expect($calendar->addWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 4)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($calendar->endDate(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 5)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12') // +4wd as above
              ->and($calendar->nextWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-08'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-09'); // holiday → next working
      });
      
      it('returns the same day when the start is already a working day', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], []);
      
          expect($calendar->firstWorkingDay(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'))->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($calendar->endDate(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 1)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($calendar->addWorkingDays(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 0)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05');
      });
      
      it('supports zero-duration milestone end equal to start', function () {
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          // endDate with duration 0 = start (milestone)
          expect($calendar->endDate(new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'), 0)->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05');
      });

      namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;

      /**

      final class ScheduleResult
      {
          /** @var array<int, TaskSchedule> */
          private array $byTask;
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, TaskSchedule>  $byTask
           */
          public function __construct(array $byTask, public readonly DateTimeImmutable $projectStart, public readonly DateTimeImmutable $projectFinish, public readonly int $totalDuration)
          {
              $this->byTask = $byTask;
          }
      
          public function forTask(int $taskId): ?TaskSchedule
          {
              return $this->byTask[$taskId] ?? null;
          }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyGraph;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      
      function edge(int $from, int $to): DependencyLink
      {
          return new DependencyLink($from, $to, DependencyType::FS, 0);
      }
      
      it('orders tasks topologically', function () {
          $order = (new DependencyGraph([1, 2, 3, 4], [edge(1, 2), edge(1, 3), edge(2, 4), edge(3, 4)]))->topologicalOrder();
      
          expect(array_search(1, $order, true))->toBeLessThan(array_search(2, $order, true))
              ->and(array_search(2, $order, true))->toBeLessThan(array_search(4, $order, true))
              ->and(array_search(3, $order, true))->toBeLessThan(array_search(4, $order, true));
      });
      
      it('detects a cycle and reports the path (DEP-5)', function () {
          $caught = null;
      
          try {
              (new DependencyGraph([1, 2, 3], [edge(1, 2), edge(2, 3), edge(3, 1)]))->topologicalOrder();
          } catch (CircularDependencyException $exception) {
              $caught = $exception;
          }
      
          expect($caught)->toBeInstanceOf(CircularDependencyException::class);
          expect($caught->cyclePath)->toBeArray()->toHaveCount(3);
          expect(array_sum($caught->cyclePath))->toBe(6);
      });
      
      it('treats disconnected tasks as independent', function () {
          expect((new DependencyGraph([1, 2], []))->topologicalOrder())->toHaveCount(2);
      });

      declare(strict_types=1);

       */
      function engine(): ScheduleEngine
      {
          return new ScheduleEngine;
      }

      {

      }
      
      function monFri(): WorkingCalendar
      {
          return new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
      }
      
      it('calculates an FS chain with holiday skipping and positive lag (reference case 1)', function () {

          // B: FS lag 0 → Tue Jan 13, 3wd → finishes Thu Jan 15.
          // C: FS lag 2 → 2wd after Jan 15 = Tue Jan 20, 2wd → finishes Wed Jan 21.
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              $calendar,
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 5), task(2, null, null, 3), task(3, null, null, 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 2)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(1)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-15')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-20')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')
              ->and($result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')
              ->and($result->totalDuration)->toBe(12)
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->slack)->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('takes the latest constraint when a task has several predecessors (reference case 2, DEP-6)', function () {
          // A: 2wd from Mon Jan 5 → finishes Tue Jan 6. B: 1wd from Fri Jan 2 → finishes Jan 2.
          // C: FS from A → Jan 7; FS from B → Jan 5. Max wins: Jan 7. C: 2wd → finishes Jan 8.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 2), task(2, null, '2026-01-02', 1), task(3, null, null, 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0)],

              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->slack)->toBeGreaterThan(0)
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->isCritical)->toBeFalse();
      });
      
      it('handles start-to-start with negative lag (lead) (reference case 3, DEP-3/DEP-4)', function () {
          // A: 3wd from Mon Jan 5 → Jan 5..7.
          // B: SS lag −1 from A, no requested start → default start Jan 5 anchors first,
          //    so B starts Jan 5 (max of default and shift(A.start, -1) = Jan 2). B: 2wd → Jan 5..6.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 3), task(2, null, null, 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::SS, -1)],

              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06');

          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;
      
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      
      /**
       * The scheduling engine: forward/backward pass CPM over working days (PRD §8, CPM-1).
       *
       * This is the ONLY place in the application where dates, slack, and critical
       * flags are calculated (build rule; PRD §8.6). It is pure PHP: no Eloquent,
       * no facades, no HTTP. Every recalculation goes through calculate().
       */
      final class ScheduleEngine
      {
          /**
           * Recalculate a whole project schedule.
           *
           * Rules implemented:
           *  - Duration is counted in working days; end = start + (duration - 1) (PRD §8.1/§8.3).
           *  - A start falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day (TSK-1 AC).
           *  - Effective start = max(adjusted requested start, all predecessor constraints) (PRD §8.2).
           *  - FS with lag L: successor starts L+1 working days after predecessor finish (D-07).
           *  - SS with lag L: successor starts L working days after predecessor start (D-07).
           *  - Parent tasks roll up: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
           *  - Slack = working days between early and late start; critical when slack <= 0 (CPM-2, D-25).
           *
           * @throws SchedulingException|CircularDependencyException
           */
          public function calculate(ProjectScheduleInput $input): ScheduleResult
          {
              $tasks = $this->indexTasks($input->tasks);
      
              if ($tasks === []) {
                  return new ScheduleResult([], $input->defaultStart, $input->defaultStart, 0);
              }
      
              $children = $this->childrenMap($tasks);
              $leaves = $this->leafTasks($tasks, $children);
              $links = $this->expandLinks($input->links, $tasks, $children);
      
              [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish] = $this->forwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links);
              $this->rollUpParents($tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish);
      
              $projectStart = $this->minDate($earlyStart);
              $projectFinish = $this->maxDate($earlyFinish);
      
              [$lateStart, $lateFinish] = $this->backwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links, $projectFinish);
              $this->rollUpParentsBackward($input, $tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish, $lateStart, $lateFinish);
      
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
              $result = [];
      
              foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
                  $slack = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $lateStart[$id]);
      
                  $result[$id] = new TaskSchedule(
                      taskId: $id,
                      earlyStart: $earlyStart[$id],
                      earlyFinish: $earlyFinish[$id],
                      lateStart: $lateStart[$id],
                      lateFinish: $lateFinish[$id],
                      slack: $slack,
                      isCritical: $slack <= 0,
                  );
              }
      
              return new ScheduleResult(
                  byTask: $result,
                  projectStart: $projectStart,
                  projectFinish: $projectFinish,
                  totalDuration: $calendar->countWorkingDays($projectStart, $projectFinish) + 1,
              );
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  list<SchedulableTask>  $taskList
           * @return array<int, SchedulableTask>
           */
          private function indexTasks(array $taskList): array
          {
              $tasks = [];
      
              foreach ($taskList as $task) {
                  if (isset($tasks[$task->id])) {
                      throw new SchedulingException("Duplicate task id {$task->id}.");
                  }
      
                  $tasks[$task->id] = $task;
              }
      
              return $tasks;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @return array<int, list<int>> parent id => child ids
           */
          private function childrenMap(array $tasks): array
          {
              $children = [];
      
              foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
                  if ($task->parentId === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  if (! isset($tasks[$task->parentId])) {
                      throw new SchedulingException("Task {$task->name} references an unknown parent ({$task->parentId}).");
                  }
      
                  $this->assertNoParentCycle($id, $tasks);
                  $children[$task->parentId][] = $id;
              }
      
              return $children;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           */
          private function assertNoParentCycle(int $id, array $tasks): void
          {
              $seen = [$id => true];
              $current = $tasks[$id];
      
              while ($current->parentId !== null) {
                  if (isset($seen[$current->parentId])) {
                      throw new SchedulingException("Task hierarchy contains a cycle at task {$current->parentId}.");
                  }
      
                  $seen[$current->parentId] = true;
                  $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Tasks without children are scheduled directly; parents roll up (D-09).
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<int>
           */
          private function leafTasks(array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              return array_values(array_filter(
                  array_keys($tasks),
                  static fn (int $id): bool => ! isset($children[$id]),
              ));
          }
      
          /**
           * Dependencies to or from a parent are treated at the parent level (PRD §8.5):
           * expand each endpoint to its descendant leaves (D-09). Self edges are dropped.
           *
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<DependencyLink>
           */
          private function expandLinks(array $links, array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              $expanded = [];
      
              foreach ($links as $link) {
                  foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->predecessorId, $tasks, $children) as $predecessor) {
                      foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->successorId, $tasks, $children) as $successor) {
                          if ($predecessor === $successor) {
                              continue;
                          }
      
                          $expanded[] = new DependencyLink($predecessor, $successor, $link->type, $link->lag);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return $expanded;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<int>
           */
          private function descendantLeaves(int $id, array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              if (! isset($tasks[$id])) {
                  throw new SchedulingException("Dependency references an unknown task ({$id}).");
              }
      
              if (! isset($children[$id])) {
                  return [$id]; // a "parent" without children behaves as a normal task (D-10)
              }
      
              $leaves = [];
      
              foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                  foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($child, $tasks, $children) as $leaf) {
                      $leaves[] = $leaf;
                  }
              }
      
              return $leaves;
          }
      
          /**
           * Forward pass over leaf tasks in topological order, then parent roll-up.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  list<int>  $leaves
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
           */
          private function forwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links): array
          {
              $order = (new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder();
      
              $incoming = [];
              foreach ($links as $link) {
                  $incoming[$link->successorId][] = $link;
              }
      
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
              $earlyStart = [];
              $earlyFinish = [];
      
              foreach ($order as $id) {
                  $task = $tasks[$id];
                  $start = $calendar->adjust($task->requestedStart ?? $input->defaultStart);
      
                  foreach ($incoming[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                      $constraint = match ($link->type) {
                          DependencyType::FS => $calendar->shift($earlyFinish[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag + 1),
                          DependencyType::SS => $calendar->shift($earlyStart[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag),
                      };
      
                      if ($constraint > $start) {
                          $start = $constraint;
                      }
                  }
      
                  $earlyStart[$id] = $start;
                  $earlyFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                      ? $start // milestone (TSK-5)
                      : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
              }
      
              return [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish];
          }
      
          /**
           * Parent tasks: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
           * Deepest parents first so grandchildren are rolled up before their parents.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
           */
          private function rollUpParents(array $tasks, array $children, array &$earlyStart, array &$earlyFinish): void
          {
              foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
                  $childStarts = [];
                  $childFinishes = [];
      
                  foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                      $childStarts[] = $earlyStart[$child];
                      $childFinishes[] = $earlyFinish[$child];
                  }
      
                  $earlyStart[$id] = $this->minDate($childStarts);
                  $earlyFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Backward pass over leaf tasks in reverse topological order, then parent roll-up.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  list<int>  $leaves
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
           */
          private function backwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links, DateTimeImmutable $projectFinish): array
          {
              $order = array_reverse((new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder());
      
              $outgoing = [];
              foreach ($links as $link) {
                  $outgoing[$link->predecessorId][] = $link;
              }
      
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
              $lateStart = [];
              $lateFinish = [];
      
              foreach ($order as $id) {
                  $task = $tasks[$id];
                  $lateFinishConstraint = null;
                  $lateStartConstraint = null;
      
                  foreach ($outgoing[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                      if ($link->type === DependencyType::FS) {
                          // successor start >= shift(predecessor finish, lag + 1)
                          $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -($link->lag + 1));
                          $lateFinishConstraint = $lateFinishConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateFinishConstraint
                              ? $candidate
                              : $lateFinishConstraint;
                      } else {
                          // successor start >= shift(predecessor start, lag)
                          $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -$link->lag);
                          $lateStartConstraint = $lateStartConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateStartConstraint
                              ? $candidate
                              : $lateStartConstraint;
                      }
                  }
      
                  // Tasks without successors finish with the project (CPM backward pass).
                  $finish = $lateFinishConstraint ?? $projectFinish;
                  $start = $task->duration === 0
                      ? $finish
                      : $calendar->shift($finish, -($task->duration - 1));
      
                  if ($lateStartConstraint !== null && $lateStartConstraint < $start) {
                      $start = $lateStartConstraint;
                  }
      
                  $lateStart[$id] = $start;
                  $lateFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                      ? $start
                      : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
              }
      
              return [$lateStart, $lateFinish];
          }
      
          /**
           * Parent late window: latest finish = latest child finish, latest start derived
           * from the parent's rolled-up span.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateStart
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateFinish
           */
          private function rollUpParentsBackward(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $children, array $earlyStart, array $earlyFinish, array &$lateStart, array &$lateFinish): void
          {
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
      
              foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
                  $childFinishes = [];
                  foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                      $childFinishes[] = $lateFinish[$child];
                  }
      
                  $lateFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);
      
                  // Late start derived from the parent's rolled-up span.
                  $span = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $earlyFinish[$id]) + 1;
                  $lateStart[$id] = $calendar->shift($lateFinish[$id], -($span - 1));
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Parent ids ordered deepest first (bottom-up roll-up needs children first).
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<int>
           */
          private function parentsByDepthDesc(array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              $parents = array_keys($children);
      
              usort($parents, static function (int $a, int $b) use ($tasks): int {
                  return self::depth($b, $tasks) <=> self::depth($a, $tasks);
              });
      
              return $parents;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           */
          private static function depth(int $id, array $tasks): int
          {
              $depth = 0;
              $current = $tasks[$id];
      
              while ($current->parentId !== null) {
                  $depth++;
                  $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
              }
      
              return $depth;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
           */
          private function minDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $min = null;
      
              foreach ($dates as $date) {
                  if ($min === null || $date < $min) {
                      $min = $date;
                  }
              }
      
              if ($min === null) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the earliest date of an empty set.');
              }
      
              return $min;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
           */
          private function maxDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $max = null;
      
              foreach ($dates as $date) {
                  if ($max === null || $date > $max) {
                      $max = $date;
                  }
              }
      
              if ($max === null) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the latest date of an empty set.');
              }
      
              return $max;
          }
      }

Limitation: I did not confirm section 8 wording line-by-line.

Bugs and issues found (by severity). I did not alter anything.

High severity — correctness risk in special calendar configurations, not in the default Mon–Fri calendar the tests use:
- Holidays with weekend-dependent logic not explicitly proven.
  - File: `app/Domain/Scheduling/WorkingCalendar.php`, methods `nextWorkingDay`, `addWorkingDays`, `endDate`, `shift`, `countWorkingDays`.
  - Issue: Implementations iterate day-by-day and rely on `isWorkingDay` which already combines weekend+'. So holiday handling is structurally correct; the concern is not a logic bug but a gap in test coverage for edge calendar shapes. No failing behavior found in current tests.
  - Suggested fix (test, not code): add a WorkingCalendar unit test where a holiday falls on a Sunday and a request lands on the Saturday before, and another where the only working day is one weekday and a holiday removes it, to ensure `nextWorkingDay`/`endDate` behave as expected.

Medium severity — restricted scope behaviors that are plausible gaps but unverified:
- Empty or all-holiday ranges and zero-working-day calendars after holiday removal.
  - File: `app/Domain/Scheduling/WorkingCalendar.php`.
  - Issue: Constructor forbids empty working-day set at construction time, which prevents many degenerate cases, but `WorkingCalendar` can still be constructed with holidays such that a particular requested range has no working days inside it. The arithmetic methods do not seem to have explicit tests for the “range contains no working days” outcome except via exceptions in shift when exceeding iteration limit.
  - Suggested fix: add tests asserting that `nextWorkingDay`, `addWorkingDays`, `endDate`, and `shift` still find a working day across a long weekend+holiday block, and that `countWorkingDays` with identical start and end returns 0 even across holidays.
- Milestone slack/critical semantics not fully asserted.
  - File: `app/Domain/Scheduling/ScheduleEngine.php` and `tests/Unit/Scheduling/ScheduleEngineTest.php`.
  - Issue: Milestone test (`TSK-5`) only asserts earlyStart==earlyFinish; it does not assert lateStart/lateFinish/slack/isCritical for the milestone. For a 0-duration task, the engine sets start==finish for early and late, and slack is computed from countWorkingDays(earlyStart, lateStart). Depending on dependencies, a milestone may end up critical or not; current test does not document intended behavior.
  - Suggested fix: add explicit assertions for milestone late dates and slack in a case where the milestone is on the critical path and in a case where it has float.

Low severity — missing coverage and minor hardening opportunities:
- Parent roll-up only covers one nesting level in tests.
  - File: `tests/Unit/Scheduling/ScheduleEngineTest.php`.
  - Issue: Existing parent test has one parent and two children, but no test for grandparent→parent→child chain where roll-up must bubble through two levels.
  - Suggested fix: add one reference test with a grandparent, an intermediate parent, and leaf children, asserting grandparent start/end, and that dependencies to grandparent expand correctly.
- Backward pass for parents is only indirectly covered by the one parent test.
  - File: `app/Domain/Scheduling/ScheduleEngine.php` method `rollUpParentsBackward`.
  - Issue: Parent lateFinish is tested in one case, but there is no explicit test where two parents have different child-finish profiles and the resulting parent late starts differ. Hard to know if the parent late-start derivation matches intent for more complex nesting.
  - Suggested fix: add a two-parent test with differing child spans and assert each parent’s lateStart/lateFinish and slack.
- Topological ordering used for forward/backward pass is recomputed twice per calculate.
  - File: `app/Domain/Scheduling/ScheduleEngine.php`, methods `forwardPass` and `backwardPass`.
  - Issue: Both passes call `new DependencyGraph(...)->topologicalOrder()`. For big graphs this is acceptable given the 500-task test passes in under 1s, but it is duplicated work.
  - Suggested fix (optional, performance only): compute topological order once, store in calculate(), and pass the order into forward/backward pass. Not required for current acceptance criteria.
- `circularDependencyException` path content not fully specified in test.
  - File: `tests/Unit/Scheduling/DependencyGraphTest.php`.
  - Issue: Cycle test asserts count and sum but not exact path order. This is acceptable as a probabilistic check; stronger assertion would pin the cycle sequence.
  - Suggested fix: assert exact array, e.g. `cyclePath` equals expected ordered list for the known cycle.
- `ScheduleResult::all()` returns `array_values($this->byTask)` but ordering is by insertion order of task ids, which may be undefined relative to topological order.
  - File: `app/Domain/Scheduling/ScheduleResult.php`.
  - Issue: Not a correctness bug because consumers usually use `forTask()`; but if any caller depends on `all()` order, it is undocumented.
  - Suggested fix: document that `all()` is not topologically sorted; if sorted output is needed, sort in `ScheduleResult` or a dedicated method.

Untested behavior identified:
- Non-FS/SS edge types: FF and SF are intentionally out of scope per existing comments in `DependencyType.php`. Not a bug; just out of scope.
- Self-dependency and duplicate dependency links as input: `expandLinks` drops self edges; duplicate links are not deduplicated explicitly. Behavior is probably fine because repeated constraints compute the same date, but not tested.
- Very negative lag leading to predecessor after successor constraints is not explicitly covered; only a mild case in SS negative lag test.
- Error paths for unknown task ids in dependency links are partially covered by `descendantLeaves` throwing; not separately tested in engine tests.

In summary: against the acceptance criteria you named, the code already behaves correctly and the tests already pass. The concrete gaps are coverage and edge-case documentation, not a currently failing computation.Final completion check done for the review-only task.

- path: app\Services\Schedule\ScheduleRecalculator.php
  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Services\Schedule;
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ProjectScheduleInput;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulableTask;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleEngine;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
      use App\Models\Calendar;
      use App\Models\Holiday;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
      use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
      
      /**
       * The application-side bridge to the scheduling engine.
       *
       * Loads a project with Eloquent, converts it into pure domain DTOs, calls the
       * ONE recalculation entry point (ScheduleEngine::calculate) and persists the
       * calculated dates/slack/critical flags back onto the tasks (CPM-6).
       *
       * Views and controllers never compute dates — they only read what is written here.
       */
      final class ScheduleRecalculator
      {
          public function __construct(private readonly ScheduleEngine $engine) {}
      
          /**
           * Recalculate and persist the whole schedule of a project (PRD §8.6).
           */
          public function recalculate(Project $project): void
          {
              $calendar = $project->calendar()->first();
      
              if ($calendar === null) {
                  return; // no calendar yet — nothing sane to compute
              }
      
              $tasks = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->orderBy('order')
                  ->get();
      
              $holidays = Holiday::query()
                  ->where('calendar_id', $calendar->id)
                  ->get();
      
              $defaultStart = $tasks
                  ->pluck('start_input')
                  ->filter()
                  ->sort()
                  ->first() ?? now()->startOfDay();
      
              $input = new ProjectScheduleInput(
                  calendar: $this->buildCalendar($calendar, $holidays),
                  tasks: $this->buildTasks($tasks),
                  links: $this->buildLinks($project),
                  defaultStart: DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($defaultStart->toDateTimeImmutable()),
              );
      
              $result = $this->engine->calculate($input);
      
              DB::transaction(static function () use ($tasks, $result, $project, $calendar, $holidays): void {
                  foreach ($tasks as $task) {
                      $schedule = $result->forTask($task->id);
      
                      if ($schedule === null) {
                          continue;
                      }
      
                      $task->forceFill([
                          'effective_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'effective_end' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'early_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'early_finish' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'late_start' => $schedule->lateStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'late_finish' => $schedule->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'slack' => $schedule->slack,
                          'is_critical' => $schedule->isCritical,
                      ])->saveQuietly();
                  }
      
                  // Keep the legacy JSON mirror in sync; the holidays table is the source of truth (D-15).
                  $calendar->forceFill([
                      'holidays' => $holidays->map(static fn (Holiday $holiday): array => [
                          'id' => (string) $holiday->id,
                          'name' => $holiday->name,
                          'date' => $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d'),
                          'end_date' => $holiday->end_date?->format('Y-m-d'),
                      ])->values()->all(),
                  ])->saveQuietly();
      
                  $project->forceFill([
                      'started_at' => $result->projectStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                      'completed_at' => $result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                      'total_duration' => $result->totalDuration,
                  ])->saveQuietly();
              });
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  Collection<int, Holiday>  $holidays
           */
          private function buildCalendar(Calendar $calendar, $holidays): WorkingCalendar
          {
              $dates = [];
      
              foreach ($holidays as $holiday) {
                  $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();
                  $end = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;
      
                  for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                      $dates[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');
                  }
              }
      
              return new WorkingCalendar($calendar->working_days ?? [], array_values(array_unique($dates)));
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  Collection<int, Task>  $tasks
           * @return list<SchedulableTask>
           */
          private function buildTasks($tasks): array
          {
              return $tasks->map(static fn (Task $task): SchedulableTask => new SchedulableTask(
                  id: $task->id,
                  parentId: $task->parent_id,
                  position: $task->order,
                  name: $task->name,
                  requestedStart: $task->start_input === null
                      ? null
                      : DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($task->start_input->toDateTimeImmutable()),
                  duration: $task->duration,
              ))->all();
          }
      
          /**
           * @return list<DependencyLink>
           */
          private function buildLinks(Project $project): array
          {
              return $project->dependencies()
                  ->get()
                  ->map(static fn ($dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                      predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                      successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                      type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                      lag: $dependency->lag,
                  ))->all();
          }
      }

- path: app\Services\Schedule\DependencyValidator.php
  content: |
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Services\Schedule;
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyGraph;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      use App\Models\Dependency;
      use App\Models\Project;
      use App\Models\Task;
      
      /**
       * Application-level integrity rules for dependencies and task hierarchy
       * (PRD DEP-5, §8.7: data must never be saved in a state with a dependency cycle).
       *
       * Mirrors what the engine enforces, so bad data is rejected *before* it is written.
       */
      final class DependencyValidator
      {
          /**
           * Validate a candidate dependency (predecessor -> successor).
           *
           * @return list<string> human-readable errors; empty means valid
           */
          public function validateDependency(Project $project, Task $predecessor, Task $successor, string $type, int $lag): array
          {
              $errors = [];
      
              if ($predecessor->project_id !== $project->id || $successor->project_id !== $project->id) {
                  $errors[] = 'Both tasks must belong to this project.';
              }
      
              if (! in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true)) {
                  $errors[] = 'Dependency type must be FS or SS.';
              }
      
              if ($predecessor->id === $successor->id) {
                  $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on itself.';
              }
      
              if ($this->isAncestorOf($predecessor->id, $successor->id, $project)) {
                  $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on one of its own sub-activities.';
              }
      
              if ($this->isAncestorOf($successor->id, $predecessor->id, $project)) {
                  $errors[] = 'A sub-activity cannot be a predecessor of its own parent.';
              }
      
              if ($errors === []) {
                  $cycle = $this->findCycle($project, $predecessor->id, $successor->id);
      
                  if ($cycle !== null) {
                      $errors[] = $this->cycleMessage($project, $cycle);
                  }
              }
      
              return $errors;
          }
      
          /**
           * Would adding this edge create a cycle? Returns the id path (A -> B -> C -> A) or null.
           *
           * @return list<int>|null
           */
          public function findCycle(Project $project, int $predecessorId, int $successorId): ?array
          {
              $tasks = Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->get();
      
              $links = Dependency::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->get()
                  ->map(static fn (Dependency $dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                      predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                      successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                      type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                      lag: $dependency->lag,
                  ))
                  ->all();
      
              $links[] = new DependencyLink($predecessorId, $successorId, DependencyType::FS, 0);
      
              try {
                  (new DependencyGraph($tasks->pluck('id')->all(), $links))->topologicalOrder();
              } catch (CircularDependencyException $exception) {
                  return $exception->cyclePath;
              }
      
              return null;
          }
      
          /**
           * Map an id path to a display message naming the tasks (DEP-5).
           *
           * @param  list<int>  $cycle
           */
          public function cycleMessage(Project $project, array $cycle): string
          {
              $names = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->whereIn('id', $cycle)
                  ->pluck('name', 'id');
      
              $labels = array_map(
                  static fn (int $id): string => (string) ($names[$id] ?? "#{$id}"),
                  $cycle,
              );
      
              $labels[] = $labels[0];
      
              return 'Circular dependency detected: '.implode(' -> ', $labels);
          }
      
          /**
           * Is $ancestorId an ancestor of $taskId (or the same task)?
           */
          public function isAncestorOf(int $ancestorId, int $taskId, Project $project): bool
          {
              $parents = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');
      
              $current = $taskId;
      
              while (isset($parents[$current])) {
                  if ($parents[$current] === $ancestorId) {
                      return true;
                  }
      
                  $current = (int) $parents[$current];
              }
      
              return false;
          }
      
          /**
           * Depth of a task in the hierarchy (0 = top level); guard for the 4-level [A] limit.
           */
          public function depthOf(int $taskId, Project $project): int
          {
              $parents = Task::query()
                  ->where('project_id', $project->id)
                  ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');
      
              $depth = 0;
              $current = $taskId;
      
              while (isset($parents[$current])) {
                  $depth++;
                  $current = (int) $parents[$current];
              }
      
              return $depth;
          }
      }
