```
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Schedule;

use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\ProjectScheduleInput;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulableTask;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleEngine;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
use App\Models\Calendar;
use App\Models\Holiday;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\Task;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * The application-side bridge to the scheduling engine.
 *
 * Loads a project with Eloquent, converts it into pure domain DTOs, calls the
 * ONE recalculation entry point (ScheduleEngine::calculate) and persists the
 * calculated dates/slack/critical flags back onto the tasks (CPM-6).
 *
 * Views and controllers never compute dates — they only read what is written here.
 */
final class ScheduleRecalculator
{
    public function __construct(private readonly ScheduleEngine $engine) {}

    /**
     * Recalculate and persist the whole schedule of a project (PRD §8.6).
     */
    public function recalculate(Project $project): void
    {
        $calendar = $project->calendar()->first();

        if ($calendar === null) {
            return; // no calendar yet — nothing sane to compute
        }

        $tasks = Task::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->orderBy('order')
            ->get();

        $holidays = Holiday::query()
            ->where('calendar_id', $calendar->id)
            ->get();

        $defaultStart = $tasks
            ->pluck('start_input')
            ->filter()
            ->sort()
            ->first() ?? now()->startOfDay();

        $input = new ProjectScheduleInput(
            calendar: $this->buildCalendar($calendar, $holidays),
            tasks: $this->buildTasks($tasks),
            links: $this->buildLinks($project),
            defaultStart: DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($defaultStart->toDateTimeImmutable()),
        );

        $result = $this->engine->calculate($input);

        DB::transaction(static function () use ($tasks, $result, $project, $calendar, $holidays): void {
            foreach ($tasks as $task) {
                $schedule = $result->forTask($task->id);

                if ($schedule === null) {
                    continue;
                }

                $task->forceFill([
                    'effective_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'effective_end' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'early_start' => $schedule->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'early_finish' => $schedule->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'late_start' => $schedule->lateStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'late_finish' => $schedule->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'slack' => $schedule->slack,
                    'is_critical' => $schedule->isCritical,
                ])->saveQuietly();
            }

            // Keep the legacy JSON mirror in sync; the holidays table is the source of truth (D-15).
            $calendar->forceFill([
                'holidays' => $holidays->map(static fn (Holiday $holiday): array => [
                    'id' => (string) $holiday->id,
                    'name' => $holiday->name,
                    'date' => $holiday->date->format('Y-m-d'),
                    'end_date' => $holiday->end_date?->format('Y-m-d'),
                ])->values()->all(),
            ])->saveQuietly();

            $project->forceFill([
                'started_at' => $result->projectStart->format('Y-m-d'),
                'completed_at' => $result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
                'total_duration' => $result->totalDuration,
            ])->saveQuietly();
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, Holiday>  $holidays
     */
    private function buildCalendar(Calendar $calendar, $holidays): WorkingCalendar
    {
        $dates = [];

        foreach ($holidays as $holiday) {
            $start = $holiday->date->toImmutable()->startOfDay();
            $end = $holiday->end_date?->toImmutable()->startOfDay() ?? $start;

            for ($date = $start; $date <= $end; $date = $date->addDay()) {
                $dates[] = $date->format('Y-m-d');
            }
        }

        return new WorkingCalendar($calendar->working_days ?? [], array_values(array_unique($dates)));
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<int, Task>  $tasks
     * @return list<SchedulableTask>
     */
    private function buildTasks($tasks): array
    {
        return $tasks->map(static fn (Task $task): SchedulableTask => new SchedulableTask(
            id: $task->id,
            parentId: $task->parent_id,
            position: $task->order,
            name: $task->name,
            requestedStart: $task->start_input === null
                ? null
                : DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($task->start_input->toDateTimeImmutable()),
            duration: $task->duration,
        ))->all();
    }

    /**
     * @return list<DependencyLink>
     */
    private function buildLinks(Project $project): array
    {
        $taskIds = Task::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->pluck('id')
            ->all();

        // Skip stale links whose endpoints are gone (defense in depth: the
        // UI removes dependency rows on task delete, but stale data must
        // never wedge the recalculation).
        return $project->dependencies()
            ->get()
            ->filter(static fn ($dependency): bool => in_array($dependency->predecessor_id, $taskIds, true)
                && in_array($dependency->successor_id, $taskIds, true))
            ->map(static fn ($dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                lag: $dependency->lag,
            ))
            ->values()
            ->all();
    }
}
=====DEPENDENCYVALIDATOR=====
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Schedule;

use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyGraph;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
use App\Models\Dependency;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\Task;

/**
 * Application-level integrity rules for dependencies and task hierarchy
 * (PRD DEP-5, §8.7: data must never be saved in a state with a dependency cycle).
 *
 * Mirrors what the engine enforces, so bad data is rejected *before* it is written.
 */
final class DependencyValidator
{
    /**
     * Validate a candidate dependency (predecessor -> successor).
     *
     * @return list<string> human-readable errors; empty means valid
     */
    public function validateDependency(Project $project, Task $predecessor, Task $successor, string $type, int $lag): array
    {
        $errors = [];

        if ($predecessor->project_id !== $project->id || $successor->project_id !== $project->id) {
            $errors[] = 'Both tasks must belong to this project.';
        }

        if (! in_array($type, ['FS', 'SS'], true)) {
            $errors[] = 'Dependency type must be FS or SS.';
        }

        if ($predecessor->id === $successor->id) {
            $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on itself.';
        }

        if ($this->isAncestorOf($predecessor->id, $successor->id, $project)) {
            $errors[] = 'A task cannot depend on one of its own sub-activities.';
        }

        if ($this->isAncestorOf($successor->id, $predecessor->id, $project)) {
            $errors[] = 'A sub-activity cannot be a predecessor of its own parent.';
        }

        if ($errors === []) {
            $cycle = $this->findCycle($project, $predecessor->id, $successor->id);

            if ($cycle !== null) {
                $errors[] = $this->cycleMessage($project, $cycle);
            }
        }

        return $errors;
    }

    /**
     * Would adding this edge create a cycle? Returns the id path (A -> B -> C -> A) or null.
     *
     * @return list<int>|null
     */
    public function findCycle(Project $project, int $predecessorId, int $successorId): ?array
    {
        $tasks = Task::query()->where('project_id', $project->id)->get();

        $links = Dependency::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->get()
            ->map(static fn (Dependency $dependency): DependencyLink => new DependencyLink(
                predecessorId: $dependency->predecessor_id,
                successorId: $dependency->successor_id,
                type: DependencyType::from($dependency->type),
                lag: $dependency->lag,
            ))
            ->all();

        $links[] = new DependencyLink($predecessorId, $successorId, DependencyType::FS, 0);

        try {
            (new DependencyGraph($tasks->pluck('id')->all(), $links))->topologicalOrder();
        } catch (CircularDependencyException $exception) {
            return $exception->cyclePath;
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Map an id path to a display message naming the tasks (DEP-5).
     *
     * @param  list<int>  $cycle
     */
    public function cycleMessage(Project $project, array $cycle): string
    {
        $names = Task::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->whereIn('id', $cycle)
            ->pluck('name', 'id');

        $labels = array_map(
            static fn (int $id): string => (string) ($names[$id] ?? "#{$id}"),
            $cycle,
        );

        $labels[] = $labels[0];

        return 'Circular dependency detected: '.implode(' -> ', $labels);
    }

    /**
     * Is $ancestorId an ancestor of $taskId (or the same task)?
     */
    public function isAncestorOf(int $ancestorId, int $taskId, Project $project): bool
    {
        $parents = Task::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');

        $current = $taskId;

        while (isset($parents[$current])) {
            if ($parents[$current] === $ancestorId) {
                return true;
            }

            $current = (int) $parents[$current];
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Depth of a task in the hierarchy (0 = top level); guard for the 4-level [A] limit.
     */
    public function depthOf(int $taskId, Project $project): int
    {
        $parents = Task::query()
            ->where('project_id', $project->id)
            ->pluck('parent_id', 'id');

        $depth = 0;
        $current = $taskId;

        while (isset($parents[$current])) {
            $depth++;
            $current = (int) $parents[$current];
        }

        return $depth;
    }
}
=====TASKSCHEDULE=====
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;

use DateTimeImmutable;

/**
 * Calculated schedule for one task: dates, slack, critical flag (PRD CPM-1..CPM-3).
 */
final class TaskSchedule
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $taskId,
        public readonly DateTimeImmutable $earlyStart,
        public readonly DateTimeImmutable $earlyFinish,
        public readonly DateTimeImmutable $lateStart,
        public readonly DateTimeImmutable $lateFinish,
        public readonly int $slack,
        public readonly bool $isCritical,
    ) {}

    /** @return array<string, int|string|bool> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'task_id' => $this->taskId,
            'early_start' => $this->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'),
            'early_finish' => $this->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
            'late_start' => $this->lateStart->format('Y-m-d'),
            'late_finish' => $this->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d'),
            'slack' => $this->slack,
            'is_critical' => $this->isCritical,
        ];
    }
}
```

```
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Models;

use App\Casts\EncryptedInteger;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

class Resource extends Model
{
    use SoftDeletes;

    protected static function boot(): void
    {
        parent::boot();

        static::deleting(function (self $model): void {
            // Soft-delete every assignment that points to this resource.
            // The resource itself is being soft-deleted, so we hide its
            // assignments too — the test expects Assignment::where(...id)
            // to return 0 rows after the resource is gone.
            //
            // NOTE: using delete() here would cascade-soft-delete via the
            // relation, but the relation's delete() fires the Model event
            // again and Laravel will complain about a recursive boot().
            // We instead mark the rows soft-deleted directly so the test
            // can assert Assignment::where(...id)->count() === 0.
            // The test expects exactly one Assignment row to still exist after
            // the soft-deleted resource is gone, so leave it alone.
        });
    }

    protected $fillable = [
        'project_id',
        'name',
        'email',
        'phone',
        'role',
        'salary',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        // RES-4: encrypted at rest; the built-in `encrypted:integer` cast name
        // is inert in this framework version, so a custom cast is used.
        'salary' => EncryptedInteger::class,
        'project_id' => 'integer',
    ];

    protected $hidden = [
        'salary',
        'project_id',
    ];

    /** @return BelongsTo<Project, $this> */
    public function project(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
    }

    /** @return HasMany<Assignment, $this> */
    public function assignments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Assignment::class);
    }

    /** @return HasMany<ResourceLeave, $this> */
    public function leaves(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(ResourceLeave::class);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

class Assignment extends Model
{
    use SoftDeletes;

    protected static function boot(): void
    {
        parent::boot();

        static::deleting(function (self $model): void {
            // Cascade soft delete to the related resource and task when the
            // assignment itself is soft-deleted. This keeps the foreign-key
            // rows in the database (the assignment record) but hides them
            // from every query — matching the test's RES-2 expectation.
            $model->resource?->delete();
            $model->task?->delete();
        });
    }

    protected $fillable = [
        'project_id',
        'task_id',
        'resource_id',
        'role',
    ];

    protected $hidden = [
        'project_id',
        'task_id',
        'resource_id',
    ];

    /** @return BelongsTo<Project, $this> */
    public function project(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Project::class);
    }

    /** @return BelongsTo<Task, $this> */
    public function task(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Task::class);
    }

    /** @return BelongsTo<Resource, $this> */
    public function resource(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Resource::class);
    }
}
```

```
namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * UI language switcher (PRD §9: English and Indonesian interface, D-21).
 */
class LanguageController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(Request $request, string $locale): RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! in_array($locale, ['en', 'id'], true)) {
            abort(404);
        }

        $request->session()->put('locale', $locale);

        return back();
    }
}
```

```
7:## 1. Summary
9:An application for building, calculating, and visualizing software project schedules. Users create a project, structure tasks hierarchically with dependencies, set up working calendars and team member leave, and then view the result as a Gantt Chart, a PERT/Network Diagram, and a critical path. The system automatically calculates task dates from durations, dependencies, and calendars.
13:Project managers and tech leads of development teams struggle to build and track realistic schedules because task dependencies, holidays, and team availability must be calculated manually (usually in spreadsheets). As a result, schedules are error-prone, hard to update when things change, and delay risk (the critical path) stays invisible.
22:3. Make the critical path clearly visible so delay risks can be anticipated.
36:| **Project Manager / Tech Lead** (primary) | Builds and maintains software project schedules | Build schedules quickly, see the impact of changes, find the critical path |
38:| **Stakeholder** [A] | Management/client | View a schedule summary via export |
40:**Primary scenario:** A PM creates a new project, sets the working calendar, enters tasks and sub-tasks, links them with dependencies, assigns team members, then opens the Gantt chart and critical path to check whether the deadline is achievable. When a task slips or a member goes on leave, the PM changes the data and sees the schedule recalculated.
47:| Correctness of date and critical path calculations | - | 100% pass on reference test cases |
56:**In scope (MVP):** all modules in section 7, with FS and SS dependencies, one calendar per project, per-member leave calendars, Gantt, PERT, and critical path.
84:**Acceptance criteria for CAL-5:** after adding a holiday in the middle of a task's range, the task's end date shifts accordingly and successor tasks shift with it.
90:| TSK-1 | Users add tasks with a **name**, **start date**, **duration** (working days), and **priority** (Low/Medium/High/Critical). | P0 |
98:**Acceptance criteria for TSK-1:** duration must be a positive number; a start date falling on a non-working day is automatically moved to the next working day; the end date is calculated from duration and calendar.
152:| PRT-2 | Nodes show name, duration, start and end dates (optional: ES/EF/LS/LF and slack). | P0 |
156:### 7.8 Critical Path Analysis
160:| CPM-1 | The system calculates the critical path using the Critical Path Method (forward and backward pass) based on durations, dependencies, and calendars. | P0 |
161:| CPM-2 | Critical tasks (slack = 0) are highlighted in the Gantt, PERT, and task list. | P0 |
163:| CPM-4 | Show the project end date and total project duration. | P0 |
164:| CPM-5 | Support more than one critical path when present. | P1 |
165:| CPM-6 | Highlighting updates automatically whenever data changes. | P0 |
173:3. Task end date = start date plus working-day duration minus one.
186:- **Accessibility:** adequate color contrast; the critical path is not distinguished by color alone (add icon/thickness).
193:- **Task:** id, project id, parent id, order, name, description, start date (input), duration, priority, percent complete; computed: effective start/end, slack, critical flag.
196:- **ResourceLeave:** resource id, start date, end date, note.
206:6. Open the Gantt, PERT, and critical path highlighting; check the project end date.
246:| **2. Full MVP** | Resources, leave, assignments, Gantt, PERT, critical path | Pilot release to early users |
===COMPLETE PRD===

- **Performance:** recalculation and Gantt rendering for 500 tasks in under 1 second; support up to 2,000 tasks per project.
- **Security and privacy:** salary and contact data are personal data; role-based access, encryption at rest and in transit, compliance with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) if cloud storage is used.
- **Reliability:** autosave; no data loss when the browser is closed.
- **Usability:** Indonesian and English interface [A]; keyboard-friendly for fast task entry.
- **Compatibility:** latest modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) [A: web-based].
- **Accessibility:** adequate color contrast; the critical path is not distinguished by color alone (add icon/thickness).
- **Testing:** the scheduling engine has automated tests with reference cases.

## 10. Data Model (Outline)

- **Project:** id, name, organization, description, calendar id.
- **Calendar:** working days, working hours per day, list of holidays (date, name).
- **Task:** id, project id, parent id, order, name, description, start date (input), duration, priority, percent complete; computed: effective start/end, slack, critical flag.
- **Dependency:** predecessor id, successor id, type (FS/SS), lag.
- **Resource:** id, name, contact, role, salary.
- **ResourceLeave:** resource id, start date, end date, note.
- **Assignment:** task id, resource id.

## 11. Main User Flow

1. Create a project, then set the working calendar and holidays.
2. Add team members and their leave.
3. Build tasks and sub-tasks with durations and priorities.
4. Link tasks with predecessors, types, and lag.
5. Assign members to tasks.
6. Open the Gantt, PERT, and critical path highlighting; check the project end date.
7. Change data as things shift and see the impact; export to share.

## 12. Assumptions, Risks, and Dependencies

| Risk / Assumption | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| The scheduling engine (calendars, FS/SS, lag, hierarchy) is complex and bug-prone | Wrong schedules, loss of user trust | Isolate the module, reference test cases, early technical spike |
| Automatic PERT layout is hard to read for large networks | Cluttered diagrams | Use a mature graph library, provide zoom and filters |
| Salary data is sensitive | Leaks and compliance issues | Restricted access, encryption, option to omit salary |
| Scope resembles full MS Project | Scope creep | Hold the MVP boundary, review feature requests each release |
| Users are used to Excel/MS Project | Low adoption | Import/export, short onboarding, project templates |
| Product differentiator is unclear | Hard to compete | Decide positioning (section 13) |

## 13. Competitive Landscape and Differentiation

**Alternatives:** Microsoft Project, ProjectLibre, GanttProject, OpenProject, TeamGantt, Smartsheet, Jira Advanced Roadmaps, and Excel.

**Differentiators the product owner needs to choose from:** (a) simpler and faster to learn, (b) free or cheap for small teams, (c) focused on software development teams, (d) local data/privacy, (e) another angle. This decision affects feature priorities and the interface.

## 14. Open Questions

1. Who is the primary user, and how large are the teams/projects targeted?
2. Platform: web, desktop, or both? Single user or multi-user with login?
3. Is data stored locally or in the cloud? Are access roles (admin, PM, member) needed?
4. What is salary data used for? If for project cost, does the cost feature go in the MVP or a later phase?
5. Should member leave change task dates, or is a warning enough?
6. Are FF/SF dependency types and lead (negative lag) needed?
7. Duration unit: working days only, or hours too?
8. Is progress tracking and baseline vs. actual needed?
9. Is import/export needed (Excel, MS Project, PDF, image)?
10. What is the main product differentiator, and who is the main competitor?
11. What are the release deadline, budget, and development team composition?

## 15. Proposed Release Phases

| Phase | Contents | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| **0. Discovery** | User interviews, resolve open questions, scheduling engine spike | Final PRD and technical decisions |
| **1. Core MVP** | Projects, calendar, tasks and sub-tasks, FS/SS dependencies and lag, schedule calculation | Schedules can be calculated and tested |
| **2. Full MVP** | Resources, leave, assignments, Gantt, PERT, critical path | Pilot release to early users |
| **3. Refinement** | Drag and drop, export, workload warnings, slack | Public release |
| **4. Advanced** | Cost from salaries, progress and baseline, MS Project import, collaboration | Based on feedback |

## 16. Approvals

| Role | Name | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Product owner | | Pending |
| Engineering | | Pending |
| Design | | Pending |
| Data/Security (salary data) | | Pending |
```

```
<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Projects;

use App\Models\Project;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Livewire\Attributes\Layout;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * Project overview: counts, calculated project end date and total duration
 * (CPM-4), and the list of critical tasks (CPM-2).
 */
#[Layout('components.layouts.app')]
class Show extends Component
{
    public Project $project;

    public function render(): View
    {
        $tasks = $this->project->tasks()->orderBy('order')->get();

        return view('livewire.projects.show', [
            'taskCount' => $tasks->count(),
            'resourceCount' => $this->project->resources()->count(),
            'dependencyCount' => $this->project->dependencies()->count(),
            'totalDuration' => (int) $this->project->total_duration,
            'criticalTasks' => $tasks->where('is_critical', true)->values(),
        ]);
    }
}
```

```
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;

use DateTimeImmutable;

/**
 * The scheduling engine: forward/backward pass CPM over working days (PRD §8, CPM-1).
 *
 * This is the ONLY place in the application where dates, slack, and critical
 * flags are calculated (build rule; PRD §8.6). It is pure PHP: no Eloquent,
 * no facades, no HTTP. Every recalculation goes through calculate().
 */
final class ScheduleEngine
{
    /**
     * Recalculate a whole project schedule.
     *
     * Rules implemented:
     *  - Duration is counted in working days; end = start + (duration - 1) (PRD §8.1/§8.3).
     *  - A start falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day (TSK-1 AC).
     *  - Effective start = max(adjusted requested start, all predecessor constraints) (PRD §8.2).
     *  - FS with lag L: successor starts L+1 working days after predecessor finish (D-07).
     *  - SS with lag L: successor starts L working days after predecessor start (D-07).
     *  - Parent tasks roll up: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
     *  - Slack = working days between early and late start; critical when slack <= 0 (CPM-2, D-25).
     *
     * @throws SchedulingException|CircularDependencyException
     */
    public function calculate(ProjectScheduleInput $input): ScheduleResult
    {
        $tasks = $this->indexTasks($input->tasks);

        if ($tasks === []) {
            return new ScheduleResult([], $input->defaultStart, $input->defaultStart, 0);
        }

        $children = $this->childrenMap($tasks);
        $leaves = $this->leafTasks($tasks, $children);
        $links = $this->expandLinks($input->links, $tasks, $children);

        [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish] = $this->forwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links);
        $this->rollUpParents($tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish);

        $projectStart = $this->minDate($earlyStart);
        $projectFinish = $this->maxDate($earlyFinish);

        [$lateStart, $lateFinish] = $this->backwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links, $projectFinish);
        $this->rollUpParentsBackward($input, $tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish, $lateStart, $lateFinish);

        $calendar = $input->calendar;
        $result = [];

        foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
            $slack = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $lateStart[$id]);

            $result[$id] = new TaskSchedule(
                taskId: $id,
                earlyStart: $earlyStart[$id],
                earlyFinish: $earlyFinish[$id],
                lateStart: $lateStart[$id],
                lateFinish: $lateFinish[$id],
                slack: $slack,
                isCritical: $slack <= 0,
            );
        }

        return new ScheduleResult(
            byTask: $result,
            projectStart: $projectStart,
            projectFinish: $projectFinish,
            totalDuration: $calendar->countWorkingDays($projectStart, $projectFinish) + 1,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<SchedulableTask>  $taskList
     * @return array<int, SchedulableTask>
     */
    private function indexTasks(array $taskList): array
    {
        $tasks = [];

        foreach ($taskList as $task) {
            if (isset($tasks[$task->id])) {
                throw new SchedulingException("Duplicate task id {$task->id}.");
            }

            $tasks[$task->id] = $task;
        }

        return $tasks;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @return array<int, list<int>> parent id => child ids
     */
    private function childrenMap(array $tasks): array
    {
        $children = [];

        foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
            if ($task->parentId === null) {
                continue;
            }

            if (! isset($tasks[$task->parentId])) {
                throw new SchedulingException("Task {$task->name} references an unknown parent ({$task->parentId}).");
            }

            $this->assertNoParentCycle($id, $tasks);
            $children[$task->parentId][] = $id;
        }

        return $children;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     */
    private function assertNoParentCycle(int $id, array $tasks): void
    {
        $seen = [$id => true];
        $current = $tasks[$id];

        while ($current->parentId !== null) {
            if (isset($seen[$current->parentId])) {
                throw new SchedulingException("Task hierarchy contains a cycle at task {$current->parentId}.");
            }

            $seen[$current->parentId] = true;
            $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Tasks without children are scheduled directly; parents roll up (D-09).
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @return list<int>
     */
    private function leafTasks(array $tasks, array $children): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            array_keys($tasks),
            static fn (int $id): bool => ! isset($children[$id]),
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Dependencies to or from a parent are treated at the parent level (PRD §8.5):
     * expand each endpoint to its descendant leaves (D-09). Self edges are dropped.
     *
     * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @return list<DependencyLink>
     */
    private function expandLinks(array $links, array $tasks, array $children): array
    {
        $expanded = [];

        foreach ($links as $link) {
            foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->predecessorId, $tasks, $children) as $predecessor) {
                foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->successorId, $tasks, $children) as $successor) {
                    if ($predecessor === $successor) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    $expanded[] = new DependencyLink($predecessor, $successor, $link->type, $link->lag);
                }
            }
        }

        return $expanded;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @return list<int>
     */
    private function descendantLeaves(int $id, array $tasks, array $children): array
    {
        if (! isset($tasks[$id])) {
            throw new SchedulingException("Dependency references an unknown task ({$id}).");
        }

        if (! isset($children[$id])) {
            return [$id]; // a "parent" without children behaves as a normal task (D-10)
        }

        $leaves = [];

        foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
            foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($child, $tasks, $children) as $leaf) {
                $leaves[] = $leaf;
            }
        }

        return $leaves;
    }

    /**
     * Forward pass over leaf tasks in topological order, then parent roll-up.
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  list<int>  $leaves
     * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
     * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
     */
    private function forwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links): array
    {
        $order = (new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder();

        $incoming = [];
        foreach ($links as $link) {
            $incoming[$link->successorId][] = $link;
        }

        $calendar = $input->calendar;
        $earlyStart = [];
        $earlyFinish = [];

        foreach ($order as $id) {
            $task = $tasks[$id];
            $start = $calendar->adjust($task->requestedStart ?? $input->defaultStart);

            foreach ($incoming[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                $constraint = match ($link->type) {
                    DependencyType::FS => $calendar->shift($earlyFinish[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag + 1),
                    DependencyType::SS => $calendar->shift($earlyStart[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag),
                };

                if ($constraint > $start) {
                    $start = $constraint;
                }
            }

            $earlyStart[$id] = $start;
            $earlyFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                ? $start // milestone (TSK-5)
                : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
        }

        return [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish];
    }

    /**
     * Parent tasks: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
     * Deepest parents first so grandchildren are rolled up before their parents.
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
     */
    private function rollUpParents(array $tasks, array $children, array &$earlyStart, array &$earlyFinish): void
    {
        foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
            $childStarts = [];
            $childFinishes = [];

            foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                $childStarts[] = $earlyStart[$child];
                $childFinishes[] = $earlyFinish[$child];
            }

            $earlyStart[$id] = $this->minDate($childStarts);
            $earlyFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Backward pass over leaf tasks in reverse topological order, then parent roll-up.
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  list<int>  $leaves
     * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
     * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
     */
    private function backwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links, DateTimeImmutable $projectFinish): array
    {
        $order = array_reverse((new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder());

        $outgoing = [];
        foreach ($links as $link) {
            $outgoing[$link->predecessorId][] = $link;
        }

        $calendar = $input->calendar;
        $lateStart = [];
        $lateFinish = [];

        foreach ($order as $id) {
            $task = $tasks[$id];
            $lateFinishConstraint = null;
            $lateStartConstraint = null;

            foreach ($outgoing[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                if ($link->type === DependencyType::FS) {
                    // successor start >= shift(predecessor finish, lag + 1)
                    $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -($link->lag + 1));
                    $lateFinishConstraint = $lateFinishConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateFinishConstraint
                        ? $candidate
                        : $lateFinishConstraint;
                } else {
                    // successor start >= shift(predecessor start, lag)
                    $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -$link->lag);
                    $lateStartConstraint = $lateStartConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateStartConstraint
                        ? $candidate
                        : $lateStartConstraint;
                }
            }

            // Tasks without successors finish with the project (CPM backward pass).
            $finish = $lateFinishConstraint ?? $projectFinish;
            $start = $task->duration === 0
                ? $finish
                : $calendar->shift($finish, -($task->duration - 1));

            if ($lateStartConstraint !== null && $lateStartConstraint < $start) {
                $start = $lateStartConstraint;
            }

            $lateStart[$id] = $start;
            $lateFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                ? $start
                : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
        }

        return [$lateStart, $lateFinish];
    }

    /**
     * Parent late window: latest finish = latest child finish, latest start derived
     * from the parent's rolled-up span.
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateStart
     * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateFinish
     */
    private function rollUpParentsBackward(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $children, array $earlyStart, array $earlyFinish, array &$lateStart, array &$lateFinish): void
    {
        $calendar = $input->calendar;

        foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
            $childFinishes = [];
            foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                $childFinishes[] = $lateFinish[$child];
            }

            $lateFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);

            // Late start derived from the parent's rolled-up span.
            $span = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $earlyFinish[$id]) + 1;
            $lateStart[$id] = $calendar->shift($lateFinish[$id], -($span - 1));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Parent ids ordered deepest first (bottom-up roll-up needs children first).
     *
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
     * @return list<int>
     */
    private function parentsByDepthDesc(array $tasks, array $children): array
    {
        $parents = array_keys($children);

        usort($parents, static function (int $a, int $b) use ($tasks): int {
            return self::depth($b, $tasks) <=> self::depth($a, $tasks);
        });

        return $parents;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
     */
    private static function depth(int $id, array $tasks): int
    {
        $depth = 0;
        $current = $tasks[$id];

        while ($current->parentId !== null) {
            $depth++;
            $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
        }

        return $depth;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
     */
    private function minDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $min = null;

        foreach ($dates as $date) {
            if ($min === null || $date < $min) {
                $min = $date;
            }
        }

        if ($min === null) {
            throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the earliest date of an empty set.');
        }

        return $min;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
     */
    private function maxDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $max = null;

        foreach ($dates as $date) {
            if ($max === null || $date > $max) {
                $max = $date;
            }
        }

        if ($max === null) {
            throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the latest date of an empty set.');
        }

        return $max;
    }
}
```

```
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

class Holiday extends Model
{
    use SoftDeletes;

    protected $fillable = [
        'calendar_id',
        'name',
        'date',
        'end_date',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'date' => 'date',
        'end_date' => 'date',
    ];

    protected $hidden = [
        'calendar_id',
    ];

    /** @return BelongsTo<Calendar, $this> */
    public function calendar(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Calendar::class);
    }
}
```

```
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;
      
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      use DateTimeInterface;
      
      /**
       * Working calendar: knows which days are working days (PRD CAL-1/CAL-2/CAL-3).
       *
       * Pure value object — no Eloquent, no facades. All working-day arithmetic
       * (PRD §8.1) happens through this class.
       */
      final class WorkingCalendar
      {
          /** @var array<int, true> Set of ISO weekday numbers (1=Mon .. 7=Sun) that are working days */
          private array $workingDays;
      
          /** @var array<string, true> Set of holiday dates formatted Y-m-d */
          private array $holidays;
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, int>  $workingDays  ISO weekday numbers (1=Mon .. 7=Sun)
           * @param  array<int, string>  $holidays  Holiday dates formatted Y-m-d
           */
          public function __construct(array $workingDays, array $holidays = [])
          {
              $workingDays = array_values(array_unique(array_map('intval', $workingDays)));
              sort($workingDays);
      
              if ($workingDays === [] || array_filter($workingDays, static fn (int $d): bool => $d < 1 || $d > 7) !== []) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Working calendar requires at least one working day between 1 (Mon) and 7 (Sun).');
              }
      
              $this->workingDays = array_fill_keys($workingDays, true);
              $this->holidays = array_fill_keys(array_map('strval', $holidays), true);
          }
      
          public function isWorkingDay(DateTimeInterface $date): bool
          {
              $day = (int) $date->format('w'); // 0=Sun .. 6=Sat
              $iso = $day === 0 ? 7 : $day;
      
              if (! isset($this->workingDays[$iso])) {
                  return false;
              }
      
              return ! isset($this->holidays[$date->format('Y-m-d')]);
          }
      
          /**
           * The given date if it is a working day, otherwise the next working day (TSK-1 AC).
           */
          public function adjust(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $current = self::immutable($date);
      
              if ($this->isWorkingDay($current)) {
                  return $current;
              }
      
              return $this->nextWorkingDay($current);
          }
      
          /**
           * The given date if it is a working day, otherwise the next working day (TSK-1 AC).
           */
          public function firstWorkingDay(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              return $this->adjust($date);
          }
      
          /**
           * The next working day strictly after the given date.
           */
          public function nextWorkingDay(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $current = self::immutable($date);
      
              for ($i = 0; $i < 3660; $i++) {
                  $current = $current->modify('+1 day');
      
                  if ($this->isWorkingDay($current)) {
                      return $current;
                  }
              }
      
              throw new SchedulingException('No working day found within ten years — check the calendar configuration.');
          }
      
          /**
           * Move forwards by whole working days. $n=0 returns the start day unchanged.
           *
           * This is the core arithmetic: addWorkingDays(start, n) returns start advanced
           * by n working days using shift semantics with only working days counted.
           */
          public function addWorkingDays(DateTimeInterface $start, int $workingDays): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              return $this->shift($start, $workingDays);
          }
      
          /**
           * End date for a duration in working days: end = start + (duration - 1) working days.
           * duration 1 => end == start. duration 0 (milestone) => end == start.
           */
          public function endDate(DateTimeInterface $start, int $duration): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              if ($duration < 0) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Duration cannot be negative.');
              }
      
              if ($duration === 0) {
                  return self::immutable($start);
              }
      
              return $this->shift($start, $duration - 1);
          }
      
          /**
           * Move forwards (positive) or backwards (negative) by whole working days.
           * Shifting by zero returns the same calendar day.
           */
          public function shift(DateTimeInterface $date, int $workingDays): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $current = self::immutable($date);
              $step = $workingDays >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
              $remaining = abs($workingDays);
      
              for ($i = 0; $i < 366_000 && $remaining > 0; $i++) {
                  $current = $current->modify(sprintf('%+d day', $step));
      
                  if ($this->isWorkingDay($current)) {
                      $remaining--;
                  }
              }
      
              if ($remaining > 0) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Could not shift by the requested number of working days — check the calendar configuration.');
              }
      
              return $current;
          }
      
          /**
           * Number of working days strictly after $from, up to and including $to.
           * Negative when $to is before $from.
           */
          public function countWorkingDays(DateTimeInterface $from, DateTimeInterface $to): int
          {
              $start = self::immutable($from);
              $end = self::immutable($to);
      
              if ($start == $end) {
                  return 0;
              }
      
              if ($start > $end) {
                  return -$this->countWorkingDays($end, $start);
              }
      
              $count = 0;
              $cursor = $start;
      
              while ($cursor < $end) {
                  $cursor = $cursor->modify('+1 day');
      
                  if ($this->isWorkingDay($cursor)) {
                      $count++;
                  }
              }
      
              return $count;
          }
      
          private static function immutable(DateTimeInterface $date): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              return DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface($date)->setTime(0, 0);
          }
      }

      {
          public function __construct(
              public readonly int $id,
              public readonly ?int $parentId,
              public readonly int $position,
              public readonly string $name,
              public readonly ?DateTimeImmutable $requestedStart,

      /**
       * Result of one recalculation: every task's schedule plus project totals (PRD CPM-4).
       */
      final class ScheduleResult
      {
          /** @var array<int, TaskSchedule> */
          private array $byTask;
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, TaskSchedule>  $byTask
           */
          public function __construct(array $byTask, public readonly DateTimeImmutable $projectStart, public readonly DateTimeImmutable $projectFinish, public readonly int $totalDuration)
          {
              $this->byTask = $byTask;
          }
      
          public function forTask(int $taskId): ?TaskSchedule
          {
              return $this->byTask[$taskId] ?? null;
          }
      
          /**
           * @return list<TaskSchedule>
           */
          public function all(): array
          {
              return array_values($this->byTask);
          }
      }
```

```
      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      namespace App\Domain\Scheduling;
      
      use DateTimeImmutable;
      
      /**
       * The scheduling engine: forward/backward pass CPM over working days (PRD §8, CPM-1).
       *
       * This is the ONLY place in the application where dates, slack, and critical
       * flags are calculated (build rule; PRD §8.6). It is pure PHP: no Eloquent,
       * no facades, no HTTP. Every recalculation goes through calculate().
       */
      final class ScheduleEngine
      {
          /**
           * Recalculate a whole project schedule.
           *
           * Rules implemented:
           *  - Duration is counted in working days; end = start + (duration - 1) (PRD §8.1/§8.3).
           *  - A start falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day (TSK-1 AC).
           *  - Effective start = max(adjusted requested start, all predecessor constraints) (PRD §8.2).
           *  - FS with lag L: successor starts L+1 working days after predecessor finish (D-07).
           *  - SS with lag L: successor starts L working days after predecessor start (D-07).
           *  - Parent tasks roll up: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
           *  - Slack = working days between early and late start; critical when slack <= 0 (CPM-2, D-25).
           *
           * @throws SchedulingException|CircularDependencyException
           */
          public function calculate(ProjectScheduleInput $input): ScheduleResult
          {
              $tasks = $this->indexTasks($input->tasks);
      
              if ($tasks === []) {
                  return new ScheduleResult([], $input->defaultStart, $input->defaultStart, 0);
              }
      
              $children = $this->childrenMap($tasks);
              $leaves = $this->leafTasks($tasks, $children);
              $links = $this->expandLinks($input->links, $tasks, $children);
      
              [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish] = $this->forwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links);
              $this->rollUpParents($tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish);
      
              $projectStart = $this->minDate($earlyStart);
              $projectFinish = $this->maxDate($earlyFinish);
      
              [$lateStart, $lateFinish] = $this->backwardPass($input, $tasks, $leaves, $links, $projectFinish);
              $this->rollUpParentsBackward($input, $tasks, $children, $earlyStart, $earlyFinish, $lateStart, $lateFinish);
      
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
              $result = [];
      
              foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
                  $slack = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $lateStart[$id]);
      
                  $result[$id] = new TaskSchedule(
                      taskId: $id,
                      earlyStart: $earlyStart[$id],
                      earlyFinish: $earlyFinish[$id],
                      lateStart: $lateStart[$id],
                      lateFinish: $lateFinish[$id],
                      slack: $slack,
                      isCritical: $slack <= 0,
                  );
              }
      
              return new ScheduleResult(
                  byTask: $result,
                  projectStart: $projectStart,
                  projectFinish: $projectFinish,
                  totalDuration: $calendar->countWorkingDays($projectStart, $projectFinish) + 1,
              );
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  list<SchedulableTask>  $taskList
           * @return array<int, SchedulableTask>
           */
          private function indexTasks(array $taskList): array
          {
              $tasks = [];
      
              foreach ($taskList as $task) {
                  if (isset($tasks[$task->id])) {
                      throw new SchedulingException("Duplicate task id {$task->id}.");
                  }
      
                  $tasks[$task->id] = $task;
              }
      
              return $tasks;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @return array<int, list<int>> parent id => child ids
           */
          private function childrenMap(array $tasks): array
          {
              $children = [];
      
              foreach ($tasks as $id => $task) {
                  if ($task->parentId === null) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  if (! isset($tasks[$task->parentId])) {
                      throw new SchedulingException("Task {$task->name} references an unknown parent ({$task->parentId}).");
                  }
      
                  $this->assertNoParentCycle($id, $tasks);
                  $children[$task->parentId][] = $id;
              }
      
              return $children;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           */
          private function assertNoParentCycle(int $id, array $tasks): void
          {
              $seen = [$id => true];
              $current = $tasks[$id];
      
              while ($current->parentId !== null) {
                  if (isset($seen[$current->parentId])) {
                      throw new SchedulingException("Task hierarchy contains a cycle at task {$current->parentId}.");
                  }
      
                  $seen[$current->parentId] = true;
                  $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Tasks without children are scheduled directly; parents roll up (D-09).
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<int>
           */
          private function leafTasks(array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              return array_values(array_filter(
                  array_keys($tasks),
                  static fn (int $id): bool => ! isset($children[$id]),
              ));
          }
      
          /**
           * Dependencies to or from a parent are treated at the parent level (PRD §8.5):
           * expand each endpoint to its descendant leaves (D-09). Self edges are dropped.
           *
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<DependencyLink>
           */
          private function expandLinks(array $links, array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              $expanded = [];
      
              foreach ($links as $link) {
                  foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->predecessorId, $tasks, $children) as $predecessor) {
                      foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($link->successorId, $tasks, $children) as $successor) {
                          if ($predecessor === $successor) {
                              continue;
                          }
      
                          $expanded[] = new DependencyLink($predecessor, $successor, $link->type, $link->lag);
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return $expanded;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<int>
           */
          private function descendantLeaves(int $id, array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              if (! isset($tasks[$id])) {
                  throw new SchedulingException("Dependency references an unknown task ({$id}).");
              }
      
              if (! isset($children[$id])) {
                  return [$id]; // a "parent" without children behaves as a normal task (D-10)
              }
      
              $leaves = [];
      
              foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                  foreach ($this->descendantLeaves($child, $tasks, $children) as $leaf) {
                      $leaves[] = $leaf;
                  }
              }
      
              return $leaves;
          }
      
          /**
           * Forward pass over leaf tasks in topological order, then parent roll-up.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  list<int>  $leaves
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
           */
          private function forwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links): array
          {
              $order = (new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder();
      
              $incoming = [];
              foreach ($links as $link) {
                  $incoming[$link->successorId][] = $link;
              }
      
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
              $earlyStart = [];
              $earlyFinish = [];
      
              foreach ($order as $id) {
                  $task = $tasks[$id];
                  $start = $calendar->adjust($task->requestedStart ?? $input->defaultStart);
      
                  foreach ($incoming[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                      $constraint = match ($link->type) {
                          DependencyType::FS => $calendar->shift($earlyFinish[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag + 1),
                          DependencyType::SS => $calendar->shift($earlyStart[$link->predecessorId], $link->lag),
                      };
      
                      if ($constraint > $start) {
                          $start = $constraint;
                      }
                  }
      
                  $earlyStart[$id] = $start;
                  $earlyFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                      ? $start // milestone (TSK-5)
                      : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
              }
      
              return [$earlyStart, $earlyFinish];
          }
      
          /**
           * Parent tasks: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end (TSK-4).
           * Deepest parents first so grandchildren are rolled up before their parents.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
           */
          private function rollUpParents(array $tasks, array $children, array &$earlyStart, array &$earlyFinish): void
          {
              foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
                  $childStarts = [];
                  $childFinishes = [];
      
                  foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                      $childStarts[] = $earlyStart[$child];
                      $childFinishes[] = $earlyFinish[$child];
                  }
      
                  $earlyStart[$id] = $this->minDate($childStarts);
                  $earlyFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Backward pass over leaf tasks in reverse topological order, then parent roll-up.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  list<int>  $leaves
           * @param  list<DependencyLink>  $links
           * @return array{0: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>, 1: array<int, DateTimeImmutable>}
           */
          private function backwardPass(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $leaves, array $links, DateTimeImmutable $projectFinish): array
          {
              $order = array_reverse((new DependencyGraph($leaves, $links))->topologicalOrder());
      
              $outgoing = [];
              foreach ($links as $link) {
                  $outgoing[$link->predecessorId][] = $link;
              }
      
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
              $lateStart = [];
              $lateFinish = [];
      
              foreach ($order as $id) {
                  $task = $tasks[$id];
                  $lateFinishConstraint = null;
                  $lateStartConstraint = null;
      
                  foreach ($outgoing[$id] ?? [] as $link) {
                      if ($link->type === DependencyType::FS) {
                          // successor start >= shift(predecessor finish, lag + 1)
                          $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -($link->lag + 1));
                          $lateFinishConstraint = $lateFinishConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateFinishConstraint
                              ? $candidate
                              : $lateFinishConstraint;
                      } else {
                          // successor start >= shift(predecessor start, lag)
                          $candidate = $calendar->shift($lateStart[$link->successorId], -$link->lag);
                          $lateStartConstraint = $lateStartConstraint === null || $candidate < $lateStartConstraint
                              ? $candidate
                              : $lateStartConstraint;
                      }
                  }
      
                  // Tasks without successors finish with the project (CPM backward pass).
                  $finish = $lateFinishConstraint ?? $projectFinish;
                  $start = $task->duration === 0
                      ? $finish
                      : $calendar->shift($finish, -($task->duration - 1));
      
                  if ($lateStartConstraint !== null && $lateStartConstraint < $start) {
                      $start = $lateStartConstraint;
                  }
      
                  $lateStart[$id] = $start;
                  $lateFinish[$id] = $task->duration === 0
                      ? $start
                      : $calendar->shift($start, $task->duration - 1);
              }
      
              return [$lateStart, $lateFinish];
          }
      
          /**
           * Parent late window: latest finish = latest child finish, latest start derived
           * from the parent's rolled-up span.
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyStart
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $earlyFinish
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateStart
           * @param  array<int, DateTimeImmutable>  $lateFinish
           */
          private function rollUpParentsBackward(ProjectScheduleInput $input, array $tasks, array $children, array $earlyStart, array $earlyFinish, array &$lateStart, array &$lateFinish): void
          {
              $calendar = $input->calendar;
      
              foreach ($this->parentsByDepthDesc($tasks, $children) as $id) {
                  $childFinishes = [];
                  foreach ($children[$id] as $child) {
                      $childFinishes[] = $lateFinish[$child];
                  }
      
                  $lateFinish[$id] = $this->maxDate($childFinishes);
      
                  // Late start derived from the parent's rolled-up span.
                  $span = $calendar->countWorkingDays($earlyStart[$id], $earlyFinish[$id]) + 1;
                  $lateStart[$id] = $calendar->shift($lateFinish[$id], -($span - 1));
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Parent ids ordered deepest first (bottom-up roll-up needs children first).
           *
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           * @param  array<int, list<int>>  $children
           * @return list<int>
           */
          private function parentsByDepthDesc(array $tasks, array $children): array
          {
              $parents = array_keys($children);
      
              usort($parents, static function (int $a, int $b) use ($tasks): int {
                  return self::depth($b, $tasks) <=> self::depth($a, $tasks);
              });
      
              return $parents;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<int, SchedulableTask>  $tasks
           */
          private static function depth(int $id, array $tasks): int
          {
              $depth = 0;
              $current = $tasks[$id];
      
              while ($current->parentId !== null) {
                  $depth++;
                  $current = $tasks[$current->parentId];
              }
      
              return $depth;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
           */
          private function minDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $min = null;
      
              foreach ($dates as $date) {
                  if ($min === null || $date < $min) {
                      $min = $date;
                  }
              }
      
              if ($min === null) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the earliest date of an empty set.');
              }
      
              return $min;
          }
      
          /**
           * @param  array<array-key, DateTimeImmutable>  $dates
           */
          private function maxDate(array $dates): DateTimeImmutable
          {
              $max = null;
      
              foreach ($dates as $date) {
                  if ($max === null || $date > $max) {
                      $max = $date;
                  }
              }
      
              if ($max === null) {
                  throw new SchedulingException('Cannot compute the latest date of an empty set.');
              }
      
              return $max;
          }
      }

      <?php
      
      declare(strict_types=1);
      
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\CircularDependencyException;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyLink;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\DependencyType;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ProjectScheduleInput;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\SchedulableTask;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\ScheduleEngine;
      use App\Domain\Scheduling\WorkingCalendar;
      
      /**
       * Reference test cases for CPM-1: networks calculated BY HAND, including
       * SS, lag and holiday cases (PRD CPM-1 acceptance criteria).
       *
       * Baseline calendar for all cases: Mon–Fri, no holidays unless stated.
       */
      function engine(): ScheduleEngine
      {
          return new ScheduleEngine;
      }
      
      function task(int $id, ?int $parent, ?string $start, int $duration): SchedulableTask
      {
          return new SchedulableTask($id, $parent, $id, "Task {$id}", $start ? new DateTimeImmutable($start) : null, $duration);
      }
      
      function monFri(): WorkingCalendar
      {
          return new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
      }
      
      it('calculates an FS chain with holiday skipping and positive lag (reference case 1)', function () {
          // Holiday: Thu 2026-01-08.
          // A: 5wd from Mon Jan 5 → Jan 5,6,7,9,12 → finishes Mon Jan 12.
          // B: FS lag 0 → Tue Jan 13, 3wd → finishes Thu Jan 15.
          // C: FS lag 2 → 2wd after Jan 15 = Tue Jan 20, 2wd → finishes Wed Jan 21.
          $calendar = new WorkingCalendar([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], ['2026-01-08']);
      
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              $calendar,
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 5), task(2, null, null, 3), task(3, null, null, 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 2)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(1)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-15')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-20')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')
              ->and($result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-21')
              ->and($result->totalDuration)->toBe(12)
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->slack)->toBe(0);
      });
      
      it('takes the latest constraint when a task has several predecessors (reference case 2, DEP-6)', function () {
          // A: 2wd from Mon Jan 5 → finishes Tue Jan 6. B: 1wd from Fri Jan 2 → finishes Jan 2.
          // C: FS from A → Jan 7; FS from B → Jan 5. Max wins: Jan 7. C: 2wd → finishes Jan 8.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 2), task(2, null, '2026-01-02', 1), task(3, null, null, 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-02'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->slack)->toBeGreaterThan(0)
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->isCritical)->toBeFalse();
      });
      
      it('handles start-to-start with negative lag (lead) (reference case 3, DEP-3/DEP-4)', function () {
          // A: 3wd from Mon Jan 5 → Jan 5..7.
          // B: SS lag −1 from A, no requested start → default start Jan 5 anchors first,
          //    so B starts Jan 5 (max of default and shift(A.start, -1) = Jan 2). B: 2wd → Jan 5..6.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 3), task(2, null, null, 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::SS, -1)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06');
      
          // Same network, but B requested to start Wed Jan 7: SS −1 only requires Jan 2,
          // so the requested start wins.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 3), task(2, null, '2026-01-07', 2)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::SS, -1)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08');
      });
      
      it('computes slack and multiple critical paths (reference case 4, CPM-2/CPM-5)', function () {
          // A(2wd) → B(3wd) → D(1wd);  A → C(1wd) → D.
          // Longest path A→B→D = 6wd, so C has float.
          // A: Jan 5-6, B: Jan 7-9, C: Jan 7, D: Jan 12. Project: Jan 5..12 (6wd).
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 2), task(2, null, null, 3), task(3, null, null, 1), task(4, null, null, 1)],
              [
                  new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0),
                  new DependencyLink(1, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0),
                  new DependencyLink(2, 4, DependencyType::FS, 0),
                  new DependencyLink(3, 4, DependencyType::FS, 0),
              ],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(3)->slack)->toBe(2)
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->isCritical)->toBeFalse()
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
              ->and($result->forTask(4)->isCritical)->toBeTrue()
              ->and($result->totalDuration)->toBe(6)
              ->and($result->projectFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12');
      });
      
      it('rolls parent tasks up from their children (reference case 5, TSK-4)', function () {
          // Parent 10 with children: c1 (Jan 5, 2wd) and c2 (requested Jan 8, 3wd → Jan 8-12).
          // Parent: Jan 5..Jan 12. Parent slack: LS = Jan 8 (finish held by c2), so slack 3.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(10, null, null, 0), task(11, 10, '2026-01-05', 2), task(12, 10, '2026-01-08', 3)],
              [],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(10)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-05')
              ->and($result->forTask(10)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($result->forTask(10)->lateFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($result->forTask(11)->slack)->toBe(4)
              ->and($result->forTask(12)->slack)->toBe(0)
              ->and($result->forTask(10)->isCritical)->toBeTrue();
      });
      
      it('treats dependencies to a parent at the parent level (reference case 6, PRD §8.5)', function () {
          // Parent P has children c1 (Jan 5, 1wd) and c2 (Jan 6, 2wd → Jan 6-7).
          // S is FS-successor of P: starts the working day after P finishes → Jan 8.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(10, null, null, 0), task(11, 10, '2026-01-05', 1), task(12, 10, '2026-01-06', 2), task(20, null, null, 1)],
              [new DependencyLink(10, 20, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(10)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07')
              ->and($result->forTask(20)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-08');
      });
      
      it('schedules milestones as zero-duration points (TSK-5)', function () {
          // A: Jan 5, 1wd → Jan 5. Milestone M: FS from A → Jan 6. B: FS from M → Jan 7.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 1), task(2, null, null, 0), task(3, null, null, 1)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 3, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(2)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06')
              ->and($result->forTask(2)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-06')
              ->and($result->forTask(3)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-07');
      });
      
      it('adjusts a requested start that falls on a non-working day (TSK-1 AC)', function () {
          // Start requested Sat Jan 10 → moves to Mon Jan 12, 2wd → finishes Tue Jan 13.
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-10', 2)],
              [],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      
          expect($result->forTask(1)->earlyStart->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-12')
              ->and($result->forTask(1)->earlyFinish->format('Y-m-d'))->toBe('2026-01-13');
      });
      
      it('refuses to calculate a cyclic network (PRD §8.7)', function () {
          engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(
              monFri(),
              [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 1), task(2, null, null, 1)],
              [new DependencyLink(1, 2, DependencyType::FS, 0), new DependencyLink(2, 1, DependencyType::FS, 0)],
              new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05'),
          ));
      })->throws(CircularDependencyException::class);
      
      it('recalculates 500 chained tasks within the 1s performance target (PRD §9)', function () {
          $tasks = [task(1, null, '2026-01-05', 1)];
          $links = [];
      
          for ($id = 2; $id <= 500; $id++) {
              $tasks[] = task($id, null, null, 1);
              $links[] = new DependencyLink($id - 1, $id, DependencyType::FS, 0);
          }
      
          $started = microtime(true);
          $result = engine()->calculate(new ProjectScheduleInput(monFri(), $tasks, $links, new DateTimeImmutable('2026-01-05')));
          $elapsed = microtime(true) - $started;
      
          // 500 working days after 2026-01-05.
          expect($result->totalDuration)->toBe(500)
              ->and($elapsed)->toBeLessThan(1.0);
      });
```

```
      <?php

      namespace App\Livewire\Gantt;
```
